items.title: Mexico: Mareykanka oo diyaarad basaas ah oo aan duuliye lahayn u duuliyay qabashada ganacsade daroogo oo caan ah
items.summary: Saraakiisha amniga Mexico ayaa Isniintii sheegay in Mareykanku uu dhulka Mexico dul marsiiyay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo basaasnimo, si ay uga caawiso raadinta iyo qabashada Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, oo loo yaqaan 'El Chapo Isidro'.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Culiacán ee gobolka Sinaloa, sawir hore

items.title: SEC oo 3 December shir gaar ah u qabanaysa go'aanka in LSU laga saaro, khilaafka RJ Luis dartiis
items.summary: Shirarka SEC ee isboortiga jaamacadaha Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii dukumiinti maxkamadeed ku sheegay inay 3 December shir gaar ah ku eegi doonaan in xubinnimada jaamacadda LSU la joojiyo, iyadoo khilaafka ciyaaryahanka kubbadda koleyga RJ Luis uu gaaray heer cusub.
items.imageAlt: Greg Sankey, guddoomiyaha SEC, sawir hore

items.title: Maxkamadda racfaanka oo dib u furtay dadaalka Trump ee ah in kiiska lacagta aamusnaanta loo wareejiyo maxkamad federaal
items.summary: Saddex garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee 2nd Circuit ayaa Isniintii dib u soo nooleeyay codsiga Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee ah in kiiskiisa dambiyeed ee lacagta aamusnaanta ee New York loo wareejiyo maxkamad federaal.
items.imageAlt: Donald Trump, sawir hore

items.title: Bukele oo shaaciyay magacyada saddex askari oo El Salvador ah oo ku dhintay hawlgal ka dhan ah burcadda Haiti
items.summary: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele ayaa magacaabay saddex askari oo dalkiisa ah oo ku dhintay hawlgal ka dhan ah kooxaha hubaysan ee Haiti, wuxuuna sheegay in qoys kasta la siin doono 200,000 oo doollar.
items.imageAlt: Nayib Bukele iyo ciidamada El Salvador, sawir hore oo 2019 ah

items.title: Mareykanka oo shirkadda Megaspeed iyo lix kale ku daray liiska madow ee dhoofinta tiknoolajiyadda
items.summary: Xafiiska Amniga iyo Warshadaha ee Mareykanka (BIS) ayaa Isniintii shirkadda Megaspeed International ee fadhigeedu yahay Singapore iyo lix shirkadood oo kale ku daray liiska xakamaynta dhoofinta, saacado kadib markii Jensen Huang uu dib ugu soo laabtay xilka maamulaha guud ee Nvidia.
items.imageAlt: Jensen Huang oo ka hadlaya bandhig Nvidia oo ka dhacay CES 2025, sawir hore

items.title: Zelensky oo ku baaqay wadahadal nabadeed oo afar dhinac ah oo Ruushka, Yurub iyo Mareykanka ay ka qaybgalaan
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Isniintii ku baaqay in sida ugu dhaqsaha badan la qabto wareeg cusub oo wadahadal ah oo ay ka qaybgalaan Ukraine, Ruushka, Mareykanka iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha Yurub, isagoo sheegay in Kyiv ay diyaar u tahay kulan dhici kara Talaadada.
items.imageAlt: Volodymyr Zelensky, sawir hore

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo soo jeediyay cunaqabateyn cusub oo Ruushka ka mamnuucaysa tartamada ciyaaraha
items.summary: Guddiga Midowga Yurub ayaa Isniintii soo bandhigay xirmadii 22aad ee cunaqabateynta Ruushka, oo bartilmaameedsanaysa bangiyo, madalaha lacagaha crypto-ga iyo ka qaybgalka Ruushka ee tartamada ciyaaraha ee dalalka Midowga.
items.imageAlt: Ursula von der Leyen, sawir hore

items.title: Luis de la Fuente oo uga digay Faransiiska: 'Waxay wajihi doonaan kooxda ugu fiican adduunka'
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Spain Luis de la Fuente ayaa Isniintii muujiyay kalsooni weyn kahor labada kulan ee wareegga siddeed-dhammaadka Nations League ee ay Spain la ciyaari doonto Faransiiska 25 iyo 28 March.
items.imageAlt: Luis de la Fuente, tababaraha xulka Spain, sawir hore

items.title: Dab ka kacay hoteel ku yaal xeebta Nungwi ee Zanzibar oo gaaray hoteello iyo dukaanno kale
items.summary: Dab xooggan oo ka kacay hoteelka Makofi ee xeebta Nungwi, waqooyiga Zanzibar, ayaa ku fiday hoteello, makhaayado iyo dukaanno ku dhow, halka saraakiishu sheegeen in dhammaan 183 dalxiisayaal ah ay ka badbaadeen.
items.imageAlt: Xeebta Nungwi ee Zanzibar, sawir hore

items.title: Brentford oo 4-0 ku jebisay Everton, Tarkowski oo helay kaarkiisii ugu horreeyay ee cas
items.summary: Brentford ayaa Isniintii 4-0 kaga adkaatay Everton oo 10 ciyaartoy ku dhammeysay kulankii ku xirmay toddobaadka 11aad ee Premier League, iyadoo Keane Lewis-Potter uu dhaliyay 2 gool.
items.imageAlt: Keane Lewis-Potter, sawir hore

items.title: Arizona Cardinals oo shaqada ka eriyay isku-duwaha difaaca Nick Rallis
items.summary: Kooxda NFL ee Arizona Cardinals ayaa xilka ka qaaday isku-duwaha difaaca Nick Rallis, sida ay sheegeen warbixino badan, iyadoo Teryl Austin uu si ku meel gaar ah u qaban doono jagada.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka kooxda Arizona Cardinals, sawir hore

items.title: Guingamp oo xiriir la sameysay Cyril Hanouna si uu u caawiyo kooxda xilli ay dhibaato dhaqaale ku jirto
items.summary: Kooxda Ligue 2 ee En Avant Guingamp ayaa la sheegay inay wada-hadal la furtay soo-saare iyo bandhig-gudbiye telefishan caan ah oo Faransiis ah, Cyril Hanouna, si uu u noqdo saamile oo uu kooxda uga caawiyo dhibaatada dhaqaale.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Roudourou ee kooxda Guingamp, sawir hore

items.title: San Francisco 49ers oo heshiiska u kordhisay maareeyaha guud John Lynch
items.summary: Kooxda NFL-ka ee San Francisco 49ers ayaa kordhisay heshiiska John Lynch, madaxa hawlaha kubadda iyo maareeyaha guud ee kooxda, oo sannadkan tobnaad la joogo kooxda.
items.imageAlt: John Lynch, sawir hore

items.title: San Francisco 49ers oo sii daayay Brandon Aiyuk kadib muddo dheer oo uu dhaawac ku maqnaa
items.summary: Kooxda NFL-ka ee San Francisco 49ers ayaa Isniintii sii daysay ciyaaryahanka Brandon Aiyuk, oo aan ciyaar NFL ah ciyaarin tan iyo markii uu dhaawac culus jilibka kaga dhacay xilli ciyaareedkii 2024.
items.imageAlt: Brandon Aiyuk, sawir hore

items.title: Ruushka oo ku eedeeyay Estonia ficillo cadownimo, kana digay in ay qarka u saaran tahay dagaal furan
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Isniintii ku eedeysay Estonia ficillo cadownimo ah, iyadoo sheegtay in dalkaas xubinta ka ah NATO uu qarka u saaran yahay inuu kiciyo dagaal furan, kadib markii Tallinn ay ku dhawaaqday inay xireyso xuduudda.
items.imageAlt: Qalcadda Hermann ee magaalada Narva, oo ku taal xuduudda Estonia iyo Ruushka, sawir hore

items.title: Guterres oo dalalka ugu baaqay inay sannad gudihii ku heshiiyaan nidaam caalami ah oo lagu maamulo AI
items.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres ayaa Isniintii shir ka socday Barbados ku sheegay in dalalku ay sannad gudihii ku heshiiyaan qaab caalami ah oo lagu maareeyo khataraha sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI), oo leh kormeer madax-bannaan.
items.imageAlt: António Guterres, Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, sawir hore

items.title: Stellantis oo kooxaheeda kala baxaysa tartamada baabuurta, Peugeot iyo Le Mans, Citroën iyo Opel-na Formula E
items.summary: Shirkadda weyn ee baabuurta Stellantis ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday inay kooxaheeda ka saaraysa tartamada baabuurta, si ay diiradda u saarto qorshe ay ku soo celinayso faa'iidadeeda, iyadoo ka bixi doonta tartamada adduunka ee FIA dhammaadka 2027.
items.imageAlt: Baabuurka tartanka Peugeot 9X8, sawir hore

items.title: Jude Bellingham iyo Real Madrid oo la sheegay inay ku jiraan wadahadallo horumarsan oo heshiis cusub ah
items.summary: Warbixinno ka soo baxay Ingiriiska iyo Spain ayaa sheegaya in Real Madrid iyo Jude Bellingham ay gaareen heer horumarsan wadahadallada heshiis cusub oo muddo dheer ah, inkastoo aan weli heshiis la gaarin.
items.imageAlt: Jude Bellingham, sawir hore

items.title: FIFA oo ansixisay: Koobka Adduunka Haweenka 2031 Mareykanka iyo saddex dal, 2035-na Boqortooyada Ingiriiska
items.summary: Shir-weyne gaar ah oo FIFA ayaa Isniintii ansixiyay in Koobka Adduunka Haweenka ee 2031 ay wada martigeliyaan Mareykanka, Mexico, Costa Rica iyo Jamaica, kan 2035-na uu ka dhaco Boqortooyada Ingiriiska.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino (midig) iyo Markwayne Mullin, sawir hore

items.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Museveni oo war-murtiyeed wadajir ah ku baaqay wadahadal siyaasadeed iyo xoojinta AUSSOM
items.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni ayaa Isniintii Uganda kaga wada hadlay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, waxayna war-murtiyeed wadajir ah ku adkeeyeen in dowladda federaalku wadahadal la yeelato dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dhinacyada kale.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Cyprien Sarrazin oo laba sano kadib shil culus dib ugu soo laabanaya Koobka Adduunka ee Ski-ga
items.summary: Xiriirka Ski-ga Faransiiska ayaa Isniintii Cyprien Sarrazin ku daray kooxda tartanka super-G ee Sabtida ka dhacaya Copper Mountain ee Mareykanka, laba sano kadib shil culus oo uu ku dhaawacmay.
items.imageAlt: Cyprien Sarrazin, sawir hore oo la qaaday 2019

items.title: Finland oo u yeeratay safiirka Ruushka kadib helikobtar Ruush ah oo looga shakiyay inuu ku xadgudbay hawadeeda
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Finland ayaa Isniintii u yeeratay safiirka Ruushka, maalmo kadib markii helikobtar Ruush ah looga shakiyay inuu galay hawada Finland, waxayna cambaareysay weerarrada Moscow ee ka dhanka ah bartilmaameedyada rayidka ee Ukraine.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Finland ee Merikasarmi, Helsinki (sawir hore)

items.title: Dukumiintiyo la daadiyay: Infantino oo doonayay in Koobka Adduunka 96 sano loo iibiyo maalgashadeyaal
items.summary: Dukumiintiyo la daadiyay ayaa muujinaya in madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino uu dejiyay qorshe ku saabsan in hawlaha ganacsiga iyo tartamada FIFA, oo uu ku jiro Koobka Adduunka, loo furo maalgashi gaar ah muddo gaaraysa 96 sano.
items.imageAlt: Gianni Infantino, madaxweynaha FIFA, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweynaha Uganda oo la filayo inuu booqasho ku yimaado Soomaaliya
items.summary: Warar hoose oo laga helayo ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Kaguta Museveni, uu qorsheynayo booqasho uu ku imaan karo Muqdisho, inkasta oo aanay labada dowladood weli si rasmi ah u shaacin safarkan.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni oo kulan ku leh, iyagoo u dhexeeya calanka Soomaaliya iyo kan Uganda

items.title: Tomáš Rosický oo ka tagay xilka agaasimaha ciyaaraha ee Sparta Prague kadib siddeed sano
items.summary: Kooxda Sparta Prague ee Czech ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday in ay heshiis ku kala tageen agaasimaheeda ciyaaraha Tomáš Rosický, oo xilkaas hayay tan iyo December 2018, waxaana xilka si ku-meel-gaar ah loogu wareejiyay Tomáš Sivok.
items.imageAlt: Tomáš Rosický, sawir hore

items.title: David Raya oo seegi doona kulanka Dortmund, Arteta-na sheegay in dhaawaca garabku aanu culus ahayn
items.summary: Tababaraha Arsenal Mikel Arteta ayaa Isniintii sheegay in goolhaye David Raya uusan u diyaar ahayn kulanka Talaadada ee Champions League ee Borussia Dortmund, balse dhaawaca garabkiisa bidix uu u muuqdo mid aan culus ahayn.
items.imageAlt: Mikel Arteta oo u ciyaaraya Arsenal sannadkii 2011, sawir hore

items.title: Goolhayaha Jarmalka Ann-Katrin Berger oo ku biiraysa Union Berlin bisha January
items.summary: Union Berlin ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqday inay la soo wareegtay goolhayaha xulka Jarmalka Ann-Katrin Berger, oo kooxda ku biiri doonta January 2027 marka uu dhammaado heshiiskeeda Gotham FC ee Mareykanka.
items.imageAlt: Ann-Katrin Berger oo u ciyaaraysa Gotham FC, sawir hore

items.title: Emre Mor oo 29 jir ah oo hakiyay xirfaddiisa kubbadda cagta, kadib markii NEC Nijmegen ay heshiiskiisa joojisay
items.summary: Kooxda Holland ee NEC Nijmegen ayaa Isniintii, 23 November, ku dhawaaqday inay si wadajir ah ula joojisay heshiiska garabka Turkiga Emre Mor, isla markiiba, iyadoo warbixinnada ay sheegayaan in ciyaaryahanku hakinayo xirfaddiisa ciyaareed.
items.imageAlt: Emre Mor, sawir hore

items.title: Mourinho oo difaacay Vinícius kahor kulanka Real Madrid iyo PSV ee Champions League
items.summary: Tababaraha Real Madrid José Mourinho ayaa kahor kulanka Talaadada ee PSV Eindhoven difaacay Vinícius Júnior, isagoo sheegay in xiddigga reer Brazil uusan u baahnayn inuu kulan kasta noqdo ciyaaryahanka ugu fiican haddii uu wax walba bixiyo.
items.imageAlt: Vinícius Júnior, sawir hore

items.title: Jannik Sinner oo la sheegay in qalliin jilibka laga sameynayo, laguna wado inuu seego Australian Open
items.summary: Ciyaartoyga tennis-ka Talyaaniga Jannik Sinner, oo ah kaalinta 2-aad ee adduunka, ayaa la sheegay in Talaadada qalliin lagaga sameynayo jilibka midig magaalada Turku ee Finland, taas oo u badan inay ka reebto tartanka Australian Open ee January.
items.imageAlt: Jannik Sinner, sawir hore

items.title: Markus Krösche oo la sheegay inuu ku biirayo AC Milan, isagoo noqonaya madaxa hawlaha kubadda
items.summary: Warbixinno ka soo baxay Jarmalka iyo Talyaaniga ayaa sheegaya in Markus Krösche, agaasimihii hore ee ciyaaraha Eintracht Frankfurt, uu ku biiri doono AC Milan 1 January 2027, inkastoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Markus Krösche, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo Addis Ababa ka daah-furtay qorshe Afrika looga hortagayo dhimashada hooyooyinka iyo dhallaanka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Isniintii, 23 November 2026, magaalada Addis Ababa ka daah-furtay qorshe qaaradeed oo hage u ah dalalka Afrika si ay u yareeyaan dhimashada laga hortagi karo ee hooyooyinka iyo carruurta dhalashada cusub.
items.imageAlt: Samia Suluhu Hassan, sawir hore

items.title: Manchester United oo racfaan ka qaadanaysa kaarka cas ee Leny Yoro lagu tusay kulanka Liverpool
items.summary: Manchester United ayaa Ururka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) u sheegtay inay racfaan ka qaadanayso kaarka cas ee daafaca Leny Yoro lagu tusay daqiiqaddii 8-aad ee kulankii Axadda ay 4-0 uga adkaatay Liverpool garoonka Anfield.
items.imageAlt: Leny Yoro, sawir hore

items.title: Enzo Maresca oo ku jawaabay Allegri ka hor kulanka Manchester City iyo Napoli
items.summary: Tababaraha Manchester City Enzo Maresca ayaa Isniintii, maalin ka hor kulanka Champions League ee ay Napoli la ciyaarayaan garoonka Etihad, ku jawaabay hadalkii Massimiliano Allegri ee ahaa in kulanku Napoli u yahay mid aad u adag.
items.imageAlt: Enzo Maresca, sawir hore

items.title: MSF oo 3 bilood u hakisay hawlaheeda Yei kadib afduubka laba shaqaale caafimaad
items.summary: Hay'adda caafimaadka ee Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) ayaa shaacisay inay 3 bilood hakisay hawlaheeda agagaarka magaalada Yei ee Koonfur Suudaan, kadib markii rag hubaysan ay afduubeen darawal ka tirsan hay'adda iyo umuliso ka tirsan Wasaaradda Caafimaadka.
items.imageAlt: Yei, sawir hore

items.title: Qoridda Copa del Rey: Valencia oo la ciyaaraysa Real Jaén, Sevilla-na Atlético Paso
items.summary: Qoridda wareegga labaad ee koobka Copa del Rey ee Spain, oo Isniintii lagu qabtay xarunta Ciudad del Fútbol ee Las Rozas, ayaa Valencia isugu keentay Real Jaén, halka Sevilla ay la ciyaari doonto Atlético Paso oo ka socota jasiiradda La Palma.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Mestalla ee Valencia, sawir hore

items.title: Axmed Macallin Fiqi: Safarkii Diblomaasiyadeed, Sirdoon, Siyaasad iyo Hoggaaminta Wasaaradaha Soomaaliya
items.summary: Warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan taariikhda siyaasadeed ee Axmed Macallin Fiqi, laga soo bilaabo safiirnimadii Suudaan iyo hoggaaminta NISA ilaa xilalka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Gaashaandhigga.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo ag taagan calanka Soomaaliya

items.title: Saadaq Joon oo la sheegay in loo magacaabayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo xilka laga qaadayo
items.summary: Warar siyaasadeed oo soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in Saadaq Cumar Xasan (Saadaq Joon) loo magacaabayo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, halka Axmed Macallin Fiqi xilka laga qaadayo, inkasta oo aan weli la helin war rasmi ah oo xaqiijinaya.
items.imageAlt: Saadaq Cumar Xasan (Saadaq Joon) iyo Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi

items.title: Abiy Axmed oo sheegay in Itoobiya ay xoojinayso xiriirka Imaaraadka xilli khilaafka Muqdisho iyo Abu Dhabi uu sii socdo
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed ayaa Isniintii sheegay inuu Addis Ababa kula kulmay Wasiiru-dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda ee Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheekh Shakhboot bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, kana wada hadleen xoojinta xiriirka labada dal.
items.imageAlt: Abiy Axmed, sawir hore

items.title: Maxkamadda CAS oo Talaadada go'aan ka gaaraysa cidda ku guulaysatay AFCON 2025: Senegal ama Morocco
items.summary: Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) ayaa Isniintii shaacisay inay Talaadada soo saari doonto go'aanka rafcaanka Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Senegal ka qaatay CAF iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Morocco, ee ku saabsan koobka Qaramada Afrika 2025.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta CAS ee Lausanne, sawir hore

items.title: PSG oo soo bandhigtay funaanaddeeda saddexaad, oo ay la sameysay Jordan Brand, kahor kulanka Roma
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain ayaa Isniintii soo bandhigtay funaanaddeeda saddexaad ee xilli ciyaareedkan, oo ay si wadajir ah u sameeyeen kooxda iyo Jordan Brand, waxaana la filayaa inay ku xirato kulanka Champions League ee ay la leedahay Roma.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Parc des Princes ee PSG, sawir hore

items.title: Lamine Yamal oo ka maqnaan doona kulanka Barcelona iyo Sabah kadib dhibaato canqowga ah
items.summary: Barcelona ayaa Isniintii shaacisay in Lamine Yamal uusan la safri doonin kooxda una ambabaxaysa Baku, kana maqnaan doono kulanka Champions League ee Sabah, sababo la xiriira dhibaato fudud oo canqowga midig ah.
items.imageAlt: Lamine Yamal, sawir hore

items.title: In ka badan 12,000 oo qof oo laga daadgureeyay hoolka Co-op Live ee Manchester kadib walax aan la aqoon
items.summary: Booliiska Greater Manchester ayaa ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo weyn kadib markii walax aan la garanayn lagu sii daayay hoolka Co-op Live xilli bandhig uu qabanayay fanaanka Maraykanka ah Don Toliver, iyadoo in ka badan 12,000 qof laga saaray.
items.imageAlt: Fanaanka Don Toliver, sawir hore

items.title: Swindon Town oo shaqada ka eryay tababare Ian Holloway kadib bilow xun oo xilli ciyaareed
items.summary: Kooxda Swindon Town ee League Two ayaa Isniintan shaqada ka eryday tababarihii Ian Holloway, kadib markii ay kaliya laba guul ka gaartay 15-kii kulan ee ugu dambeeyay.
items.imageAlt: Ian Holloway, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo booqasho hal maalin ah ku tagaya Uganda, xilli hadallada Muhoozi ay muran dhaliyeen
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa booqasho shaqo oo hal maalin ah ku tagaya Uganda si uu ula kulmo Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, iyadoo ay socoto dhimista ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: AB de Villiers oo sheegay in Australia ay kubadda wax ka beddelaysay tan iyo kulankii ugu horreeyay ee taxanaha 2018
items.summary: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee South Africa AB de Villiers ayaa eedeeyay in kooxda cricket-ka Australia ay si sharci darro ah kubadda u beddelaysay laga bilaabo kulankii ugu horreeyay ee taxanihii Test-ka ee 2018, kaas oo dhaliyay fadeexaddii caanka ahayd ee 'sandpaper'.
items.imageAlt: AB de Villiers, sawir hore

items.title: Kim Jong Un oo xoojinaya xiriirka dibadda ee Kuuriyada Waqooyi, kadib markii kulankii Trump uu dhici waayay
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi Kim Jong Un ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu uu ballaarin doono xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed isagoo ilaalinaya madax-bannaanidiisa iyo amnigiisa qaran, maalmo kadib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu Aasiya ka ambabaxay isagoon la kulmin.
items.imageAlt: Kim Jong Un, sawir hore

items.title: Zelensky oo sheegay in Ukraine ay 7 drone badeed ku quusisay markabka dagaalka Ruushka ee Merkury xeebta Libya
items.summary: Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Isniintii sheegay in ciidamada Ukraine ay ka dambeeyeen weerarkii Axaddii lagu qaaday markabka dagaalka Ruushka ee Merkury ee dekedda Benghazi, isagoo sheegay in markabka la quusiyay, markab xamuul ah la garaacay, helikobtar militari ahna la burburiyay.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelensky, sawir hore

items.title: Charlotte oo daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay 2-1 kaga adkaatay Chicago Fire ee Lewandowski kulanka koowaad ee play-off-ka MLS
items.summary: Charlotte FC ayaa Axaddii 2-1 kaga adkaatay Chicago Fire kulankii koowaad ee wareegga koowaad ee play-off-ka MLS, kadib gool Pep Biel ku dhaliyay daqiiqadda 90+12.
items.imageAlt: Pep Biel, sawir hore

items.title: Fermín López oo laga yaabo inuu seego kulanka Atlético kadib warbixinta garsooraha ee kaarka casaanka
items.summary: Garsoore Alejandro Hernández Hernández ayaa warbixintiisa ku xaqiijiyay sababta kaarka casaanka ah ee Fermín López loo tusay kulankii Barcelona iyo Villarreal, waxaana xiddigga Barcelona sugaya ganaax laba ilaa saddex kulan ah oo uu Guddiga Anshaxa go'aan ka gaari doono.
items.imageAlt: Fermín López, sawir hore

items.title: Lorient iyo Rennes oo 1-1 ku kala tegey derby-ga Brittany, rigoore la khasaariyay
items.summary: Kooxaha Lorient iyo Stade Rennais ayaa Axaddii garoonka Stade du Moustoir ku kala tegey barbaro 1-1 ah, kulan ka tirsan wareegga 11-aad ee Ligue 1 oo ahaa derby-ga gobolka Brittany.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stade du Moustoir ee Lorient, sawir hore

items.title: Racing Santander oo 3-2 ku garaacday Real Sociedad, Yassir Zabiri oo laba daqiiqo gudahood laba gool ku dhaliyay
items.summary: Racing Santander ayaa Axaddii garoonka El Sardinero 3-2 kaga adkaatay Real Sociedad kulankii toddobaadka 13-aad ee LaLiga, iyadoo weeraryahanka reer Morocco Yassir Zabiri uu dhaliyay laba gool, isla markaana uu keenay rigoorihii go'aamiyay kulanka.
items.imageAlt: Yassir Zabiri, sawir hore oo laga qaaday xulka Morocco

items.title: Arsenal oo 0-0 la gashay West Ham, Lisa Baum oo xaaladdeedu deggan tahay kadib markii ay garoonka ku dhacday
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Arsenal ayaa Axaddii 0-0 la gashay West Ham horyaalka WSL, barbardhacii lixaad oo isku xiga ee garoonkeeda, iyadoo ciyaaryahanadda reer Jarmal ee Lisa Baum, 19 jir, laga qaaday garoonka iyadoo wejiga ku sidata maaskaro neefsasho.
items.imageAlt: Renée Slegers, tababaraha kooxda haweenka Arsenal, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2014

items.title: Markab Ruush ah oo ku xirnaa saldhigga ciidanka badda ee Benghazi oo lagu weeraray drone badeed
items.summary: Markab Ruush ah oo ku xirnaa saldhigga ciidanka badda ee magaalada Benghazi ee bariga Libya ayaa Axaddii lagu dhuftay weerar loo maleynayo inuu ahaa drone badeed, taas oo keentay qarax iyo dab, sida ay sheegtay dowladda fadhigeedu yahay bariga Libya.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Benghazi ee Libya, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweynaha Dortmund Watzke oo u rajeeyay Harry Kane bogsasho degdeg ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Borussia Dortmund, Hans-Joachim Watzke, ayaa Axaddii shirweynaha xubnaha kooxda uga mahadceliyay Harry Kane, weeraryahanka Bayern Munich ee dhaawacmay, una rajeeyay inuu si degdeg ah u bogsado.
items.imageAlt: Hans-Joachim Watzke, madaxweynaha Borussia Dortmund, sawir hore

items.title: Saint-Étienne oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Reims, taageerayaashiisana garoonka laga mamnuucay
items.summary: Saint-Étienne ayaa Sabtidii 1-0 kaga guuleystay Reims kulankii wareegga 13-aad ee Ligue 2, laakiin taageerayaasha kooxda ayaan loo oggolaan inay galaan garoonka Auguste-Delaune, taas oo ay ku tilmaameen go'aan xorriyadda xaddidaya oo ceeb ah.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Auguste-Delaune ee Reims, sawir hore

items.title: Puntland oo Carmo ka dhagax-dhigtay 500 guri oo loogu talagalay ciidanka booliiska iyo qoysaskooda
items.summary: Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliiska Puntland, Jeneraal Muumin Cabdi Shire, ayaa Axaddii degmada Carmo ee gobolka Bari dhagax-dhig ugu sameeyay dhismaha 500 guri iyo xarumo waxbarasho iyo caafimaad oo ay yeelan doonaan askarta booliiska iyo qoysaskooda.
items.imageAlt: Jeneraal Muumin Cabdi Shire, taliyaha ciidanka booliiska Puntland, sawir hore

items.title: Van Dijk oo rikoor cusub dhigay, Liverpool-na gaartay 700 guul oo Premier League ah
items.summary: Kabtanka Liverpool Virgil van Dijk ayaa Axaddii noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu da'da weyn ee aan goolhaye ahayn ee 50 kulan oo Premier League ah oo isku xiga u bilaaba hal naadi, xilli Liverpool ay 4-0 ku garaacday Manchester United.
items.imageAlt: Virgil van Dijk, sawir hore

items.title: Hull City oo 2-0 ku garaacday Brighton, McBurnie oo laba gool ku dhaliyay waqtiga dheeraadka
items.summary: Hull City ayaa Axaddii garoonkeeda MKM Stadium 2-0 kaga adkaatay Brighton oo 10 ciyaaryahan ku dhammaysatay kulanka, kadib laba gool oo Oli McBurnie ku dhaliyay waqtiga dheeraadka ah ee kulanka toddobaadka 11-aad ee Premier League.
items.imageAlt: Oli McBurnie, weeraryahanka Hull City, sawir hore

items.title: Córdoba oo 3-0 ku garaacday Real Oviedo, Raúl oo labadiisii kulan ee ugu horreeyay laga badiyay
items.summary: Kooxda Córdoba ayaa Axaddii garoonkeeda El Arcángel 3-0 kaga adkaatay Real Oviedo horyaalka heerka labaad ee Isbaanishka, taas oo ahayd guuldarradii labaad ee Oviedo kala kulantay labada kulan ee uu tababare Raúl González Blanco hoggaaminayay.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyda Real Oviedo oo ciyaar ku jira, sawir hore oo 2017 ah

items.title: Bologna iyo Udinese oo 1-1 ku kala baxay, Zaniolo oo joojiyay afartii guul ee isku xigtay ee Bologna
items.summary: Bologna ayaa Axaddii garoonka Dall'Ara 1-1 ku la barbardhacday Udinese kulankii toddobaadka 12-aad ee Serie A, iyadoo goolkii Zortea uu Zaniolo ka jawaabay qaybtii labaad.
items.imageAlt: Nicolò Zaniolo, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2018 isagoo ku jira xulka Talyaaniga ee da'da 19

items.title: Genoa oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Sassuolo, Osmajic oo laba gool dhaliyay; D'Aversa oo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay laga badiyay
items.summary: Genoa oo uu tababaro Daniele De Rossi ayaa Axaddii 2-0 kaga guulaysatay Sassuolo garoonka Mapei Stadium kulankii toddobaadka 12-aad ee Serie A, iyadoo labada gool ay dhammaantood qaybtii hore dhalisay weeraryahanka Osmajic.
items.imageAlt: Daniele De Rossi, hadda tababaraha Genoa, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2012 isagoo ciyaaryahan ah

items.title: Serie B: Avellino oo 4-1 dib uga soo kacday Mantova, Cheddira oo laba gool dhaliyay
items.summary: Kooxda Avellino ayaa Axaddii garoonkeeda Partenio-Lombardi 4-1 kaga adkaatay Mantova kulankii wareegga 12-aad ee Serie B, kadib markii ay gool ku hormartay, iyadoo weeraryahan Cheddira uu laba gool u dhaliyay.
items.imageAlt: Weeraryahan Walid Cheddira, sawir hore

items.title: Paris FC oo 4-0 ku jebisay Angers, kuna soo baxday kaalinta labaad ee Ligue 1 oo ay PSG ka dambeyso
items.summary: Paris FC ayaa Axaddii garoonka Jean-Bouin 4-0 kaga adkaatay Angers kulankii toddobaadka 11-aad ee Ligue 1, guushaas oo kooxda caasimadda ka dhigtay tan labaad ee horyaalka Faransiiska, iyadoo PSG oo keliya ay ka sarreyso.
items.imageAlt: Pablo Pagis oo u dabaaldegaya gool, sawir hore oo laga qaaday markii uu ku jiray FC Lorient

items.title: Iraola oo ka warbixiyay dhaawaca Gakpo iyo Gravenberch ee Liverpool
items.summary: Tababaraha Liverpool Andoni Iraola ayaa sharxay sababta Cody Gakpo iyo Ryan Gravenberch ay uga maqnaayeen kooxda ciyaartay kulankii Axadda ee Manchester United, iyadoo Gakpo uu qabo dhaawac murqaha kubka ah.
items.imageAlt: Cody Gakpo oo ku labisan Liverpool, sawir hore

items.title: Hansi Flick oo dhaleeceeyay garsoorayaashii kulanka Barcelona iyo Villarreal
items.summary: Tababaraha Barcelona Hansi Flick ayaa, kadib guushii 3-2 ee kooxdiisa ka gaartay Villarreal Axaddii, si adag u dhaleeceeyay garsoorihii kulanka Hernández Hernández iyo garsooraha afraad, isagoo sheegay in kooxdiisa ay had iyo jeer dhibaato la kulanto garsoorahan.
items.imageAlt: Hansi Flick, sawir hore

items.title: Ciyaaryahanka snooker-ka Shiinaha Liu Wenwei oo la hakiyay baaritaan ciyaar-iibsi awgiis
items.summary: Hay'adda maamusha snooker-ka adduunka, WPBSA, ayaa Axaddii 22 November si degdeg ah u hakisay ciyaaryahanka reer Shiinaha Liu Wenwei, iyadoo baaritaan lagu wado ku lug lahaanshihiisa isku dayo lagu doonayay in kulamo la iibsado.
items.imageAlt: Jason Ferguson, guddoomiyaha WPBSA, sawir hore

items.title: Burnley iyo Blackburn oo 2-2 ku kala baxay, Burnley oo 400 maalmood guul la'aan ku ah garoonkeeda
items.summary: Blackburn Rovers ayaa Axaddii 2-2 kula barbardhacday Burnley kulankii dheeraa ee East Lancashire ee horyaalka Championship, iyadoo Todd Cantwell uu rigoore ku dhaliyay goolka barbardhaca, kulankii ugu horreeyay tan iyo markii tababaraha Tony Mowbray uu xilka uga dhinac maray arrimo caafimaad.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Turf Moor ee kooxda Burnley, sawir hore

items.title: Barcelona oo 0-2 ka soo noqotay, 3-2 ku garaacday Villarreal, hoggaankana 3 dhibcood ku kordhisay
items.summary: Barcelona ayaa Axaddii ka soo kabatay 2-0 ay nasashada ku hoos jirtay, waxayna 3-2 ku garaacday Villarreal, iyadoo saddex gool dhalisay 10 daqiiqo gudahood, taasoo hoggaanka La Liga 3 dhibcood ugu kordhisay Real Madrid.
items.imageAlt: Natiijada kulanka: Barcelona 3-2 Villarreal

items.title: Marc Márquez oo ku guuleystay horyaalkiisii 8-aad ee MotoGP, la simay Giacomo Agostini
items.summary: Marc Márquez ayaa Axaddii ku guuleystay horyaalkiisii 8-aad ee MotoGP, isagoo kaalinta 8-aad ku dhammeystay Grand Prix-ga Portugal, taasoo la siman rikoorka Talyaaniga Giacomo Agostini.
items.imageAlt: Marc Márquez, sawir hore

items.title: Wasiir Fiqi oo ciidamada xoogga dalka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan qabyaaladda iyo ku biirista jabhadaha
items.summary: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Axaddii ciidamada qaranka ugu baaqay inay ka fogaadaan qabyaaladda iyo ku biirista jabhadaha, isagoo ka hadlayay munaasabad lagu soo bandhigayay dib-u-dhiska ciidanka badda.
items.imageAlt: Askar ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliya, sawir hore

items.title: Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha oo daah-furtay nidaam lagu diiwaangelinayo shirkadaha amniga gaarka ah
items.summary: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa Muqdisho ka daah-furay nidaam casri ah oo lagu diiwaangelinayo, laguna kormeerayo shirkadaha bixiya adeegyada amniga gaarka ah iyo shaqaalahooda.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), sawir hore

items.title: Tottenham oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Man City WSL, rikoorkii guriga ee Jeglertz oo burburay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Tottenham ayaa Axaddii 3-1 ku garaacday Manchester City garoonka Joie Stadium ee Women's Super League, taasoo soo afjartay rikoorkii guusha buuxda ee City ay gurigeeda ku lahayd.
items.imageAlt: Jess Naz oo ka tirsan Tottenham, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi ka socda shirkadda shidaalka ee Aljeeriya SONATRACH
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii Madaxtooyada Muqdisho ku qaabilay wafdi ka socda SONATRACH, shirkadda dowladda Aljeeriya ee shidaalka iyo gaaska, si looga wada hadlo iskaashi dhinaca khayraadka dabiiciga ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Shirka cimilada COP31 oo Antalya ku dhammaaday heshiis la'aan, kaddib khilaaf ku saabsan shidaalka
items.summary: Shirka sannadlaha ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee isbeddelka cimilada COP31, oo ka socday Antalya ee Turkiga, ayaa Axaddii ku soo idlaaday iyadoo aan la gaarin heshiis guud, kaddib khilaaf ku saabsan ka guurista shidaalka.
items.imageAlt: Murat Kurum, madaxweynaha COP31, sawir hore

items.title: Michael Olise oo la filayo inuu seego safarka Bayern ee Lille, Nianzou-na wuu dhaawacan yahay
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Bayern Munich Michael Olise ayaa la filayaa inuu seego kulanka Champions League ee Arbacada ay kooxdiisu la ciyaarayso Lille, halka Lille ay iyaduna la'aan doonto daafaceeda Tanguy Nianzou oo dhaawac muruq ah soo gaaray.
items.imageAlt: Michael Olise, sawir hore

items.title: WAR CUSUB: Galmudug oo maanta lagu dhawaaqayo Golaha Wasiirrada cusub, khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid beeleedna laga cabsi qabo
items.summary: Dhismaha Golaha Wasiirrada cusub ee Galmudug ayaa maanta si weyn isha loogu hayaa, iyadoo la filayo in Madaxweynaha maamulka Galmudug, Liibaan Cabdi Xasan, uu ku dhawaaqo xubnaha cusub ee Golaha Wasiirrada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Galmudug Liibaan Cabdi Xasan oo xiran suud madow iyo garawaati casaan ah, gacmihiisana is dul saaran

items.title: Timon Haugan oo ku guuleystay slalom-ka Gurgl, Pinheiro Braathen oo ka dhacay
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka Norway Timon Haugan ayaa Axaddii ku guuleystay tartanka slalom-ka Koobka Adduunka ee barafka ee Gurgl ee Austria, kaddib markii Lucas Pinheiro Braathen oo Brazil u ciyaara uu tartanka ka baxay.
items.imageAlt: Timon Haugan, sawir hore

items.title: Bayern Munich oo walaac ka qabta Jamal Musiala oo mar kale la kulmay miyir-beel kooban
items.summary: Jamal Musiala, xiddigga Bayern Munich, ayaa warbixinno la daabacay Axaddii lagu sheegay inuu Isniintii hore mar kale la kulmay miyir-beel kooban, inkastoo uu Jimcihii dib ugu soo laabtay garoonka Bundesliga.
items.imageAlt: Jamal Musiala, sawir hore

items.title: Juventus oo 4-0 ku jebisay Venezia, afar gool 18 daqiiqo gudahood ah
items.summary: Juventus ayaa Axaddii 4-0 ku garaacday Venezia kulankii toddobaadka 12-aad ee Serie A ee garoonka Allianz Stadium, iyadoo dhammaan goolasha ay dhalisay qaybtii labaad.
items.imageAlt: Tababaraha Juventus Luciano Spalletti, sawir hore

items.title: Isbarbardhigga Waxqabadka Labada Dowladood ee Soomaaliya: 2017–2022 iyo 2022–2026
items.summary: Labadii maamul ee Madaxweyne Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo (2017–2022) iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (2022–2026) waxay dalka ku hoggaamiyeen marxalado kala duwan, kuwaas oo mid walba lahaa fursado, caqabado siyaasadeed, mudnaano dowladeed iyo natiijooyin u gaar ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo is salaamaya, calanka Soomaaliya ag taagan

items.title: Watford oo shaqada ka eriyay tababaraha Alessio Dionisi kaddib 18 kulan
items.summary: Kooxda Watford ee horyaalka Championship ee England ayaa Axaddii shaqada ka eriday tababarahooda Alessio Dionisi, kaddib 18 kulan oo keliya, maalin kaddib guuldarro 4-0 ah oo ay kala kulantay Sheffield United.
items.imageAlt: Alessio Dionisi, sawir hore

items.title: PSG oo xaqiijisay in Désiré Doué uu ka go'ay seed-ka jilibka, qalliin ayaana loo samayn doonaa
items.summary: Paris Saint-Germain ayaa xaqiijisay in weeraryahankeeda Désiré Doué uu ka go'ay seed-ka hore ee jilibka midig (ACL) kulankii Ligue 1 ee Sabtida ay Nice kaga adkaadeen, qalliinna lagu samayn doono dhammaadka bisha kahor.
items.imageAlt: Désiré Doué, sawir hore

items.title: Verstappen oo ku guulaystay Las Vegas Grand Prix, Russell oo qalad sameeyay, Ferrari-na isku dhacday
items.summary: Max Verstappen oo u ciyaara Red Bull ayaa ku guulaystay Las Vegas Grand Prix tartan aad u qasan oo hoggaanka uu 34 jeer gacmo beddelay, halka George Russell uu qalad muhiim ah sameeyay, labada darawal ee Ferrari-na ay isku dhaceen.
items.imageAlt: Max Verstappen, sawir hore

items.title: Inter Miami oo 3-0 looga adkaaday Columbus, Messi oo kaarka cas ka badbaaday kaddib muran
items.summary: Inter Miami ayaa Sabtidii garoonkeeda 3-0 looga adkaaday Columbus Crew kulankii koowaad ee taxanaha saddexda kulan ee MLS Cup playoffs, iyadoo Lionel Messi uu ku jiray muran kaddib markii uu kubad ku tuuray ciyaaryahan kale.
items.imageAlt: Lionel Messi, sawir hore

items.title: Senator Faroole: muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha iyo baarlamaanka federaalka waa dhammaaday
items.summary: Madaxweynihii hore ee Puntland, Senator Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole, ayaa qoraal uu soo saaray Axaddan ku sheegay in muddo-xileedka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo labada aqal ee baarlamaanka federaalka uu dhammaaday.
items.imageAlt: Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Faroole oo la hadlaya saxaafadda, sawir hore

items.title: Wasiirka Duulista Soomaaliya oo Montreal kula kulmay madaxda ICAO
items.summary: Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya, Maxamed Faarax Nuux, ayaa magaalada Montreal ee Canada kaga qaybgalay Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Gaadiidka Cirka Adduunka, wuxuuna kulamo la yeeshay madaxda Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Caalamiga ah (ICAO).
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya Maxamed Faarax Nuux oo fadhiya miis shir

items.title: Warbixin caalami ah: dareenka amniga muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya oo lagu qiimeeyay 74%
items.summary: Hay'adda cilmi-baarista ee Global Safety Report ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in dareenka badbaadada muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya lagu qiimeeyay 74%, taas oo dalka ka dhigaysa kan ugu sarreeya dalalka Afrika ee ka hooseeya Saxaraha.
items.imageAlt: Waddo ku taal Muqdisho, sawir hore

items.title: Donyell Malen oo 4 gool dhaliyay, Roma oo 5-1 ku burburisay Parma
items.summary: Weeraryahanka reer Holland ee Donyell Malen ayaa Sabtidii afar gool u dhaliyay Roma, oo 5-1 kaga adkaatay Parma kulan Serie A ah, isagoo 2026 gaaray 26 gool oo uu ku dhaliyay 27 kulan.
items.imageAlt: Donyell Malen, sawir hore

items.title: Garsooraha Norway Espen Eskås oo maamuli doona kulanka Real Madrid iyo PSV
items.summary: Garsooraha reer Norway Espen Eskås ayaa loo magacaabay inuu maamulo kulanka Real Madrid iyo PSV Eindhoven ee Talaadada, kaas oo ka tirsan wareegga shanaad ee marxaladda horyaalka Champions League.
items.imageAlt: Garsoore Espen Eskås, sawir hore

items.title: Madaxa Ferrari: isku dhaca Hamilton iyo Leclerc ee Las Vegas waa mid aan la aqbali karin
items.summary: Madaxa kooxda Ferrari Fred Vasseur ayaa sheegay in isku dhacii ciyaaryahannadiisa Lewis Hamilton iyo Charles Leclerc ee Grand Prix-ga Las Vegas uu ahaa mid gebi ahaanba aan la aqbali karin.
items.imageAlt: Charles Leclerc oo wata gaariga Ferrari, sawir hore

items.title: Bruno Fernandes oo sheegay in Man Utd u bandhigtay heshiis cusub, balse wada-hadallada la hakiyay
items.summary: Kabtanka Manchester United, Bruno Fernandes, ayaa sheegay in naadigu u bandhigay heshiis cusub, balse uu dareemayo in hadda aysan ahayn waqtigii ku habboonaa ee laga wada hadli lahaa mustaqbalkiisa.
items.imageAlt: Bruno Fernandes, sawir hore

items.title: Carlos Alcaraz iyo Alexander Zverev oo maanta ku kulmaya finalka ATP Finals ee Turin
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz ayaa saddex set kaga adkaaday Ben Shelton semi-finalka ATP Finals, wuxuuna Axadda finalka magaalada Turin ee Talyaaniga kula ciyaari doonaa Alexander Zverev oo isna ka gudbay Daniil Medvedev.
items.imageAlt: Carlos Alcaraz, sawir hore

items.title: Xoolo-dhaqato abaartu xoolaha ka laysay oo Mudug kalluumeysi ugu wareegay
items.summary: Rag badan oo xoolo-dhaqato ah oo abaarihii isdaba-joogga ahaa ay xoolahooda ka laayeen gobolka Mudug ayaa u guuray xeebaha, halkaas oo ay ku barteen dabaasha iyo kalluumeysiga si ay noloshooda u maareeyaan.
items.imageAlt: Kalluumeysato Soomaaliyeed, sawir hore

items.title: Xasan Sheekh: Diyaar baan u ahay inaan mucaaradka guryahooda ugu tago si loo wada hadlo
items.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in dowladdu diyaar u tahay inay mucaaradka kula kulanto guryahooda, kaddib markii ay diideen martiqaadkii wada-hadalka ee dowladda.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho u soo wareejinaysa keydka tallaallada oo 30 sano ku jiray Kenya
items.summary: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Soomaaliya, Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, ayaa sheegay in xarunta keydinta tallaallada dalka, oo in ka badan 30 sano laga maamulayay Kenya, dib loogu soo wareejinayo Muqdisho.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Caafimaadka Soomaaliya Dr. Cali Xaaji Aadan, sawir hore

items.title: Lix garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Sare oo dowladda federaalka dacwad uga gudbiyey Maxkamadda Bariga Afrika
items.summary: Lix garsoore oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya, oo uu ku jiro guddoomiyihii xilka laga qaaday Baashe Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa dowladda federaalka dacwad uga gudbiyey Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Bariga Afrika (EACJ).
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Boca Juniors oo ku guulaysatay Copa Sudamericana, koob caalami ah kii ugu horreeyay 18 sano
items.summary: Boca Juniors ayaa Sabtidii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Atlético Mineiro finalka Copa Sudamericana ee lagu ciyaaray Barranquilla, Colombia, waxayna gaartay koobkii caalamiga ahaa ee ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2008.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaaryahan Boca Juniors ah oo ciyaar ku jira, sawir hore

items.title: Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea oo Aswan ka taageeray madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya
items.summary: Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee Masar, Suudaan iyo Eritrea ayaa kulan saddex geesood ah oo ay ku yeesheen magaalada Aswan mar kale ku xaqiijiyey taageeradooda midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, kana soo horjeestay maamullo ama maleeshiyaad barbar socda dowladda dhexe.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Masar Badr Abdelatty, sawir hore

items.title: Victor Wembanyama oo 50 dhibcood dhaliyay, San Antonio Spurs oo New Orleans ku garaacday 114-91
items.summary: Xiddigga San Antonio Spurs Victor Wembanyama ayaa dhaliyay 50 dhibcood iyo 19 rebound, iyadoo kooxdiisu NBA-da ku garaacday New Orleans Pelicans 114-91, waxqabad aan hore loogu arag taariikhda horyaalka.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama, sawir hore

items.title: PSG oo 3-2 kaga adkaatay Nice, balse Désiré Doué oo jilibka si xun uga dhaawacmay

items.summary: Ururka Kubadda Cagta Koonfurta Ameerika (CONMEBOL) ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay in 10-ka dal ee ka tirsan ay si wadajir ah u taageerayaan dib-u-doorashada Gianni Infantino oo ah guddoomiyaha FIFA, doorashada 18 March 2027.

items.title: Liverpool: Van Dijk, Frimpong iyo Gravenberch oo diyaar u ah Man Utd, Van Dijk-na mustaqbalkiisa ma hubo

items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu mamnuuco shirkadaha Mareykanka ee xarumaha xogta AI ka dhisa dibadda

items.title: NFL: Drake Maye oo lafta lugta ka jabtay, Patriots-na waxay sidoo kale waayi doonaan A.J. Brown
items.summary: Quarterback-ka New England Patriots Drake Maye ayaa laga helay jab lafta fibula ee lugta midig, taas oo la filayo inay ka fogeyso garoonka inta badan xilli ciyaareedka caadiga ah ee NFL, halka A.J. Brown uu dhaawac muruq ah dartiis toddobaadyo maqnaan doono.

items.title: Taageere Liverpool oo maxkamaddu ka fasaxday eedda aflagaadada cunsuriyadeed ee Antoine Semenyo
items.summary: Maxkamad ku taal magaalada Liverpool ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in aanu dembi galin nin taageere u ah Liverpool oo lagu eedeeyay inuu cunsuriyad ku aflagaadeeyay Antoine Semenyo, kaddib markii ciyaaryahanku uu ka noqday taageeridda dacwadda.
items.imageAlt: Antoine Semenyo, sawir hore

items.title: Pochettino oo ballanqaaday kubbad geesinimo leh shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay Manchester United

items.imageAlt: Liverpool Anfield, sawir hore

items.title: Pascal Groß oo heshiis cusub oo ilaa 2028 ah u saxiixay Brighton
items.summary: Kooxda Brighton & Hove Albion ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday in khadka dhexe ee reer Jarmal Pascal Groß, oo 35 jir ah, uu saxiixay heshiis cusub oo kooxda kula sii joogayo ilaa 2028.
items.imageAlt: Pascal Groß, sawir hore

items.title: NFL: Indianapolis Colts oo sii daayay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson oo noqonaya bilaabaha
items.summary: Kooxda Indianapolis Colts ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay sii daysay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, maalin kaddib guuldarradii 26-3 ee ay ka soo gaartay Houston Texans, waxayna Anthony Richardson u magacawday bilaabaha cusub.
items.imageAlt: Daniel Jones, sawir hore

items.title: Chelsea oo ganaax £150,000 ah lagu riday heeso takoor diimeed ah oo taageerayaasheedu ku qaadeen ciyaar FA Cup

items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stamford Bridge ee kooxda Chelsea, sawir hore

items.title: NFL: Puka Nacua oo qalliin jilibka loogu sameeyay, Rams-na bilooyin ayuu ka maqnaan doonaa

items.imageAlt: Sean McVay, sawir hore (2014)

items.title: Real Sociedad oo xaqiijisay in Yangel Herrera uu dhaawac murqo ka soo gaaray xulka Venezuela
items.summary: Real Sociedad ayaa Jimcihii shaacisay in khadka dhexe Yangel Herrera uu dhaawac murqo ah ka soo gaaray lugtiisa bidix, kaddib kulan uu u ciyaaray xulka Venezuela, isla markaana uusan diyaar ahayn.

items.summary: Duqa magaalada New York Zohran Mamdani ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu seedda Achilles ka jaray kulan saaxiibtinimo oo kubadda cagta ah oo uu Khamiistii ciyaaray, wuxuuna ku yimid shir jaraa'id isagoo ku tiirsan ulo.

items.title: Omar Berrada: Qaar ka mid ah dhaleeceynta taageerayaasha Man United waxay dhaafeen xadka

items.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz oo aan weli go'aamin inuu ka qeybgalo Davis Cup-ka

items.imageAlt: Garoonka Celtic Park ee kooxda Celtic, Glasgow (sawir hore)

items.title: Iraola: Duubista tababarka kooxaha ee diyaaradaha drone-ka waa in sharci darro laga dhigaa

items.title: Tanzania: Madaxweyne Samia oo sheegtay in dhawaan la dhisayo guddi dib-u-heshiisiin qaran, dastuur cusubna la qorayo

items.imageAlt: Garoonka Kasarani ee Nairobi ka hor ciyaar, sawir hore (ma aha garoonka Talanta)

items.summary: FC Barcelona ayaa Jimcihii si rasmi ah u kordhisay heshiiska ciyaartoyga da'da yar Xavi Espart, kaas oo hadda kooxda la joogaya ilaa 2030.

items.imageAlt: Ousmane Dembélé, sawir hore (France iyo Spain, July 2026)

items.imageAlt: Tonda Eckert, tababaraha Southampton, sawir hore

items.title: Ruushka oo ku hanjabay jawaab kadib markii dowladda Estonia ay si rasmi ah u ansixisay xiridda xuduudda

items.title: Jules Koundé oo ku soo laabtay tababarka Barcelona kahor kulanka Villarreal

items.imageAlt: Jules Koundé, sawir hore

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Yurub oo Brussels shir heer sare ah kaga yeeshay qorshaha kala-guurka amniga

items.title: Kenya oo bilowday qodista ceelasha shidaalka ee Turkana, shidaalka ugu horreeyana waxaa la filayaa 1 December
items.summary: Kenya ayaa bilowday qodista ceelasha shidaalka ceeriin ee gobolka hoose ee South Lokichar ee degmada Turkana, kadib markii si rasmi ah loo bilaabay qodista ceelka Amosing 1 ee ay maamusho shirkadda Gulf Energy.
items.imageAlt: Shaqaale isu diyaarinaya hawl rig oo mashruuc shidaal ah oo ku taal Lokichar, Turkana (sawir hore, 2014)

items.title: Nations League: France iyo Spain oo isku beegmay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka, England-na waxay la ciyaari doontaa Norway

items.title: Thibaut Courtois oo heshiiskiisa Real Madrid u kordhiyay ilaa 2028
items.summary: Real Madrid ayaa Jimcaha si rasmi ah u shaacisay in goolhayaha reer Belgium Thibaut Courtois, 34 jir, uu heshiiskiisa sannad kale u kordhiyay, isagoo kooxda la sii joogi doona ilaa 30 June 2028.
items.imageAlt: Thibaut Courtois, sawir hore (2014)

items.title: Finland oo shaqada ka eryday tababaraha xulka qaranka Jacob Friis
items.summary: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Finland ayaa Jimcaha shaqada ka eryay tababaraha xulka qaranka, Jacob Friis oo u dhashay Denmark, kadib markii Finland ay ku fashilantay inay u dalacsiiso heerka B ee Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Taallooyinka saldhigga tareenka Helsinki oo loo xiray dharka xulka Finland intii uu socday Koobka Yurub (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Midowga Yurub iyo Britain oo heshiis dib-u-habeyn xiriir ah ku gaaray shir Brussels lagu qabtay

items.title: Mourinho: Real Madrid way jeceshahay Vinícius, laakiin ciyaartoy mudnaan gaar ah leh ma jiro

items.title: Weeraryahanka Dortmund Samuele Inacio oo dhaawac jilibka ah dartiis bilooyin maqnaan doona
items.summary: Borussia Dortmund ayaa bilooyin waayi doonta weeraryahankeeda da'da yar Samuele Inacio, kadib markii baaritaanno ay muujiyeen inuu meniscus-ka jilibka kaga dhaawacmay kulan uu u ciyaarayay xulka Italy ee da'da ka yar 21.

items.title: Dani Ceballos oo ka maqnaan doona kulanka derby-ga Seville ee Betis iyo Sevilla

items.title: Arteta: Bukayo Saka laga yaabo inuusan soo laaban kahor Kirismaska, Zubimendi-na waa dhaawac

items.title: Poland oo sheegtay in gantaal Ruush ah uu ku dhacay koonfur-bari dalkeeda, cidna wax uma gaarin

items.title: ATP oo ansixisay isbeddello lacageed oo abaalmarinta ciyaartoyda tennis-ka ka dhigaya in ka badan 350 milyan oo doollar
items.summary: Ururka Ciyaartoyda Tennis-ka Xirfadleyda ah (ATP) ayaa ansixiyay isbeddello waaweyn oo dhaqaale, kuwaas oo abaalmarinta guud ee ciyaartoyda ka qaadaya 270 milyan oo doollar sannadkan una gaarsiinaya in ka badan 350 milyan oo doollar 2028.
items.imageAlt: Kulan ka dhacay tartanka ATP Finals ee Turin, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: Ruushka oo diiday fikradda ah in Ukraine la siiyo xubinnimo qayb ahaaneed oo NATO ah
items.summary: Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka, Sergei Ryabkov, ayaa Jimcaha sheegay in Moscow aysan aqbali karin nooc kasta oo xubinnimo qayb ahaaneed ah oo NATO ah oo Ukraine la siiyo, isagoo ka jawaabayay hadallo uu sheegay ergayga Mareykanka Jared Kushner.
items.imageAlt: Sergei Ryabkov, ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka, oo kulan ku leh Vienna, sawir hore (2020)

items.title: Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid): Baaqiisa Midnimada Qaran iyo Isku-duubnida oo Soo Jiidanaya Dareenka Siyaasadda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, musharrax Madaxweyne, Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid), ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay si weyn uga dhex muuqday hadal-haynta siyaasadeed ee dalka, kaddib markii uu muujiyey mowqif ku aaddan muhiimadda midnimada qaranka, wadajirka bulshada Soomaaliyeed iyo ilaalinta dowladnimada.
items.imageAlt: Cabdi Faarax Shirdoon (Saacid), musharrax Madaxweyne, oo ka hor taagan calanka Soomaaliya

items.title: Inter: Lautaro Martínez oo diyaar u ah kulanka Atalanta kadib 40 maalmood oo dhaawac ah
items.summary: Kabtanka Inter Milan Lautaro Martínez ayaa diyaar u ah inuu dib ugu soo laabto kooxda kadib 40 maalmood oo uu dhaawac ku maqnaa, xilli tababare Cristian Chivu uu hadda heysto ikhtiyaarro badan ka hor kulanka Atalanta.
items.imageAlt: Lautaro Martínez, sawir hore (Argentina iyo Spain, July 2026)

items.title: Federico Valverde oo la sheegay inuu heshiis cusub oo ilaa 2031 ah la gaaray Real Madrid
items.summary: Khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid Federico Valverde, 28 jir, ayaa la sheegay inuu heshiis ku gaaray in heshiiskiisa kooxda la kordhiyo ilaa 2031, sida ay sheegayaan warbixinno ka soo baxay Spain iyo Mareykan; kooxdu weli si rasmi ah uma aysan shaacin.
items.imageAlt: Federico Valverde oo la jira xulka Uruguay, sawir hore (2017)

items.title: Boqolaal qof oo Muqdisho isugu soo baxay taageero go'aanka lagu eryay safiirka Imaaraadka
items.summary: Boqolaal muwaadiniin ah ayaa Khamiistii dibadbax ku sameeyay waddooyinka Muqdisho, iyagoo taageeraya go'aanka dowladda federaalka ee ah in safiirka Imaaraadka Carabta uu dalka ka baxo.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, sawir hore

items.title: Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka oo cambaareeyay hadallada mas'uuliyiinta Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan Imaaraadka
items.summary: Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka (GCC), Jaasim Maxamed Al-Budaiwi, ayaa bayaan uu soo saaray 19 November ku cambaareeyay hadallada mas'uuliyiinta Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo olole warbaahineed oo uu sheegay in lagu beegsanayo Imaaraadka Carabta.
items.imageAlt: Jaasim Maxamed Al-Budaiwi, Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka, sawir hore

items.title: WHO oo sheegtay in Ebola-da Congo ay weli tahay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg caalami ah
items.summary: Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO) ayaa go'aamiyay in cudurka Ebola ee ka dillaacay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo uu weli yahay xaalad caafimaad oo degdeg ah oo caalami ah, iyadoo infekshannada iyo dhimashadu ay sii kordhayaan.
items.imageAlt: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Agaasimaha Guud ee WHO, sawir hore (2018)

items.title: Ergeyada Mareykanka oo la sheegay inay soo jeediyeen in Ukraine NATO ku biirto haddii ay Donbas ka tanaasusho
items.summary: Ergeyada Mareykanka Jared Kushner iyo Steve Witkoff ayaa la sheegay inay wada-hadallo xiran ku soo jeediyeen in Ukraine la siiyo xubinnimada NATO haddii ay Ruushka u dhaafto qaybta ka hartay gobolka Donbas.
items.imageAlt: Jared Kushner, ergeyga Mareykanka, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: NBA: Damian Lillard oo 33 dhibcood dhaliyay, Portland-na garaacday Bucks oo 12 kulan oo xiriir ah laga badiyay
items.summary: Damian Lillard ayaa xilli ciyaareedkan dhibcihii ugu badnaa, 33 dhibcood, ku dhaliyay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Milwaukee tan iyo markii Bucks ay sii daysay, isagoo Portland Trail Blazers u horseeday guul.
items.imageAlt: Damian Lillard, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: MLS: Orlando City oo 3-1 looga adkaaday Cincinnati, xilli ciyaareedkii Griezmann oo dhammaaday
items.summary: Kooxda Orlando City ee Antoine Griezmann ayaa Khamiistii 3-1 looga adkaaday FC Cincinnati kulan isreebreeb ah oo lagu kala saarayay kooxaha gelaya wareegga play-off-ka MLS, taasoo soo afjartay xilli ciyaareedka xiddigga reer Faransiiska.
items.imageAlt: Antoine Griezmann oo u ciyaaraya Orlando City, sawir hore (August 2026)

items.title: Wembanyama oo sheegay in finan farta ka soo baxay uu ka joojiyay dunk-ka, qaab cusub oo tuuris ahna la yimid
items.summary: Xiddigga San Antonio Spurs Victor Wembanyama ayaa kulankii ay Khamiistii ka adkaadeen Los Angeles Clippers ka tagay fursad dunk ah oo bannaan, isagoo kubbadda si tartiib ah dusha ka saaray giraanta, kadibna sheegay in sababtu ay tahay finan farta ka soo baxay.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama oo u ciyaaraya San Antonio Spurs, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Formula 1 oo ku dhow heshiis lagu soo celinayo matoorada V8 laga bilaabo 2030
items.summary: Madaxda Formula 1 iyo shirkadaha matoorada samaysa ayaa la sheegay inay mabda' ahaan isku raaceen in matoorada V8 turbo hybrid ah ay bedelaan matoorada hadda la isticmaalo sannadka 2030.
items.imageAlt: Zak Brown, maamulaha guud ee McLaren, sawir hore (2025)

items.title: Golaha Siyaasiyiinta Puntland oo ka soo horjeestay mamnuucidda shirarka mucaaradka ee Garoowe
items.summary: Golaha Siyaasiyiinta iyo Aqoonyahanka Puntland ayaa cambaareeyay warqad ka soo baxday guddoomiyaha gobolka Nugaal oo lagu mamnuucay shirarka siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka magaalada Garoowe.
items.imageAlt: Madaxtooyada Puntland ee magaalada Garoowe, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: Napoli: Goolhaye Alex Meret oo la sheegay inuu laba bilood garoonka ka maqnaan doono
items.summary: Goolhayaha Napoli Alex Meret, oo Khamiistii tababarka ka jabay lafta shanaad ee qaybta hoose ee laf-dhabarta, ayaa warbixinnada Talyaaniga sheegayaan inuu ku dhowaad laba bilood maqnaan doono.
items.imageAlt: Goolhaye Alex Meret oo u ciyaaraya Napoli, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Dagaalka Iran oo Mareykanka ku kacay 48.3 bilyan oo doollar, Senate-ka oo mar kale diiday ka saarista ciidamada
items.summary: Musharrax ka tirsan Pentagon-ka ayaa Senate-ka Mareykanka u sheegay in howlgalka milatari ee ka dhanka ah Iran uu ilaa dabayaaqadii February ku kacay qiyaastii 48.3 bilyan oo doollar, iyadoo Senate-ku 48-51 ku diiday qaraar lagu dalbanayay ka saarista ciidamada.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Senate-ka Mareykanka, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo iibiyay shatiyadii ugu horreeyay ee macdan qodista badda qoto dheer, maalmo kadib go'aan maxkamadeed
items.summary: Maamulka Trump ayaa Khamiistii iibiyay shatiyadii ugu horreeyay taariikhda Mareykanka ee macdan qodista sagxadda badda qoto dheer, kuwaas oo ku yaal biyaha ka baxsan American Samoa, maalmo kadib markii maxkamad federaal ah ay sheegtay in habka loo oggolaaday uu sharci darro ahaa.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Pago Pago ee American Samoa, sawir hore

items.title: Formula 1: George Russell oo ugu dheereeyay tababarka labaad ee Las Vegas Grand Prix oo roob saameeyay
items.summary: Darawalka Mercedes George Russell ayaa ugu waqti fiicnaa tababarka labaad ee Las Vegas Grand Prix, kaas oo lagu ciyaaray waddo qoyan oo si tartiib ah u qallalaysay roob kadib.
items.imageAlt: George Russell oo wata baabuurka Mercedes, sawir hore (China 2026)

items.title: Kyiv: Laba buundo oo ku waxyeelloobay weerar gantaal oo Ruushku qaaday, sida uu sheegay duqa magaalada
items.summary: Duqa magaalada Kyiv Vitali Klitschko ayaa sheegay in laba buundo oo caasimadda Ukraine ku yaal ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarro Ruushku qaaday, kadib weerar gantaallo ballistic ah oo lagu beegsaday magaalada.
items.imageAlt: Duqa magaalada Kyiv Vitali Klitschko, sawir hore (2014)

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Golaha Samatabixinta Qaranka u sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay wada-hadal
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa farriin u diray Golaha Samatabixinta Qaranka oo uu ku muujiyay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu la fariisto mucaaradka, kulankana lagu qabto goob ay iyagu ku kalsoon yihiin.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo la hadlaya saxaafadda, sawir hore

items.title: Wasiirrada maaliyadda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada oo shir 48 saac ah ku soo gabagabeeyay Muqdisho
items.summary: Shirka 25-aad ee Madasha Wasiirrada Maaliyadda ee dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Gobolka Banaadir ayaa Muqdisho lagu soo gabagabeeyay, iyadoo laga soo saaray warmurtiyeed ku saabsan dib-u-habeynta nidaamka maaliyadda.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Muqdisho iyo dekeddeeda, sawir hore

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse: Soomaaliya kama sii tiirsana beesha caalamka, Imaaraadkana waa mas'uul
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa Jimcaha ka sheegay Muqdisho in dowladdu ay ka gudubtay ku tiirsanaanta beesha caalamka, isagoo dhanka kale Imaaraadka Carabta ku eedeeyay inuu hurinayo dagaallada Koonfur Galbeed.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre oo ka qeyb galaya munaasabad Muqdisho, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: NBA: San Antonio Spurs oo 102-99 ku garaacay Clippers, Wembanyama oo kulankiisii 7-aad ee 30 dhibcood gaaray
items.summary: San Antonio Spurs ayaa 102-99 kaga adkaaday Los Angeles Clippers, iyagoo dib ugu soo laabtay guusha laba maalmood kadib markii ay soo dhammaatay taxanihii 12 guulood ee isku xigay.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama, xiddiga San Antonio Spurs, sawir hore

items.title: NFL: Houston Texans oo 26-3 ku garaacay Indianapolis Colts, CJ Stroud oo dhaliyay saddex touchdown
items.summary: Houston Texans ayaa Khamiistii 26-3 kaga adkaaday Indianapolis Colts kulankii Thursday Night Football ee NFL, taasoo noqotay guushii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan ka gaaraan garoonkooda.
items.imageAlt: CJ Stroud, weeraryahanka Houston Texans, sawir hore

items.title: Kenya: Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka oo ka dhex baxay kulan ay la lahaayeen guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC
items.summary: Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka Kenya ayaa Nairobi uga dhex baxay kulan wadatashi ah oo ay la lahaayeen guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inaan laga qeyb gelin diyaargarowga doorashada 2027.
items.imageAlt: Kalonzo Musyoka, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper, sawir hore

items.title: NHL: Tampa Bay Lightning oo 3-1 ku garaacay Oilers, taxanihii dhibcaha ee Connor McDavid oo ku joogsaday 23 kulan
items.summary: Taxanihii Connor McDavid ee dhibcaha ayaa ku joogsaday 23 kulan kadib markii Edmonton Oilers ay 3-1 uga dhaceen Tampa Bay Lightning kulan ka tirsan horyaalka NHL.
items.imageAlt: Connor McDavid, kabtanka Edmonton Oilers, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Suuqyada saamiyada Aasiya oo si weyn hoos ugu dhacay kadib diiwaangelinta Anthropic
items.summary: Suuqyada saamiyada Japan, Kuuriyada Koonfureed, Taiwan iyo Hong Kong ayaa Jimcaha, 20 November, si weyn hoos ugu dhacay, iyadoo maalgashadayaashu ay ka walaacsan yihiin in maalgashiga sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) uu noqday mid aan sii socon karin.
items.imageAlt: Suuqa saamiyada Tokyo, sawir hore

items.title: Arda Güler iyo Kenan Yıldız oo ku jira musharaxiinta Globe Soccer Awards 2026
items.summary: Ciyaartoyda reer Turkiga Arda Güler oo ka ciyaara Real Madrid iyo Kenan Yıldız oo ka ciyaara Juventus ayaa lagu daray 14-ka musharax ee abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka soo koraya ee Globe Soccer Awards 2026.
items.imageAlt: Arda Güler oo u ciyaaraya xulka Turkiga, sawir hore

items.title: Australia oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Argentina furitaanka Koobka Adduunka U-17
items.summary: Xulka da'da ka yar 17 sano ee Australia ayaa 19 November dalka Qatar 2-0 kaga adkaaday Argentina, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee Group C ee Koobka Adduunka U-17.
items.imageAlt: Akol Akon oo dabaaldegaya kulan ay Sydney FC ciyaartay, sawir hore

items.title: MLB: Chicago White Sox oo Luis Castillo iyo Davis Martin u wareejiyay Colorado Rockies
items.summary: Kooxda baseball-ka ee Chicago White Sox ayaa ganacsi ay la gashay Colorado Rockies ku siisay tuurayaasha Luis Castillo iyo Davis Martin, iyagoo beddelkooda helay Sean Sullivan iyo ciyaaryahanka da'da yar Douglas Veliz.
items.imageAlt: Tuuraha Luis Castillo, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Aqalka Cad oo beddelaya agaasimaha amniga internetka xilli dalka uu la daalaa dhacayo go'itaanno teknoolajiyadeed
items.summary: Sean Cairncross, agaasimaha qaranka ee amniga internetka ee Aqalka Cad, ayaa xilkiisa ka tagaya, waxaana beddeli doonta Kirsten Davies, oo ah afhayeen ka tirsan Pentagon-ka, sida ay sheegeen warbaahinno badan oo Mareykan ah 19 November.
items.imageAlt: Aqalka Cad ee Washington, sawir hore

items.title: Buffalo Bills oo go'aansatay in lambarka 83 ee Andre Reed la hawlgabo xilliga 2027
items.summary: Kooxda NFL ee Buffalo Bills ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday in lambarka 83 ee Andre Reed, xiddigii hore ee kooxda, si rasmi ah loo hawlgabi doono inta lagu jiro xilliga 2027.
items.imageAlt: Andre Reed, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2015

items.title: Afar meyd oo laga soo saaray badda kadib markii doon tahriib ay ku rogmatay xeebta Senegal
items.summary: Afar meyd ayaa laga soo saaray badda kadib markii doon ay saarnaayeen muhaajiriin ay Arbacadii, 18 November, ku rogmatay xeebta Senegal meel u dhow magaalada Yenne oo ka koonfureysa Dakar.
items.imageAlt: Doomo kalluumeysi oo dhinaca xeebta Senegal yaal, sawir hore

items.title: Zverev oo garaacay Fils, kuna dhammaystay wareegga kooxaha ATP Finals isagoon set laga badin
items.summary: Alexander Zverev ayaa 19 November magaalada Turin 6-4, 7-6 (8-6) kaga adkaaday Arthur Fils, wuxuuna kaalinta koowaad kaga gudbay kooxdiisa ATP Finals isagoon hal set laga badin.
items.imageAlt: Alexander Zverev oo tababar ku jira, sawir hore

items.title: Horyaalka haweenka Mareykanka NWSL oo ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo lagu horumarinayo ciyaartoyda da'da yar
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha horyaalka kubadda cagta haweenka Mareykanka (NWSL), Jessica Berman, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay xeer cusub oo kooxaha ku dhiirri-gelinaya inay maalgashadaan ciyaartoyda da'da yar.
items.imageAlt: Jessica Berman, guddoomiyaha NWSL, sawir hore

items.title: Tom Sykes oo 10-9 kaga adkaaday Luke Humphries Grand Slam of Darts
items.summary: Tom Sykes oo aan ka mid ahayn ciyaartoyda la kala horreysiiyay ayaa 19 November magaalada Wolverhampton 10-9 kaga adkaaday Luke Humphries, wareegga labaad ee Grand Slam of Darts.
items.imageAlt: Luke Humphries oo booqasho ku jooga Downing Street 2024, sawir hore

items.title: Bayern München oo 4-0 kaga adkaatay Austria Wien, kuna dhowaatay wareegga xiga
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka ee Bayern München ayaa 19 November magaalada Vienna 4-0 kaga adkaatay Austria Wien, waxayna u dallacday kaalinta saddexaad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League.
items.imageAlt: Klara Bühl oo tuuraysa kubad gees, sawir hore

items.title: Trump oo cafis buuxa siiyay Pete Rose, xiddigii baseball-ka ee dhintay
items.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay inuu cafis buuxa siiyay Pete Rose, xiddigii hore ee baseball-ka Mareykanka, in ka badan laba sano kaddib geeridiisii.
items.imageAlt: Pete Rose oo xirnaa funaanadda Cincinnati Reds, sawir hore

items.title: Roma oo daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay 3-2 kaga adkaatay Benfica, rajada wareegga xigana sii haysata
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka ee Roma ayaa 19 November garoonka Estádio da Luz ee Lisbon 3-2 kaga adkaatay Benfica, iyadoo goolka guusha ay dhalisay Sofia Jahnukainen waqtigii dheeraadka ahaa.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Estádio da Luz ee Lisbon, sawir hore

items.title: OL Lyonnes oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Arsenal, una gudubtay wareegga siddeedda Champions League-ka haweenka
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka ee OL Lyonnes ayaa 19 November garoonka Meadow Park 2-0 kaga adkaatay Arsenal, waxayna si toos ah ugu gudubtay wareegga siddeedda ee UEFA Women's Champions League iyadoo hal kulan uu weli dhiman yahay.
items.imageAlt: Melchie Dumornay oo ka tirsan OL Lyonnes, sawir hore

items.title: Barcelona oo 6-0 ku garaacday Servette, Clàudia Pina oo saddex gool dhalisay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka ee Barcelona ayaa 19 November 6-0 ku garaacday Servette ee Switzerland, waxayna u gudubtay wareegga siddeedda ee UEFA Women's Champions League, iyadoo dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka wareegga horyaalka.
items.imageAlt: Clàudia Pina oo tuuraysa kubad gees, sawir hore

items.title: NFL oo saddex kulan ka joojisay Puka Nacua oo ka tirsan Los Angeles Rams
items.summary: Horyaalka kubadda cagta Mareykanka (NFL) ayaa 19 November saddex kulan ka joojiyay Puka Nacua, ciyaaryahanka qaabka wide receiver ee kooxda Los Angeles Rams, kaddib markii lagu helay inuu jebiyay xeerka anshaxa shakhsiga ah ee horyaalka.
items.imageAlt: Puka Nacua, sawir hore

items.title: Haiti: Booliska oo sheegay in 34 xubnood oo looga shakisan yahay kooxaha hubaysan lagu dilay howlgal Martissant
items.summary: Booliska Qaranka Haiti ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 34 qof oo looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsan yihiin kooxaha burcadda hubaysan lagu dilay howlgal 19 November lagu qaaday xaafadda Martissant ee caasimadda Port-au-Prince.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Port-au-Prince oo cirka laga sawiray, sawir hore

items.title: FIA oo shaqaalaysiinaysa garsoorayaal joogto ah oo Formula 1 laga bilaabo 2027
items.summary: Hay'adda maamusha Formula 1, FIA, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqday inay markii ugu horreysay taariikhda isboortiga u magacaabi doonto garsoorayaal tartan (race stewards) oo waqti-buuxa ah, laga bilaabo xilli ciyaareedka 2027.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta FIA ee Place de la Concorde, Paris, sawir hore

items.title: Filim ay Lyon sameysay oo muujiyay hadal adag oo Tolisso u jeediyay Paulo Fonseca markii uu kooxda ka tagay
items.summary: Filim dokumentari ah oo ay diyaarisay kooxda Olympique Lyonnais ayaa muujiyay kabtanka Corentin Tolisso oo si adag uga hadlaya go'aanka tababare Paulo Fonseca ee ah inuu kooxda ka tago.
items.imageAlt: Corentin Tolisso oo garoonka ku jira, sawir hore

items.title: Bayern oo ka adkaatay Baskonia, kuna gaartay guushii ugu horreysay ee guriga ee EuroLeague xilligan
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee FC Bayern ayaa 19 November garoonka SAP Garden ee Munich kaga adkaatay Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz, taasoo ah guushii ugu horreysay ee ay guriga ka gaarto EuroLeague xilligan.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka SAP Garden ee Munich, sawir hore

items.title: Troyes oo wada-hadal horumarsan la gashay Florian Maurice si uu u noqdo agaasimaha isboortiga
items.summary: Kooxda Troyes ee Ligue 1 ayaa la sheegay inay wada-hadal horumarsan la gashay Florian Maurice, agaasimihii hore ee isboortiga Rennes iyo Nice, si uu u buuxiyo jagada agaasimaha isboortiga.
items.imageAlt: Florian Maurice xilligii uu ciyaaryahan ka ahaa PSG, sawir hore

items.title: Neymar oo caayay taageerayaasha Coritiba kadib guushii Santos ee 1-0
items.summary: Xiddigga Brazil Neymar ayaa caayo culus u jeediyay taageerayaasha kooxda Coritiba kadib markii Santos ay 1-0 kaga adkaatay garoonka Couto Pereira tartanka horyaalka Brazil.
items.imageAlt: Neymar oo u dabaaldegaya gool uu Santos u dhaliyay, sawir hore (2025)

items.title: Imaaraadka oo sheegay inuu horay u xiray safaaraddiisa Muqdisho bishii January
items.summary: Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa war rasmi ah kaga jawaabtay go'aannada Soomaaliya ee 19 November, iyadoo sheegtay inay horay u xirtay safaaraddeedii Muqdisho, diblomaasiyiinteediina ay dalka kala baxday bishii January 2026.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Abu Dhabi, caasimadda Imaaraadka, sawir hore

items.title: Senate-ka Mareykanka oo diiday xaddidaadda awoodda dagaalka Trump ee Iran
items.summary: Golaha Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa Khamiistii 19 November 51 cod iyo 48 ku diiday qaraar ku qasbi lahaa Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu joojiyo dagaalka Iran ama oggolaansho ka helo Congress-ka si uu u sii wado.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Golaha Senate-ka Mareykanka, sawir hore

items.title: Thomas Frank oo shirkiisii ugu horreeyay ee Crystal Palace ku sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay soo laabashadiisa
items.summary: Tababaraha cusub ee Crystal Palace Thomas Frank ayaa shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay ku sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay inuu dib ugu soo laabto kubbadda cagta, kadib bilo uu shaqo la'aan ahaa tan iyo markii Tottenham ka eriday.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Selhurst Park ee Crystal Palace, sawir hore

items.title: Apollo iyo mulkiilayaasha Man City oo hakiyay qorshe amaah ah oo $2 bilyan ah

items.summary: Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay diyaar u tahay inay tallaabo sharci ah qaaddo haddii ay hesho caddeyn muujinaysa in kooxo kale ay la xiriireen ciyaaryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel intii uu heshiiska kula jiray, sida ay wariyeen warbaahinta Ingiriiska iyo Spain.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Old Trafford ee Manchester United

items.title: Juventus Haweenka oo 2-0 ku garaacday OH Leuven, una gudubtay wareegga ka-saarista Champions League
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Juventus ayaa Arbacadii magaalada Biella 2-0 kaga adkaatay OH Leuven ee Belgium ciyaartii 5aad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League, waxayna xaqiijisay inay u gudubto wareegga ka-saarista iyadoo ay ka harsan tahay hal ciyaar.

items.title: Mamadou Coulibaly oo hal kulan laga mamnuucay kaddib dabaaldeggiisii muranka dhaliyay
items.summary: Guddiga anshaxa ee Ligue de Football Professionnel (LFP) ayaa Arbacadii hal kulan oo toos ah iyo laba kulan oo shuruud ah ku ganaaxay ciyaaryahanka Monaco Mamadou Coulibaly, kaddib dabaaldeg uu sameeyay markii uu gool ka dhaliyay Le Mans.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Stade Louis II ee Monaco

items.title: Rob Manfred: milkiilayaasha MLB ma aqbali doonaan heshiis aan lahayn xad mushahar
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha horyaalka baseball-ka Mareykanka (MLB) Rob Manfred ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in milkiilayaasha kooxaha aysan ka tanaasuli doonin dalabkooda ah in heshiiska shaqada ee cusub uu yeesho xad sare iyo xad hoose oo mushaharka ah, taas oo horyaalka u dhaweynaysa xannibaad shaqo.
items.imageAlt: Rob Manfred, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Wadaad ku nool Florida oo lagu helay dembiyo la xiriira dilkii Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse
items.summary: Xeerbeegti federaal ah oo ku sugan Miami ayaa Arbacadii dembi ku heshay wadaadka Christian Emmanuel Sanon, oo haysta dhalashada Haiti iyo Mareykanka, dhammaan sideed eedeyn oo ay ka mid tahay shirqool lagu dilayay Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynihii Haiti Jovenel Moïse, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Chelsea oo gool dambe 1-0 kaga adkaatay PSG, kuna gashay hoggaanka Champions League-ka Haweenka
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Chelsea ayaa Arbacadii 1-0 kaga adkaatay Paris Saint-Germain wareegga horyaalka ee UEFA Women's Champions League, kaddib gool ay daqiiqadii 88 dhalisay daafaca Veerle Buurman.
items.imageAlt: Veerle Buurman, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2025

items.title: Copa del Rey: Mallorca oo waqti dheeraad ah ku dhaaftay Alcoyano, Tenerife-na 5-2 ku garaacday Badajoz
items.summary: Mallorca ayaa Arbacadii 3-1 kaga adkaatay Alcoyano kaddib waqti dheeraad ah, halka Tenerife ay 5-2 kaga badisay Badajoz, iyagoo labaduba u gudbay wareegga xiga ee Copa del Rey.
items.imageAlt: Sawir hore oo laga qaaday garoonka Estadi Mallorca Son Moix

items.title: Mykhailo Mudryk oo sheegay in maamulka xulka Ukraine uu mas'uul ka yahay baaritaankii doping-ka ee uu ku dhacay
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Tottenham ee amaahda kaga jira Chelsea, Mykhailo Mudryk, ayaa markii ugu horreysay si furan uga hadlay ganaaxiisii doping-ka, isagoo eedda saaray maamulka xulka qaranka Ukraine.
items.imageAlt: Mykhailo Mudryk, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2023

items.title: Daafaca England Jess Carter oo ku biirtay Bay FC kaddib markii ay ka tagtay Gotham FC
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanadda khadka daafaca ee xulka England Jess Carter ayaa u wareegtay kooxda Bay FC ee horyaalka NWSL, iyadoo heshiis la saxiixatay ilaa 2028 kaddib markii ay si xor ah uga tagtay Gotham FC.
items.imageAlt: Jess Carter, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2022

items.title: Strasbourg oo si rasmi ah u magacaabtay Vítor Matos, Hugo Oliveira-na wuu tagay
items.summary: Kooxda Strasbourg ee Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqday in Vítor Matos oo 38 jir ah, kana yimid Swansea City, uu noqday tababarahooda cusub, kaddib markii ay kala tageen Hugo Oliveira.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stade de la Meinau ee Strasbourg, sawir hore

items.title: Sonny Gray oo ku laabtay Minnesota Twins, heshiis laba sano ah oo lagu sheegay 55 milyan oo dollar
items.summary: Kooxda baseball-ka Minnesota Twins ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay dib u qaadatay tuuraha waayo-aragga ah Sonny Gray, iyadoo heshiiska lagu sheegay laba sano iyo 55 milyan oo dollar.
items.imageAlt: Sonny Gray, sawir hore oo laga qaaday 2015

items.title: Pew: Islaamku wuxuu 2035 ka gudbi doonaa Masiixiyadda, noqonna doonaa diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka
items.summary: Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay xarunta cilmi-baarista Pew Research Center ayaa saadaalisay in Islaamku uu sannadka 2035 ka gudbi doono Masiixiyadda, uuna noqon doono diinta ugu dadka badan adduunka.
items.imageAlt: Dad ka soo baxaya masjid kaddib salaadda Jimcaha, Kano, Nigeria, sawir hore

items.title: Valtteri Bottas oo kursigiisa Cadillac ku sii haynaya xilli ciyaareedka 2027
items.summary: Darawalka Finland u dhashay Valtteri Bottas ayaa sii wadi doona inuu u wado kooxda Mareykanka ee Cadillac xilli ciyaareedka 2027 ee Formula 1, kaddib muddo mustaqbalkiisa uu ahaa mid aan la hubin.
items.imageAlt: Valtteri Bottas, sawir hore oo 2024 la qaaday

items.title: McKennie oo sheegay inuu ku faraxsan yahay Juventus, hadalkiisa Man Utd-na si khaldan loo fahmay
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Juventus iyo xulka Mareykanka, Weston McKennie, ayaa sheegay in hadalladii uu dhowaan ka sheegay Manchester United si khaldan loo fahmay, isla markaana uu ku faraxsan yahay inuu sii joogo Juventus.
items.imageAlt: Weston McKennie, sawir hore oo 2019 la qaaday

items.title: Real Madrid oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter, Signe Bruun oo laba gool dhalisay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Real Madrid ayaa Arbacadii garoonka Alfredo Di Stéfano 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter Milan, kulan ka tirsan Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Signe Bruun ay daqiiqadihii ugu dambeeyay dhalisay laba gool.
items.imageAlt: Signe Bruun, sawir hore oo 2018 la qaaday

items.title: Manchester City oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Häcken, Hemp iyo Shaw oo dhaliyay
items.summary: Kooxda haweenka Manchester City ayaa Arbacadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay BK Häcken oo dalka Sweden ah, kulan ka tirsan wareegga horyaalka Champions League-ka haweenka, iyadoo Lauren Hemp iyo Khadija Shaw ay dhaliyeen goolasha.
items.imageAlt: Lauren Hemp, sawir hore

items.title: Leicester City oo joojisay heshiiska maalgeliyaha funaanadda BC Game
items.summary: Kooxda Leicester City ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay heshiis ku kala tageen shirkadda sharadka internetka ee BC Game, oo funaanaddooda ku qornayd tan iyo 2024, kaddib cabashooyin ka yimid taageerayaasha.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka King Power ee kooxda Leicester City, sawir hore

items.title: Rassie Erasmus oo la ganaaxay 6 kulan, kulanka Ireland-na toos ula daawan doona taageerayaasha
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, oo World Rugby ay 6 kulan ka mamnuucday hoggaaminta Springboks, ayaa qorsheynaya inuu kulanka Ireland ee Sabtida si toos ah internetka ugula daawado taageerayaasha.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kooxda Springboks oo yaal matxafka Springbok Experience Rugby, sawir hore

items.title: Darajada FIFA: Spain oo hoggaanka haysa, Morocco-na markii ugu horreysay 5-ta sare gashay
items.summary: Darajada cusub ee FIFA oo Arbacadii la shaaciyay ayaa Spain ku sii haysa kaalinta 1-aad, Argentina 2-aad iyo Faransiiska 3-aad, halka Morocco ay gashay 5-ta xul ee ugu sarreysa, kana sarreysay Brazil.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta FIFA ee Zurich, sawir hore

items.title: Emma Hayes oo ka mid ah kooxda raadinaysa tababaraha cusub ee xulka ragga Mareykanka
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka haweenka Mareykanka, Emma Hayes, ayaa sheegtay inay ku kalsoon tahay kooxda loo xilsaaray raadinta beddelka Mauricio Pochettino, kaas oo u ambabaxay Manchester United, iyadoo ay iyadu ka mid tahay kooxdaas.
items.imageAlt: Emma Hayes, sawir hore

items.title: Primož Roglič oo ku biiray kooxda baaskiilka NSN ee Andrés Iniesta
items.summary: Baaskiil-wadaha Slovenia u dhashay Primož Roglič oo 37 jir ah ayaa ka tagay Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe, wuxuuna heshiis hal sano ah la saxiixday kooxda NSN Cycling, oo uu milkiilayaasheeda ka mid yahay ciyaaryahankii hore ee Spain Andrés Iniesta.
items.imageAlt: Primož Roglič, sawir hore oo 2024 la qaaday

items.title: Sharciga offside-ka ee Wenger oo la filayo in la tuuro kaddib tijaabo Canada
items.summary: Sharciga cusub ee offside-ka oo uu soo jeediyay Arsène Wenger, laguna tijaabiyay horyaalka Canada tan iyo bishii April, ayaa la filayaa in aan la dhaqan gelin, iyadoo la soo xiganayo The New York Times.
items.imageAlt: Arsène Wenger, sawir hore oo 2019 la qaaday

items.title: SU’AALO CULUS OO KA DHASHAY KULANKA MUUNGAAB IYO DIBLOMAASIYIINTA IMAARAADKA EE NAIROBI!

items.title: Walter Samuel oo sagootiyay xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ka mid ahaa shaqaalaha Scaloni
items.summary: Difaacii hore ee Roma iyo Inter Walter Samuel ayaa si rasmi ah uga tagay shaqaalaha tababarka xulka Argentina kaddib siddeed sano oo uu ku garab shaqaynayay Lionel Scaloni, sida uu xulku ku shaaciyay baraha bulshada, una werisay Sky Sport Italia.

items.imageAlt: Michael Emenalo, sawir hore oo 2017 laga qaaday

items.summary: Goolhayaha reer Spain Antonio Adán, oo ay da'diisu tahay 39 sano, ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubadda cagta xirfadeed, kaddib xirfad uu ku guuleystay 11 koob.

items.imageAlt: Pep Guardiola, sawir hore

items.title: Dowladda Yemen oo sharci cusub ku magacawday Xuutiyiinta urur argagixiso ah

items.title: Antonio Conte: Goor uun xiriirkayga Juventus wuu dhammaystirmi doonaa
items.summary: Tababaraha reer Talyaani Antonio Conte, oo hadda aan koox lahayn, ayaa sheegay in maalin uun uu dib ugu laaban doono kursiga tababaraha Juventus, isagoo daaha ka qaaday in laba jeer uu ku dhowaaday inuu kooxda dib ugu soo laabto.

items.title: Dimuqraadiyiinta oo Hakeem Jeffries u magacaabay guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiilada Mareykanka
items.summary: Xildhibaannada Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Wakiilada Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii si rasmi ah u magacaabay Hakeem Jeffries inuu noqdo guddoomiyaha golaha, taasoo u xaaraysa inuu noqdo qofkii ugu horreeyay ee madow ah ee hoggaamiya golaha.

items.imageAlt: Sawir hore: Michael Olise oo u ciyaaraya xulka France

items.title: Riek Machar oo maxkamadda u sheegay in Salva Kiir uusan ka jawaabin codsigiisii dib u dhigista ciidamada Nasir
