items.imageAlt: Gaari Waymo ah oo aan darawal lahayn, sawir hore (San Francisco, 2025)

items.title: Cutter Gauthier oo noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay ee NHL ee hal bil gudaheed sameeya 4 hat-trick
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Anaheim Ducks, Cutter Gauthier, ayaa noqday ciyaartoygii ugu horreeyay taariikhda NHL ee sameeya 4 hat-trick hal bil oo kalandar ah, inkastoo Ducks ay 8-6 ku lumiyeen kulankii St. Louis Blues.
items.imageAlt: Cutter Gauthier oo ku jira tababar ay Anaheim Ducks sameeyeen 2024

items.title: Cricket Australia oo madal madaxbannaan u furtay ciyaartoyda fadeexadda sandpapergate
items.summary: Cricket Australia ayaa furtay madal madaxbannaan oo ciyaartoyda iyo shaqaalihii ku lug lahaa fadeexaddii xumeynta kubbadda ee 2018, ee loo yaqaan sandpapergate, ay ku sheegi karaan sida ay wax u dhaceen.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka cricket-ka ee Newlands ee magaalada Cape Town, sawir hore

items.title: Mary Peltola oo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Alaska, Dan Sullivan oo laga adkaaday
items.summary: Musharaxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Mary Peltola ayaa ka adkaatay Senator Dan Sullivan oo ka tirsan Xisbiga Jamhuuriga, iyadoo ku guuleysatay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee gobolka Alaska, kaas oo ahaa doorashadii ugu dambeysay ee Golaha Guurtida ee la go'aamiyo, sida ay saadaaliyeen warbaahinta Mareykanka.
items.imageAlt: Mary Peltola, sawir rasmi ah oo hore (2022)

items.title: Connor Bedard oo dhaawac la baxay, Blackhawks oo 6-3 ku garaacay Maple Leafs
items.summary: Xiddigga kooxda Chicago Blackhawks Connor Bedard ayaa Talaadadii dhaawac ku ah garoonka ka baxay xilli uu socday kulan ay kooxdiisu 6-3 kaga adkaatay Toronto Maple Leafs horyaalka NHL.
items.imageAlt: Connor Bedard, sawir hore (2023)

items.title: Nin Pakistani ah oo 27 sano iyo badh lagu xukumay qorshe lagu doonayay in lagu dilo siyaasiyiin Mareykan ah
items.summary: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal Brooklyn ayaa Talaadadii 330 bilood oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Asif Merchant, oo u dhashay Pakistan, kaddib markii lagu helay qorshe dil oo uu sheegay inuu ka dambeeyay Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran, Donald Trump-na uu ka mid ahaa bartilmaameedyada.
items.imageAlt: Maxkamadda federaalka ee Brooklyn, New York, sawir hore

items.title: Stojakovic oo 46 dhibcood dhaliyay, Illinois oo 99-78 ku garaacday Duke
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Illinois, oo kaalinta 10-aad ah, ayaa Talaadadii 99-78 kaga adkaatay Duke oo kaalinta 5-aad ah garoonkeeda Cameron Indoor Stadium, iyadoo Andrej Stojakovic uu dhaliyay 46 dhibcood.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Cameron Indoor Stadium ee Duke, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo 2-0 ku garaacay Haiti kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee Pochettino
items.summary: Xulka Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cincinnati 2-0 kaga adkaaday Haiti, isagoo isugeyn ahaan 8-0 ugu gudbay semi-finalka CONCACAF Nations League, kulankaas oo ahaa kii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Mauricio Pochettino.
items.imageAlt: Christian Pulisic oo u ciyaaraya xulka Mareykanka, sawir hore (March 2026)

items.title: Nin Irish ah oo New York lagu soo oogay burburinta diyaarad milatari oo Mareykan ah garoonka Shannon
items.summary: Golaha garsoorka ee magaalada New York ayaa dacwad ku soo oogay Daithi O'Corrain, oo 48 jir ah kana soo jeeda Ireland, kaddib markii xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanku ay ku eedeysay inuu faas ku burburiyay diyaarad milatari oo C-130 ah oo la dhigay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Shannon.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka diyaaradaha ee Shannon, Ireland, sawir hore

items.title: Nin 25 jir ah oo lagu soo oogay isku day dil kadib weerarkii darawalka Soomaaliga ah ee Minnesota
items.summary: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta degmada Hennepin ee gobolka Minnesota ayaa Talaadadii eedeymo isku day dil iyo afduub gaari ku soo oogay Samit Apurva Patel, oo 25 jir ah, kaddib weerar loo geystay Maxamed Yuusuf, darawal Uber oo Soomaali-Maraykan ah.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dowladda degmada Hennepin ee Minneapolis, sawir hore

items.title: Uruguay oo 5-0 ku garaacday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican, Valverde oo gool qurux badan dhaliyay
items.summary: Xulka Uruguay ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Maldonado 5-0 kaga adkaaday Jamhuuriyadda Dominican ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, taasoo ahayd guushii labaad ee tababare Diego Forlán laba kulan gudahood.
items.imageAlt: Federico Valverde oo u ciyaaraya Uruguay, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Golaha Nabadda oo uga digay Golaha Ammaanka in xabbad-joojinta Gaza ay khatar ugu jirto burbur
items.summary: Golaha Nabadda (Board of Peace) oo Mareykanku taageero ayaa Talaadadii warbixintiisii sannadeed ee ugu horreysay u gudbiyay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, isagoo uga digay in heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta Gaza ee 2025 uu burburi karo haddii aan tallaabooyin degdeg ah la qaadin.
items.imageAlt: Burburka magaalada Rafah ee Gaza markii xabbad-joojintii hore ay dhaqan gashay, sawir hore (January 2025)

items.title: Argentina oo 7-0 ku burburisay Costa Rica, guushii ugu horreysay kaddib fariisashada Messi
items.summary: Xulka Argentina ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Mario Alberto Kempes ee magaalada Córdoba 7-0 kaga adkaaday Costa Rica ciyaar saaxiibtinimo ah, iyadoo Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez iyo Franco Mastantuono ay mid kasta laba gool dhaliyeen.
items.imageAlt: Nico Paz oo u ciyaaraya Argentina, sawir hore (July 2026)

items.title: Houston Dash oo Seb Hines u magacaawday tababaraha cusub
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda cagta haweenka ee Houston Dash, oo ka ciyaarta horyaalka NWSL ee Mareykanka, ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday inay tababare cusub u magacawday Seb Hines, oo hore Orlando Pride ugu hoggaamiyay laba koob sannadkii 2024.
items.imageAlt: Seb Hines xilligii uu ciyaaryahan ahaa, sawir hore (2017)

items.title: Kuwait oo sheegtay weerarro drone ah, xiisadda Iran iyo Mareykanka oo sii kordhaysa
items.summary: Ciidamada Kuwait ayaa Talaadadii habeennimo sheegay in difaaca hawadu uu ka jawaabayo weerarro drone ah, saacado kaddib markii Mareykanku uu weeraray goob gantaallo oo ku taalla jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran.
items.imageAlt: Jasiiradda Qeshm oo laga sawiray hawada sare, sawir hore NASA

items.title: Humphries iyo Van Gerwen oo u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ee Grand Slam of Darts
items.summary: Luke Humphries iyo Michael van Gerwen ayaa Talaadadii u gudbay wareegga 16-ka ciyaaryahan ee tartanka Grand Slam of Darts, kaddib guulo ay ka gaareen kulamadoodii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha.
items.imageAlt: Luke Humphries, sawir hore (2024)

items.title: Northern Ireland oo markii ugu horreysay u dallacday League A ee Nations League
items.summary: Northern Ireland ayaa Talaadadii Budapest 1-1 la gashay Hungary, iyadoo Justin Devenny uu dhaliyay gool qurux badan oo ka dhigay kooxda koowaad ee kooxda B2, kuna dallaciyay heerka ugu sarreeya ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Justin Devenny, sawir hore

items.title: Websaydhka Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka oo la jabsaday kaddib mamnuucidda Ruushka
items.summary: Xiriirka Caalamiga ah ee Xeegada Barafka (IIHF) ayaa sheegay in websaydhkiisa Talaadadii lagu qaaday weerar internet, kaas oo u muuqday mid looga jawaabayo go'aankii Ruushka looga reebay Horyaalka Adduunka ee Dhallinyarada 2026-27.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta IIHF ee magaalada Zurich, Switzerland, sawir hore

items.title: Olimpia Milano oo 91-77 ku garaacday Crvena Zvezda, soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo isku xiga
items.summary: Kooxda kubadda koleyga ee Olimpia Milano ayaa Talaadadii wareegga 12-aad ee EuroLeague 91-77 kaga adkaatay Crvena Zvezda ee Serbia, taasoo soo afjartay sagaal guuldarro oo ay Yurub isku xigxiga kala kulantay.
items.imageAlt: Leandro Bolmaro oo u ciyaaraya Olimpia Milano, sawir hore (March 2026)

items.title: Josh Hokit oo dalbaday ciyaar celis ah, Gane oo kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound
items.summary: Feeryahanka Mareykanka Josh Hokit ayaa Talaadadii dalbaday in mar kale lala ciyaarsiiyo Ciryl Gane, isagoo sheegay in farta Gane ay ishiisa gashay bilowgii dagaalkii UFC 334, halka Gane uu kor ugu kacay liisaska pound-for-pound.
items.imageAlt: Ciryl Gane, sawir hore

items.title: Norway oo 3-2 kaga soo laabatay Denmark, Haaland oo u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka
items.summary: Norway ayaa Talaadadii Copenhagen 3-2 kaga adkaatay Denmark kaddib markii ay 2-0 ka dambeysay, iyadoo Erling Haaland uu rigoore waqtiga dheeraadka ah ku dhaliyay goolka u gudbiyay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Erling Haaland oo xiran funaanadda Norway, sawir hore

items.title: Bosnia oo 2-1 kaga soo laabatay Romania, Sweden oo 1-1 la gashay Poland
items.summary: Bosnia iyo Herzegovina ayaa Talaadadii 2-1 kaga adkaatay Romania, halka Sweden ay 1-1 la gashay Poland, labadaas kulan oo ahaa kuwii ugu dambeeyay ee kooxda B4 ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Benjamin Tahirović, sawir hore

items.title: Nations League: 8-da xul ee u gudbay wareegga siddeed dhammaadka oo la ogaaday
items.summary: Wareegga siddeed dhammaadka ee UEFA Nations League 2026/27 ayaa dhammaystirmay Talaadadii, kaddib markii Norway ay noqotay xulkii ugu dambeeyay ee u gudba, iyadoo ku biirtay Belgium, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Portugal iyo Spain.
items.imageAlt: Koobka UEFA Nations League oo lagu soo bandhigay matxaf, sawir hore

items.title: Nvidia oo soo bandhigtay natiijooyin xooggan, guddiguna ma soo celinayo Jensen Huang
items.summary: Shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Talaadadii soo bandhigtay natiijooyin maaliyadeed oo ka sarreeya filashada suuqa, iyadoo sheegtay inaysan dib u magacaabayn maamulihii hore Jensen Huang.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Endeavor ee Nvidia ee Santa Clara, sawir hore

items.title: Parrott oo laba rigoore dhaliyay, Ireland oo 3-0 ku garaacday Kosovo
items.summary: Jamhuuriyadda Ireland ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Aviva ee Dublin 3-0 kaga adkaatay Kosovo oo 10 ciyaaryahan ku dhammaysatay kulanka, iyadoo Troy Parrott uu dhaliyay laba rigoore, taasoo u gudbisay ciyaaraha play-off-ka ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Aviva ee Dublin, sawir hore

items.title: Portugal oo 3-2 kaga adkaatay Wales, Carlos Forbs oo dhaliyay goolka guusha
items.summary: Xulka Portugal ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Cardiff 3-2 kaga adkaaday Wales kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee wareegga kooxaha ee UEFA Nations League, iyadoo Carlos Forbs, oo ciyaarta ku soo galay beddel, uu dhaliyay goolka guusha.
items.imageAlt: Carlos Forbs, sawir hore

items.title: Mali oo 2-0 ku garaacday Rwanda, 6 xul oo u gudbay AFCON 2027
items.summary: Mali ayaa Talaadadii 2-0 kaga adkaatay Rwanda, halka Burkina Faso ay 3-1 ku garaacday Mauritania, labaduba waxay xaqiijiyeen kaalintooda Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka 26 Mars ee Bamako, sawir hore

items.title: Matan Kahana oo loo doortay guddoomiyaha baarlamaanka Israa'iil
items.summary: Baarlamaanka Israa'iil ee Knesset-ka ayaa Talaadadii guddoomiye u doortay Matan Kahana, oo xulafo la ah Gadi Eisenkot, isagoo helay 66 cod oo ka mid ah 120-ka xubnood, taasoo wiiqaysa awoodda Ra'iisul Wasaare Benjamin Netanyahu.
items.imageAlt: Matan Kahana, sawir hore

items.title: Xulka Kenya ee U-23 oo laga reebay isreebreebka AFCON kaddib 2-0 ay Abidjan kaga badisay Ivory Coast
items.summary: Xulka Kenya ee ka yar 23 sano ayaa Talaadadii laga reebay isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika ee U-23, kaddib markii Ivory Coast ay magaalada Abidjan kaga badisay 2-0, wadartana ku guuleysatay 3-2.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Félix Houphouët-Boigny ee Abidjan, sawir hore

items.title: David Bednar iyo Ryan Jeffers oo aqbalay dalabka $23.15 milyan, lix ciyaaryahan oo kale diideen
items.summary: Laba ciyaaryahan oo baseball-ka MLB ah, David Bednar (New York Yankees) iyo Ryan Jeffers (Minnesota Twins), ayaa aqbalay dalabka hal sano ah ee loo yaqaan qualifying offer, oo dhan $23.15 milyan.
items.imageAlt: Ryan Jeffers, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Ralph Brand, mid ka mid ah goolhayeyaasha ugu waaweyn taariikhda Rangers, oo ku geeriyooday 89 jir
items.summary: Kooxda Rangers ee Scotland ayaa tacsi u dirtay Ralph Brand, weeraryahankii hore ee kooxda iyo xulka Scotland, oo ku geeriyooday da’da 89 sano.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Ibrox ee Rangers, sawir hore

items.title: Mareykanka oo duqeeyay jasiiradda Qeshm ee Iran kadib markii miinooyin ay ku dhaceen shan markab oo Hormuz mara
items.summary: Diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii fiidkii duqeeyay goobaha gantaallada laga rido ee jasiiradda Qeshm ee koonfurta Iran, kadib markii ugu yaraan shan markab ay ku dhaceen miinooyin badeed oo ku yaal Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo Iran ay isla maalintaas weerar ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Bahrain.
items.imageAlt: Jasiiradda Qeshm ee Khaliijka Faaris, sawir hore

items.title: Žalgiris oo waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay Bayern Munich, Carsen Edwards oo 32 dhibcood dhaliyay
items.summary: Kooxda kubbadda koleyga ee Žalgiris Kaunas ayaa Talaadadii kulan EuroLeague ah oo gaaray waqti dheeraad ah 117-114 kaga adkaatay FC Bayern Munich, iyadoo ciyaaryahankii hore ee Bayern, Carsen Edwards, uu go'aamiyay kulanka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Žalgirio Arena ee Kaunas, sawir hore

items.title: Libya iyo Tunisia oo 1-1 ku kala baxay, ciyaartoyda Tunisia oo garoonka uga baxay mudaharaad rigoore
items.summary: Kulanka isreebreebka AFCON 2027 ee Libya iyo Tunisia oo Talaadadii lagu ciyaaray Tripoli ayaa ku dhammaaday 1-1, kadib markii ciyaartoyda Tunisia ay dhowr daqiiqo garoonka uga baxeen iyagoo ka cabanaya rigoore muran dhaliyay oo la siiyay Libya.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyda xulka Tunisia oo diyaargarow sameynaya, sawir hore

items.title: Nasser Al-Khelaïfi oo garsoorayaasha u sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee PSG
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Paris Saint-Germain, Nasser Al-Khelaïfi, ayaa bishii September laba garsoore oo baaritaan ay dhegeysteen isagoo ah markhaati la caawiyo, wuxuuna sheegay inuusan waxba ka ogeyn akoonnada baraha bulshada ee loo yaqaan "ciidanka dijitaalka" ee naadiga.
items.imageAlt: Nasser Al-Khelaïfi, sawir hore

items.title: Ukraine oo sheegtay inay burburisay qeyb ka mid ah buundada Kerch ee Ruushka ku xirta Crimea
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in diyaarado drone ah iyo gantaallo Ukraine ah ay garaaceen buundada Kerch ee isku xirta Ruushka iyo jasiiradda Crimea ee la haysto, isagoo howlgalka ku tilmaamay mid aan horay loo arag.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Kerch ee isku xirta Ruushka iyo Crimea, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: JJ Gabriel oo xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagay Manchester United, Real Madrid oo u dhow saxiixiisa
items.summary: Weeraryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel ayaa Talaadadii muuqaal sagootin ah ku xaqiijiyay inuu ka tagay Manchester United, iyadoo la sheegayo inuu heshiis afka ah la gaaray Real Madrid.
items.imageAlt: JJ Gabriel oo kursiga Manchester United ku jira kulan diyaargarow ah, sawir hore (2026)

items.title: NFL oo kulanka Raiders iyo Browns u wareejisay Sunday Night Football
items.summary: Horyaalka NFL ayaa go'aansaday in kulanka Las Vegas Raiders iyo Cleveland Browns ee toddobaadka 12 loo wareejiyo barnaamijka habeenkii Axadda ee Sunday Night Football, halka kulanka New England Patriots iyo Los Angeles Chargers laga saaray waqtigaas.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Cleveland Browns, sawir hore

items.title: Ivory Coast oo gool daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay ah ku heshay barbardhac 2-2 ah oo ay la gashay Gambia
items.summary: Xulka Ivory Coast ayaa Talaadadii waqtigii lagu daray gool ku helay, wuxuuna barbardhac 2-2 ah la galay Gambia kulan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ah, natiijadaas oo ku dhowaad u xaqiijisay kaalintiisa tartanka.
items.imageAlt: Yankuba Minteh, sawir hore

items.title: Xulka U21 ee Jarmalka oo 3-2 looga adkaaday Croatia, roob iyo ceeryaamo culus dhexdooda
items.summary: Xulka da'da ka yar 21 sano ee Jarmalka ayaa Talaadadii 3-2 looga adkaaday Croatia kulan saaxiibtinimo oo lagu ciyaaray roob culus iyo ceeryaamo cufan, taas oo ah guuldarradiisii labaad oo isku xigta.
items.imageAlt: Tababare Antonio Di Salvo, sawir hore (2021)

items.title: Ademola Lookman oo jilibka ka dhaawacmay, Atlético Madrid oo laga yaabo inay waayaan ilaa dhammaadka 2026
items.summary: Baaritaanno caafimaad oo Atlético Madrid ku sameysay magaalada Madrid ayaa muujiyay in weeraryahanka Nigeria Ademola Lookman uu jilibka ka qabo dhaawac xiriiq oo heer sare ah, taas oo laga yaabo inay ka saarto kulamada inta ka harsan 2026.
items.imageAlt: Ademola Lookman, sawir hore (2019)

items.title: Zverev oo 6-2, 7-6 ku garaacay Shelton, kuna gudbay semi-finalka ATP Finals
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka ee Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Turin 6-2, 7-6 kaga adkaaday Ben Shelton oo u dhashay Mareykanka, wuxuuna xaqiijiyay inuu u gudbo semi-finalka tartanka ATP Finals.
items.imageAlt: Alexander Zverev oo ku sugan tartanka Miami Open 2026

items.title: Moise Kean oo dhaawac cusub ku qabsaday tababarka, Como oo sheegtay inuu baaritaanno dheeraad ah marayo
items.summary: Naadiga Como ayaa Talaadadii war rasmi ah ku sheegay in weeraryahanka Talyaaniga Moise Kean uu dhibaato ku qabsaday tababarka, isla markaana uu marayo baaritaanno caafimaad oo dheeraad ah, taas oo dib u dhigaysa soo laabashadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Moise Kean, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Harambee Stars oo garoonka Nyayo 2-1 looga adkaaday, Mofokeng oo Bafana Bafana u dhaliyay labada gool
items.summary: Xulka Koonfur Afrika, Bafana Bafana, ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Nyayo ee Nairobi 2-1 kaga adkaaday xulka Kenya, Harambee Stars, kulan ka tirsan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027, wuxuuna hoggaanka u qabsaday Kooxda D.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Nyayo ee Nairobi, sawir hore

items.title: Piero Hincapie oo Arsenal la saxiixday heshiis cusub oo socda ilaa 2032
items.summary: Daafaca reer Ecuador, Piero Hincapie, ayaa Arsenal la saxiixday heshiis cusub oo shuruudo ka wanaagsan leh, kaas oo muddadiisa sii dheereynaya 12 bilood ilaa 2032.
items.imageAlt: Piero Hincapie xilligii uu joogay Bayer Leverkusen, sawir hore (2022)

items.title: Togo oo 3-0 ku jebisay Aljeeriya, Thibault Klidje oo laba gool dhaliyay
items.summary: Xulka Togo ayaa Talaadadii 3-0 kaga adkaaday Aljeeriya kulan ka tirsan isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ee Kooxda I, iyadoo dhammaan saddexda gool la dhaliyay qeybtii hore.
items.imageAlt: Xulka qaranka Togo, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Kabtanka Houston Texans Azeez Al-Shaair oo la geliyay liiska dhaawacyada, qalliin ayaa sugaya
items.summary: Kooxda Houston Texans ee horyaalka NFL ayaa kabtankeeda iyo ciyaaryahankeeda difaaca Azeez Al-Shaair gelisay liiska dhaawacyada (injured reserve), kaddib dhaawac uu ka soo gaaray gumaarka oo u baahan qalliin.
items.imageAlt: Azeez Al-Shaair iyo tababaraha Bill Davis xerada tababarka Texans, sawir hore (2026)

items.title: Peter Storey, xiddigii Arsenal ee koobabka labada ah ku guuleystay 1971, oo ku geeriyooday 81 jir
items.summary: Kubbad-yaqaankii hore ee Arsenal iyo xulka England, Peter Storey, ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 81 jir, sida uu Talaadadii shaaciyay naadiga Arsenal.
items.imageAlt: Peter Storey (Arsenal) iyo Johan Cruyff, sawir hore oo 1970 laga qaaday Amsterdam

items.title: War culus: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si aan horay loo arag u weeraray Imaaraadka Carabta – “Faragelintiisa waa khatar ku soo wajahan qarannimada Soomaaliya”
items.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad uu caawa u jeediyay shacabka ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta inuu faragelin toos ah ku hayo arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeedinaya madal

items.title: Tababarihii hore ee Betis Pepe Mel oo ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee isbitaalka
items.summary: Tababarihii hore ee Real Betis, Pepe Mel, ayaa ka soo baxay qaybta daryeelka degdegga ah ee Isbitaalka Virgen del Rocío ee Sevilla, kaddib istaroog uu ku dhacay 1 November.
items.imageAlt: Pepe Mel, sawir hore oo 2011 ah

items.title: Philippe Diallo oo Paris ka furay ololihiisa doorashada madaxtinimada FIFA ee ka dhanka ah Infantino
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Faransiiska, Philippe Diallo, ayaa Talaadadii Paris ka furay ololihiisa madaxtinimada FIFA, kaddib markii guddiga fulinta ee FFF uu ansixiyay musharaxnimadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Xiriirka Kubbadda Cagta Faransiiska (FFF) ee Paris, sawir hore

items.title: Jerry Jones: Cowboys waxay ka wada hadlayaan beddelka isku-duwaha difaaca
items.summary: Milkiilaha Dallas Cowboys Jerry Jones ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in kooxdu ay ka wada hadlayso isbeddel ku saabsan isku-duwaha difaaca Christian Parker, kaddib markii difaaca Cowboys uu u oggolaaday 584 yaard kulankii ay 46-40 ugu guuldarreysteen San Francisco 49ers.
items.imageAlt: Jerry Jones, milkiilaha Dallas Cowboys, sawir hore

items.summary: LeBron James ayaa beeniyay warbixin uu daabacay wariyaha ESPN Dave McMenamin oo sheegtay inuu Philadelphia 76ers ka codsaday dulqaad, xilli dhibcihiisu ay yihiin kuwii ugu hooseeyay noloshiisa ciyaareed.

items.title: Arthur Fils oo Rafael Jodar ku garaacay, helayna guushiisii ugu horreysay ee ATP Finals

items.summary: Tuuraha baseball-ka Dustin May ayaa la sheegay inuu Chicago White Sox la gaaray heshiis saddex sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $52.5 milyan; naadigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan shaacin.

items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Spain, Madrid

items.title: Antoine Griezmann oo loo doortay ciyaaryahanka cusub ee ugu fiican MLS 2026

items.title: Japan oo 1-2 ku lumisay Paraguay kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee tababare Hajime Moriyasu
items.summary: Xulka Japan ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Singapore 1-2 uga dhashay Paraguay kulan saaxiibtinimo ah, kaas oo ahaa kulankii ugu dambeeyay ee tababaraha muddada dheer xulka hayay, Hajime Moriyasu.

items.imageAlt: Aagga ganacsiga ee Nakivubo ee bartamaha Kampala, sawir hore

items.imageAlt: Gerard Piqué, milkiilaha FC Andorra, sawir hore (2015)

items.title: Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo adkeysay ilaalinta imtixaannada kaddib arday qirtay inuu ku khiyaameeyay AI

items.imageAlt: Maalinta imtixaanka galitaanka jaamacadaha ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed, sawir hore

items.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada laga qaaday magaalada Hargeysa, sawir hore

items.title: Ilhan Omar oo gaartay guushii ugu ballaarnayd ee musharrax xisbi weyn ka gaaro Minnesota
items.summary: Xildhibaan Ilhan Omar ayaa doorashadii Aqalka Wakiillada ee bishan ku heshay 76.48 boqolkiiba codadka degmada 5-aad ee Minnesota, taasoo noqotay guushii ugu ballaarnayd ee musharrax Dimuqraadi ama Jamhuuri ah uu ka gaaro tartame xisbi weyn ka socda taariikhda gobolkaas.
items.imageAlt: Ilhan Omar oo ka hadlaysa shir dadweyne, sawir hore

items.title: Ciidamada Suudaan oo shan cutub oo cusub u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee xuduudka la leh Itoobiya
items.summary: Ciidanka milatariga Suudaan ayaa shan cutub oo si buuxda u qalabeysan u diray gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah (Blue Nile), oo ku yaal koonfur-bari dalka xuduudna la leh Itoobiya, xilli ay dagaallo ka socdaan gobolkaas.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Damazin, xarunta gobolka Niilka Buluugga ah ee Suudaan, sawir hore oo 2019

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Saddex shaqaale gargaar oo Yei lagu afduubay oo la sii daayay kaddib $2,500 madax furasho
items.summary: Booliiska degmada Yei ee gobolka Central Equatoria ee Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijiyay in saddex shaqaale ah oo ka tirsan hay'ad gargaar caalami ah, oo 9 November qori caaraddiis lagu afduubay, la sii daayay kaddib markii afduubayaashu ay qaateen $2,500.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo deegaanka Yei ee Koonfur Suudaan, sawir hore

items.title: RAYE oo hoggaamisay magacaabista Grammy 2027, Beyoncé oo gaartay 100 magacaabis
items.summary: Fannaanadda reer Ingiriiska RAYE ayaa helay 11 magacaabis oo ah tirada ugu badan ee abaalmarinta Grammy 2027, halka Beyoncé ay noqotay fannaankii ugu horreeyay taariikhda Grammy ee gaara 100 magacaabis.
items.imageAlt: Fannaanadda RAYE oo ku heesaysa Kingston, sawir hore oo 2023

items.title: Madaxweynaha Mongolia Ukhnaa Khurelsukh oo iscasilay kaddib eedeymo musuqmaasuq ah oo uu beeniyay
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mongolia, Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, ayaa Talaadadii 17 November ku dhawaaqay inuu xilka ka degayo, kaddib markii xisbiga mucaaradka uu ku eedeeyay musuqmaasuq kuna hanjabay inuu baarlamaanka xilka kaga qaadi doono.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, sawir hore oo 2024 laga qaaday Ulaanbaatar

items.title: Xavi oo ku tilmaamay shoog guuldarradii 5-0 ee Nederland, warbaahinta Holland oo eedda saartay

items.imageAlt: Xavi Hernández, sawir hore oo 2016 laga qaaday Doha

items.title: Jules Koundé oo la filayo inuu Barcelona ugu soo laabto kulanka Villarreal kaddib dhaawac dheeraaday
items.summary: Daafaca Barcelona Jules Koundé ayaa la filayaa in dhakhaatiirta kooxdu ay u oggolaadaan inuu ciyaaro kulanka Villarreal, kaddib markii soo kabashadiisa ay in ka badan hal bil dib u dhacday, sida ay wariyeen wargeysyada AS iyo Mundo Deportivo.
items.imageAlt: Jules Koundé oo u ciyaaraya Faransiiska, sawir hore oo 2026

items.title: Hakan Fidan: Ruushku ma rabo heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo Badda Madow ah ilaa nabad joogto ah la helo
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, ayaa sheegay in Ruushku uusan oggolaan doonin heshiis ku meel gaar ah oo la xiriira socdaalka maraakiibta Badda Madow, ilaa laga gaaro heshiis nabadeed oo joogto ah oo lala galo Ukraine.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan, sawir hore oo 2024 laga qaaday Washington

items.title: Japan oo diyaarado dagaal u dirtay kaddib markii laba diyaaradood oo Ruush ah la sheegay inay galeen hawadeeda
items.summary: Dowladda Japan ayaa sheegtay in laba diyaaradood oo la rumeysan yahay inay Ruush yihiin ay Talaadadii subax hore ku xadgudbeen hawada dalka agagaarka jasiiradda Okinoshima, taasoo keentay in Tokyo ay diyaarado dagaal u dirto kana gudbiso Moscow cabasho.
items.imageAlt: Afhayeenka dowladda Japan Minoru Kihara, sawir hore oo 2024

items.title: Ukraine oo mar labaad 24 saacadood gudahood weerartay buundada Crimea, socodka gaadiidka oo la joojiyay

items.imageAlt: Buundada Crimea ee Kerch (sawir hore, 2021)

items.imageAlt: Burbur ka muuqda tuulada Komyshuvakha ee gobolka Zaporizhzhia (sawir hore, 2025)

items.title: Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ahaa horyaalka adduunka ee feerka, oo ay hay'adda socdaalka Mareykanka ICE ku xirtay Texas
items.summary: Feeryahankii hore ee reer Venezuela, Jorge Linares, oo saddex jeer ku guuleystay horyaalnimada adduunka, ayaa ay xirtay hay'adda socdaalka iyo kastamka Mareykanka (ICE) gobolka Texas, sida ay xaqiijiyeen qareennadiisa.
items.imageAlt: Jorge Linares oo feer ka ciyaaraya O2 Arena ee London, sawir hore oo 2015

items.title: Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika oo Tanzania u ballanqaaday $26 milyan oo loogu talagalay isbeddelka cimilada

items.imageAlt: Xarunta Bangiga Horumarinta Afrika ee Abidjan (sawir hore, 2016)

items.title: Golaha Ammaanka QM oo maanta shir gaar ah ka yeelanaya howlgalka AUSSOM iyo xaaladda Soomaaliya

items.title: NBA: Magic oo Boston ku jebiyay Celtics, Heat oo 128-110 ku garaacay Rockets ka hor kulanka Giannis iyo Bucks

items.imageAlt: Giannis Antetokounmpo oo xilligii uu Milwaukee Bucks u ciyaarayay, sawir hore oo 2022

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo amar ku siisay hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn inay dib isu diiwaangeliyaan

items.imageAlt: Buundada webiga Niil ee magaalada Juba, caasimadda Koonfur Suudaan (sawir hore)

items.summary: Kooxda Los Angeles Chargers ayaa Isniintii habeennimo 23-20 kaga adkaatay Baltimore Ravens garoonka M&T Bank Stadium, taasoo ah guushii ugu horreysay ee ay xilli ciyaareedkan ka gaaraan horyaalka NFL.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka M&T Bank Stadium ee Baltimore oo sare laga sawiray (sawir hore, 2022)

items.title: Tababaraha Koonfur Afrika Pitso Mosimane oo qiray in Harambee Stars ay ka yaabiyeen barbardhacii 2-2 ee Soweto
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Koonfur Afrika, Pitso Mosimane, ayaa qiray in heerka ciyaareed ee xulka Kenya, Harambee Stars, uu la yaabay kulankii isreebreebka Koobka Qaramada Afrika 2027 ee Jimcihii ku dhammaaday 2-2 magaalada Soweto.

items.title: Mareykanka oo xeer cusub ku xiraya helitaanka fog ee Shiinaha ee chips-ka AI

items.summary: Riad Bouchaker, oo 52 jir ah, ayaa Isniintii xabsi daa'in lagu xukumay isku day dil oo uu u geystay saddex carruur ah, weerar mindi ah oo 23 November 2023 ka dhacay meel u dhow dugsi ku yaal bartamaha Dublin kuna dhaliyay rabshado iyo boob caasimadda Ireland.

items.imageAlt: Magaalada Maputo, caasimadda Mozambique, oo hawada laga sawiray (sawir hore)

items.summary: Jaamacadda Arkansas State ayaa shaqada ka eryday tababaraha kooxdeeda kubadda cagta Mareykanka, Butch Jones, xilli ay ka harsan yihiin laba ciyaarood oo xilli-ciyaareedka caadiga ah.
items.imageAlt: Butch Jones oo loogu dhawaaqay tababaraha Arkansas State (sawir hore)

items.title: Weerarro Ruush ah oo ku dhacay laba buundo oo waaweyn oo Kyiv ah, biyaha iyo korontada oo go'ay
items.summary: Ciidamada Ruushka ayaa habeennimadii Isniinta weerarro ku qaaday laba buundo oo waaweyn oo ka gudba webiga Dnipro ee caasimadda Ukraine, Kyiv, taasoo keentay go'itaan biyo, koronto iyo kuleyl qaybo ka mid ah magaalada, sida uu sheegay duqa magaalada Vitali Klitschko.

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Burnham: Brexit wuu fashilmay, Ingiriisku waa inuu u soo dhowaado Midowga Yurub
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Ingiriiska Andy Burnham ayaa sheegay in ballanqaadkii Brexit uusan wax u qaban dalka, isla markaana Ingiriisku uu u baahan yahay inuu dib u habeeyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay Midowga Yurub si uu ula tacaalo go'doominta sii kordheysa ee adduunka.
items.imageAlt: Andy Burnham oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shir xisbiga Labour (sawir hore)

items.title: Strasbourg oo doonaysa tababaraha Swansea Vítor Matos si uu u beddelo Hugo Oliveira
items.summary: Kooxda Strasbourg ee Ligue 1 ayaa la xiriirtay Swansea City iyadoo doonaysa in tababarahooda Vítor Matos uu beddelo Hugo Oliveira, Swansea-na waxay sii aqbalaysaa inay waayi karto; The Athletic iyo L'Équipe ayaa iyana sidaas qoray.
items.imageAlt: Tababaraha Vítor Matos, sawir hore

items.title: Saddex koob oo Melbourne Cup ah oo uu lahaa faraska Makybe Diva oo laga xaday Flemington, nin la xiray
items.summary: Booliiska gobolka Victoria ee Australia ayaa xiray nin 36 jir ah kaddib markii saddex koob oo Melbourne Cup ah, oo uu ku guuleystay faraska caanka ah ee Makybe Diva, laga xaday garoonka tartanka fardaha ee Flemington, balse koobabka weli lama helin.
items.imageAlt: Faraska Makybe Diva oo tababar ku jira, sawir hore oo 2005

items.title: Rassie Erasmus oo su'aal ka keenay garsoorka rugby-ga ka hor kulanka Springboks iyo Ireland
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka rugby-ga Koonfur Afrika, Rassie Erasmus, ayaa dhaleeceeyay waxa uu ku tilmaamay laba-wejiilenimo xagga garsoorka iyo anshaxa, isagoo weydiiyay in garsoore arka ciyaar xun balse ka aamusa aysan taasi noqonayn wax lagu beddelo natiijada.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Aviva ee Dublin, halka Springboks iyo Ireland ay Sabtida ku kulmi doonaan

items.title: Paul Seixas: ku guuleysiga Tour de France waa riyadayda muddada dheer
items.summary: Baaskiil-wadaha Faransiiska ee 20 jirka ah Paul Seixas ayaa wargeyska Isbaanishka ee AS u sheegay in ku guuleysiga Tour de France uu yahay riyadiisa muddada dheer, halka horyaalka adduunka uu yahay rabitaankiisa ugu weyn ee sannadka 2027.
items.imageAlt: Paul Seixas oo ku taagan masraxa guusha ee Faun Ardèche Classic 2026

items.title: Kooxo Suudaani ah oo ka dibadbaxay in Abyei lagu daro doorashooyinka Koonfur Suudaan

items.imageAlt: Guryo ku yaal magaalada Abyei

items.title: Guatemala oo xoojisay howlgallada amniga kaddib xaalad degdeg ah oo 30 maalmood ah
items.summary: Wasiirrada arrimaha gudaha iyo difaaca Guatemala ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, kormeeray howlgallada amniga ee laba gobol oo xuduud la leh Honduras, maalmo kaddib markii Madaxweyne Bernardo Arévalo uu ku dhawaaqay xaalad degdeg ah oo 30 maalmood ah si loola dagaallamo rabshadaha la xiriira daroogada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Guatemala Bernardo Arévalo

items.title: Shirarka SEC oo dib uga gurtay khilaafka RJ Luis, LSU oo hadda xor u ah inay ku darto ciyaaryahanka

items.imageAlt: Hoolka Pete Maravich Assembly Center ee jaamacadda LSU, Baton Rouge, sawir hore

items.title: Nations League: Slovenia oo 3-0 ku jabisay Waqooyiga Macedonia, Giriigga oo 1-0 kaga adkaaday Serbia
items.summary: Slovenia ayaa 3-0 kaga adkaatay Waqooyiga Macedonia, waxayna hubisay kaalinta labaad ee Kooxda B1 iyo booska ciyaarta isreebreebka ee heerka A/B, halka Giriigga uu 1-0 kaga adkaaday Serbia, sida ay xaqiijisay UEFA iyo wargeyska L'Équipe.
items.imageAlt: Giorgos Masouras, oo dhaliyay goolka Giriigga, sawir hore oo 2022

items.title: Packers: Micah Parsons oo la qorsheeyay inuu xilli ciyaareedka ugu horreeyo kulanka Rams
items.summary: Tababaraha Green Bay Packers, Matt LaFleur, ayaa sheegay in qorshihiisu yahay in Micah Parsons uu kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee xilli ciyaareedkan ka ciyaaro Arbacada soo socota, marka Packers ay Los Angeles ku wajahaan Rams.
items.imageAlt: Micah Parsons oo garoonka ku jira, December 2021

items.title: California oo dacwad ka gudbisay OpenAI kaddib weerar internet oo uu qaaday moodeel AI ah oo tijaabo ahaa

items.title: Shan dal oo Yurub ah oo la filayo inay ku dhawaaqaan xarun lagu celiyo muhaajiriinta oo laga dhiso Kigali
items.summary: Jarmalka, Denmark, Austria, Giriigga iyo Netherlands ayaa la filayaa inay ku dhawaaqaan in caasimadda Rwanda, Kigali, laga dhiso xarun loogu talagalay magangalyo-doonayaasha laga diiday sii joogitaanka Midowga Yurub, sida ay BBC u sheegeen ilo diblomaasiyadeed.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Kigali, caasimadda Rwanda

items.title: Puntland: Wasiirka Maaliyadda oo baarlamaanka ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka 6 bilood aan la mushaarin
items.summary: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Puntland, Maxamed Faarax Maxamuud, ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, baarlamaanka hortiisa ku qiray in shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee dowladda aysan mushaar qaadan muddo 6 bilood ah, isagoo sidoo kale golaha u gudbiyay miisaaniyadda 2027.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Garoowe, caasimadda Puntland

items.title: Drake Maye oo dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah la kulmay, Patriots oo laga yaabo inay waayaan xilli ciyaareedka
items.summary: Quarterback-ka New England Patriots, Drake Maye, ayaa dhaawac culus oo canqowga ah ku gaaray kulankii Patriots ay Detroit Lions uga dhacday Munich, waxaana la filayaa inuu muddo dheer maqnaado, laga yaabee inta ka hartay xilli ciyaareedka.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Gillette Stadium ee kooxda New England Patriots (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Dino Sani, oo Brazil kula guuleystay Koobka Adduunka 1958, kuna ciyaaray AC Milan, oo ku geeriyooday 94 jir
items.summary: Dino Sani, xiddigii hore ee khadka dhexe ee xulka Brazil iyo AC Milan, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku geeriyooday magaalada São Paulo isagoo 94 jir ah, sida ay xaqiijisay xiriirka kubbadda cagta Brazil.
items.imageAlt: Dino Sani sannadkii 2008

items.title: Markab dagaal oo saddexaad oo Mareykan ah oo gaaray Bariga Dhexe, Iran oo sheegtay inay u heellan tahay diblomaasiyadda
items.summary: Markabka diyaaradaha sida ee USS Theodore Roosevelt ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, gaaray Bariga Dhexe, halka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi, uu Islamabad ka sheegay in dalkiisu weli u heellan yahay diblomaasiyadda.
items.imageAlt: Markabka diyaaradaha sida ee USS Theodore Roosevelt oo badda ku jira (sawir hore)

items.title: Maxkamad Hargeysa oo xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasi sheegay inuu u tartamayo madaxweynaha Soomaaliya iyo wariyihii waraystay
items.summary: Maxkamadda Gobolka Maroodi-jeex ee Hargeysa ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, xabsi ku xukuntay siyaasiga Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Sharaay iyo wariye Cabdiraxmaan Cige, kadib waraysi uu Sharaay kaga hadlay damaciisa ah inuu u tartamo xilka Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Suuq ku yaalla magaalada Hargeysa

items.title: Nike oo beddeleysa Adidas, noqonaysana shirkadda kubbadaha Champions League laga bilaabo 2027
items.summary: Shirkadda Mareykanka ee Nike ayaa laga bilaabo xilli ciyaareedka 2027/28 noqon doonta bixiyaha rasmiga ah ee kubbadaha tartamada kooxaha ragga ee UEFA, iyadoo beddeleysa Adidas oo kubbadda Champions League keenaysay tan iyo 2001.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta UEFA ee magaalada Nyon, Swiiserland (sawir hore)

items.title: Shiinaha: Xi, Trump iyo Putin oo Shenzhen kaga wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Shiinaha ayaa Isniinta xaqiijisay in Madaxweyne Xi Jinping, Donald Trump iyo Vladimir Putin ay Khamiista, 19 November, magaalada Shenzhen ku yeelan doonaan shirkii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah, iyagoo ka wada hadli doona nabadda adduunka iyo xasilloonida istiraatiijiga ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin iyo Xi Jinping oo ku kulmay Beijing (2025)

items.title: Ciidanka Asluubta oo fashiliyay maandooriye la doonayay in la geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho
items.summary: Taliska Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa Isniinta sheegay inuu gacanta ku dhigay maandooriye la doonayay in si qarsoodi ah loo geliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho, lix haween ahna lagu xiray, kaddib hawlgal laba bilood socday.
items.imageAlt: Ilaalada xabsiga oo taagan Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho (2013)

items.title: Mareykanka oo dib u cusboonaysiinaya taageerada xafiiska UNSOS iyo howlgalka AUSSOM
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa wakaaladda AFP u xaqiijisay in Washington ay hal sano oo kale taageeri doonto kordhinta waajibaadka Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya (UNSOS) iyo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM.
items.imageAlt: Xaflad Muqdisho lagu sagootiyay madaxii hore ee xafiiska UNSOS, Lisa Filipetto (2023)

items.title: Bankiga Adduunka oo ka fiirsanaya hakinta taageerada miisaaniyadda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Bankiga Adduunka ayaa ka fiirsanaya inuu hakiyo taageerada uu siiyo miisaaniyadda dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo khilaafka ka dhashay muddo kororsiga madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Kooxda Bankiga Adduunka ee Washington, D.C.

items.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu habeennimo riday 1,336 drone oo Ukraine ah; buundada Crimea la weeraray
items.summary: Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka ayaa Isniinta sheegtay in difaaceeda cirku uu habeennimadii riday 1,336 diyaaradood oo drone ah oo Ukraine soo dirtay, kuwaas oo boqolaal ka mid ahi u socdeen Moscow, halka maamulaha Crimea uu sheegay in buundada Crimea la weeraray.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Crimea ee ku taal Kerch (2021)

items.title: Warbixin gaar ah: Waxqabadka iyo hoggaaminta xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre
items.summary: Warbixin gaar ah oo ku saabsan waxqabadka xukuumadda Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre: dowlad-dhis, horumar, amni, diblomaasiyad iyo dowlad-wanaag.
items.imageAlt: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo ag taagan calanka Soomaaliya

items.title: Suudaan iyo Itoobiya oo isku eedeynaya taageerada kooxaha hubeysan
items.summary: Xiisadda u dhexaysa Suudaan iyo Itoobiya ayaa sii korortay, iyadoo dal waliba uu kan kale ku eedeynayo inuu taageero kooxo hubeysan oo dagaal ka wada gudaha xuduudihiisa.
items.imageAlt: Taliyaha ciidamada Itoobiya, Field Marshal Birhanu Jula (2019)

items.title: Kenya oo baaritaan ku billowday boob lagu qaaday xafiisyada qaxootiga ee Hagadera, Dadaab
items.summary: Dowladda Kenya ayaa ku baaqday degganaansho deegaanka Hagadera ee Dadaab, kadib markii xafiisyada Waaxda Adeegyada Qaxootiga la burburiyay oo la boobay, iyadoo ay ku eedaysan yihiin koox dhallinyaro qaxooti ah.
items.imageAlt: Hoyga qaxootiga ee xerada Dadaab, waqooyiga Kenya (2011)

items.title: Ciidamada Uganda ee AUSSOM oo Xoogga Dalka ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla Baraawe
items.summary: Ciidamada Uganda ee ka tirsan hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa Isniintii, 16 November, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ku wareejiyay shan saldhig oo ku yaalla aagga Baraawe ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Uganda ee hawlgalka Midowga Afrika oo ku sugan Baraawe, gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose (2017)

items.title: Martine Moïse, carmalladii madaxweyne Jovenel Moïse, oo isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne Haiti
items.summary: Martine Moïse, oo ah carmalladii madaxweynihii hore ee Haiti Jovenel Moïse oo la dilay sannadkii 2021, ayaa isu diiwaangelisay musharax madaxweyne doorashada sannadka soo socda.
items.imageAlt: Martine Moïse oo ka qayb gelaysa kulan ka dhacay Haiti, December 2018

items.title: San Antonio Spurs iyo Wembanyama oo gaaray 12 guul oo isku xigta, kadib 110-102 ay kaga adkaadeen Utah Jazz
items.summary: San Antonio Spurs ayaa Axaddii 110-102 kaga adkaatay Utah Jazz, taasoo ah guushoodii 12-aad ee isku xigta ee NBA, iyadoo Victor Wembanyama uu dhaliyay 26 dhibcood.
items.imageAlt: Victor Wembanyama oo u ciyaaraya San Antonio Spurs (sawir hore, 2025)

items.title: 49ers oo 46-40 kaga adkaaday Cowboys, natiijo aan weligeed horay uga dhicin taariikhda NFL
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers ayaa Axaddii 15 November magaalada Dallas ku garaacay Dallas Cowboys 46-40, ciyaar 86 dhibcood leh oo natiijadeedu ay markii ugu horreysay abid ka dhacday horyaalka kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NFL.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: garoonka AT&T Stadium ee Arlington, Texas, oo ay ku ciyaaraan Dallas Cowboys

items.title: Toronto Tempo oo ku guuleystay bakhtiyaanasiibka WNBA, waxayna heleen doorashada 1-aad ee 2027
items.summary: Kooxda cusub ee Toronto Tempo ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku guuleysatay bakhtiyaanasiibka doorashada ciyaartoyda WNBA, waxayna heshay doorashada 1-aad ee 2027, taasoo fursad u siin karta inay qaataan xiddigta USC JuJu Watkins.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: JuJu Watkins, xiddigta kubadda koleyga ee USC, oo daawanaysa ciyaar NFL ah 2025

items.title: Sarkaal ciidanka Mareykanka ah oo cabasho ka gudbiyay Pentagon-ka weerarkii Iran ee ku dilay 6 askari Kuwait
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidanka dhulka Mareykanka oo ka badbaaday weerar diyaarad drone ah oo Iran ku qaadday xarun Mareykan oo ku taal Kuwait, kaas oo dilay 6 askari, ayaa Congress-ka u gudbiyay cabasho uu ku sheegay in hoggaanka ciidamadu iska indha tireen walaacii laga qabay difaaca xarunta.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: dhismaha Pentagon-ka, xarunta Wasaaradda Difaaca Mareykanka, oo cirka laga qaaday

items.title: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, aasaasihii kartelka Guadalajara, oo ku dhintay isbitaal isagoo 80 jir ah
items.summary: Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, oo loo yaqaanay "madaxa madaxda" isla markaana aasaasay kartelka Guadalajara ee Mexico, ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku geeriyooday isbitaal ku yaal magaalada Guadalajara isagoo 80 jir ah, sida ay sheegtay wasaaradda amniga ee gobolka Jalisco.
items.imageAlt: Felix Gallardo, sawir hore

items.title: Mirra Andreeva oo finalka kaga adkaatay Svitolina, ku guuleysatayna WTA Finals
items.summary: Ciyaartoyda Ruushka ah ee Mirra Andreeva, oo 19 jir ah, ayaa Axaddii 15 November finalka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells kaga adkaatay Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine 7-5, 6-3, waxayna noqotay ciyaartoyda ugu da'da yar ee ku guuleysata tartankan muddo 22 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Mirra Andreeva oo ciyaareysa US Open 2023

items.title: Amiir Harry oo booqasho lama filaan ah ku tegay Lviv, dagaalyahannada dhaawacmayna ku tilmaamay tusaale
items.summary: Amiirka Ingiriiska Harry ayaa Axaddii 15 November soo gabagabeeyay booqasho aan horay loo shaacin oo uu ku tegay magaalada Lviv ee galbeedka Ukraine, halkaas oo uu ku ammaanay askarta dagaalka ku dhaawacantay, isagoo ku tilmaamay tusaalayaasha bulshada.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Amiir Harry oo ka hadlaya furitaankii Ciyaaraha Invictus 2017

items.title: Bessent oo ku baaqay in Nvidia maamule ka keento dibadda, Musk oo taageeray soo celinta Huang
items.summary: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent ayaa Axaddii 15 November ku baaqay in guddiga Nvidia uu maamulaha cusub ka raadiyo meel ka baxsan shirkadda, xilli Elon Musk uu ku biiray in ka badan 158,000 oo qof oo saxiixay warqad dalbaneysa in Jensen Huang dib loogu celiyo xilka.
items.imageAlt: Sawir kayd ah: Wasiirka Maaliyadda Mareykanka Scott Bessent, sawirkiisa rasmiga ah ee 2025

items.title: Klopp oo ku baaqay in hoggaanka FIFA la beddelo, kuna dhaleeceeyay Infantino
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka Jarmalka Jürgen Klopp ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku baaqay in isbeddel lagu sameeyo madaxtinimada Ururka Kubadda Cagta Adduunka (FIFA), isagoo dhaliilay guddoomiyaha Gianni Infantino.
items.imageAlt: Jürgen Klopp, tababaraha xulka Jarmalka, sawir laga qaaday 2019

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo fuulay markab shidaal oo looga shakiyay inuu ka tirsan yahay 'raxanta qarsoon' ee Ruushka
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ayaa badda Mediterranean-ka ku fuulay markab shidaal oo lagu magacaabo MV MIDAG, kaas oo looga shakiyay inuu ka tirsan yahay raxanta qarsoon ee Ruushka, waxayna caddeeyeen inuu sitay calan been ah, sida ay Axaddii, 15 November, sheegtay Kaja Kallas, madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda…
items.imageAlt: Kaja Kallas, madaxa siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Midowga Yurub

items.title: Africa CDC: Cudurka Ebola ee Kongo weli lama xakameyn, lix bilood kadib markii lagu dhawaaqay
items.summary: Madaxa Xarunta Afrika ee Xakameynta iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (Africa CDC), Jean Kaseya, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in faafidda Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo aan weli la xakameyn, isagoo ka digay inay noqon karto faafiddii ugu xumayd ee adduunka haddii aan hadda la joojin.
items.imageAlt: Jean Kaseya, agaasimaha guud ee Africa CDC, oo saxiixaya heshiis is-afgarad ah 2025

items.title: Xasan Sheekh: Israa'iil iyo Taiwan waxay khatar ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ka sheegay Muqdisho in Israa'iil iyo Taiwan ay khatar ku yihiin jiritaanka iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, isagoo ku eedeeyay inay qaadayaan tallaabooyin ka dhan ah midnimada dalka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud

items.title: Yemen: Xuuthiyiinta oo u soo dhowaaday 60 km magaalada Cadan, sida ay sheegeen ilo militari
items.summary: Xoogagga Xuuthiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, u soo dhowaaday qiyaastii 60 kilomitir magaalada Cadan, oo ah caasimadda ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay, sida ay ilo militari iyo kuwo dowladeed u sheegeen wakaaladda AFP.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda iyo dhismayaal ku yaal magaalada Cadan ee koonfurta Yemen

items.title: Ronaldinho oo 46 jir ah oo 45 daqiiqo u ciyaaray Ravenna, kulankiisii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015
items.summary: Xiddigii hore ee Brazil Ronaldinho ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku soo laabtay garoonka isagoo 46 jir ah, wuxuuna qaybtii hore oo dhan u ciyaaray kooxda Ravenna ee horyaalka Serie C ee Talyaaniga, kulan ay 2-0 kaga adkaadeen deriskooda Forlì.
items.imageAlt: Xiddigii hore ee Brazil Ronaldinho, sawir laga qaaday 2016

items.title: Estonia oo xiraysa dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Estonia, Margus Tsahkna, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in dalkiisu xiri doono dhammaan marinnada xuduudda Ruushka laga bilaabo 1 December, kadib isku day weerar dab-qabadsiin ah oo lala beegsaday shirkad difaac, kaas oo Tallinn ay ku eedeysay Moscow.
items.imageAlt: Xuduudda Estonia iyo Ruushka ee webiga Narva, iyadoo gadaal ka muuqato qalcadda Ivangorod

items.title: Kumanyaal qof oo Prague isugu soo baxay ka soo horjeedka qorshaha maalgelinta warbaahinta dadweynaha
items.summary: Kumanyaal kun oo qof ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, isugu soo baxay beerta Letná ee Prague, caasimadda Jamhuuriyadda Czech, si ay uga soo horjeestaan qorshe dowladeed oo beddelaya habka loo maalgeliyo warbaahinta dadweynaha.
items.imageAlt: Boodhka mudaaharaad ka dhan ah Andrej Babiš oo lagu taagay banaanbax 2019 ka dhacay beerta Letná ee Prague

items.title: Hirshabeelle oo Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha Hirshabeelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Guudlaawe), ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, Korneel Cabdullaahi Barre Cilmi u magacaabay guddoomiyaha cusub ee gobolka Hiiraan.
items.imageAlt: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo ilaalo ku jooga waddo ku taal bartamaha Beledweyne, xarunta gobolka Hiiraan (sawir 2012)

items.title: Ruto oo ugu baaqay Ntutu iyo Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda kadib qalalaasihii dabaaldegga Maa
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ugu baaqay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Narok Patrick Ole Ntutu iyo xildhibaanka Narok West Gabriel Tongoyo inay xakameeyaan taageerayaashooda, kadib qalalaase ka dhacay dabaaldegga Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Maa ee Sabtidii.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah magaalada Narok ee Kenya

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo Sanca ku sii daayay 600 maxbuus oo la xiriira colaadda, sida ay sheegtay ICRC
items.summary: Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen ayaa magaalada Sanca ku sii daysay 600 qof oo loo xiray colaadda dalka, iyadoo la raacayo cafis ay keligeed ku dhawaaqday, sida ay sheegeen Guddiga Caalamiga ah ee Laanqayrta Cas (ICRC) iyo saraakiil Xuuti ah.
items.imageAlt: Dhismayaal ku yaal magaalada qadiimiga ah ee Sanca, Yemen

items.title: Mareykanka oo waayay heerka dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay kadib sannad faafitaan ah
items.summary: Hay'adda Caafimaadka Pan American (PAHO) ayaa ku dhawaaqday in Mareykanku waayay heerkiisa dal jadeecadu ka cirib-tirantay, kadib markii guddi khubaro ah ay go'aamiyeen in fayraska cudurkani uu dalka ku faafayay si aan kala go' lahayn in ka badan 12 bilood.
items.imageAlt: Tallaalka MMR ee jadeecada, qaamaqa iyo rubella

items.title: Iran oo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerartay saldhig Mareykan oo ku yaal Bahrain
items.summary: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay inay 6 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn ku beegsadeen xarun raadaar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal saldhigga hawada ee Riffa ee Bahrain, halka Bahrain ay sheegtay in difaaceeda hawadu burburiyay weerarka.
items.imageAlt: Munaaradda saacadda ee magaalada Riffa ee Bahrain

items.title: Weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine qaaday oo ku dhacay Nizhnekamsk iyo Taganrog ee Ruushka
items.summary: Saraakiisha Ruushka ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in weerarro drone ah oo Ukraine habeennimo qaaday ay waxyeelleeyeen xarumo warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Nizhnekamsk, halka weerar kale oo lagu qaaday Taganrog uu ku dhintay injineer ka shaqeynayay xarun koronto.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Nizhnekamsk ee Tatarstan oo baraf ku daboolan

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo dhagax-dhigay Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka, mucaaradkana ugu baaqay inay ku soo laabtaan wada-hadallada
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, dhagax-dhigay dhismaha Jaamacadda Difaaca Qaranka iyo dib-u-dhiska Isbitaalka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoo xilligaas ugu baaqay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay ku soo laabtaan miiska wada-hadallada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo booqasho rasmi ah ku jira

items.title: Ruto oo ka jawaabay eedaha mucaaradka ee musuqmaasuqa tareenka SGR
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya, William Ruto, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku eedeeyay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka inay si xulasho ah u soo xiganayaan warbixin Bangiga Adduunka oo walaac ka muujisay musuqmaasuq iyo daciifnimo ku jirtay iibsiga dhismaha tareenka SGR, isagoo sheegay in mashruuca la fuliyay xilligii dowlad hore.
items.imageAlt: Tareen rakaab ah oo maraya khadka SGR ee Mombasa iyo Nairobi

items.title: Hamas oo xaqiijisay dilka taliyaheeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, oo lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil
items.summary: Garabka militari ee Hamas, Kataa'ib al-Qassam, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku dhawaaqay in taliyihii guutadeeda Rafah, Samir Abu Younis, lagu dilay duqeyn Israa'iil ay ka fulisay aagga al-Mawasi ee Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay werisay wakaaladda Anadolu oo Daily Sabah daabacday.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Khan Younis ee koonfurta Gaza, 2019

items.title: Isbaanishka: ku dhowaad 2,200 muhaajiriin ah oo laba maalmood gudahood soo gaaray Jasiiradaha Canary
items.summary: Ku dhowaad 2,200 muhaajiriin ah ayaa laba maalmood gudahood doonyo ku soo gaaray Jasiiradaha Canary ee Isbaanishka, sida ay Axaddii, 15 November, sheegtay hay'adda samatabbixinta badda ee Isbaanishka.
items.imageAlt: Canary Islands, sawir hore

items.title: Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamse: Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay awood ay iskaga difaacdo weerarrada internetka
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, sheegay in Soomaaliya ay khasab ku tahay inay dhisato awood ay kaga hortagto weerarrada internetka iyo khataraha amniga dhijitaalka ah, xilli uu kormeer ku tagay xarunta Wasaaradda Isgaarsiinta iyo Tiknoolajiyadda ee Muqdisho.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamse Cabdi Barre oo ka qayb galaya shir lagu qabtay Muqdisho, Janaayo 2023

items.title: Australia oo New Zealand 32-12 kaga adkaatay finalka Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League
items.summary: Australia ayaa Axaddii, 15 November, ku guuleysatay Koobka Adduunka ee Rugby League ee ragga markii afraad oo isku xigta, kadib markii ay finalkii ka dhacay garoonka Suncorp ee Brisbane 32-12 kaga adkaatay New Zealand.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Suncorp ee magaalada Brisbane, Australia

items.title: Senator Ted Cruz oo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ugu baaqay inay aqoonsato Somaliland

items.imageAlt: Kayla Harrison oo dabaaldegaysa kadib guusheedii billadda dahabka ee judo Olombikada Rio 2016

items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka dhismayaasha dhaadheer ee magaalada Riyadh, Sacuudi Carabiya

items.title: Duulimaadyada Mareykanka oo dib u bilaabmay kadib markii la qaaday hakadkii dalka oo dhan
items.summary: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa habeenimadii Jimcaha qaadday hakadkii saacadaha socday ee garoomada dalka oo dhan, iyadoo masuuliyiintu sheegeen in cilladda aysan sababin weerar internet.
items.imageAlt: Munaaradda xakamaynta hawada ee garoonka Dallas Fort Worth iyo diyaarad (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: SpaceX oo Starship u dirtay meeraha dhulka, balse gantaalka hoose ayaa ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico
items.summary: Shirkadda SpaceX ayaa si guul leh u dirtay duulimaadkii ugu dambeeyay ee dayax-gacmeedka Starship, balse kama ay soo celin gantaalka hoose ee Super Heavy sidii loo qorsheeyay, kaas oo ku qarxay Gacanka Mexico.
items.imageAlt: Gantaalka Starship iyo gantaalka hoose ee Super Heavy oo isku dul saaran goobta Starbase ee Texas (sawir kayd ah, 2022)

items.title: Mareykanka oo waayay magacii dal ka xorobay jadeecada kadib 26 sano
items.summary: Guddi khubaro madax-bannaan oo warbixin u gudbiya agaasimaha Ururka Caafimaadka Pan-Ameerika (PAHO) ayaa toddobaadkan go'aamiyay in jadeecada aan mar dambe loo arkin cudur Mareykanka ka xorobay.
items.imageAlt: Sawir mikroskoob oo midab lagu daray oo muujinaya walxaha fayraska jadeecada (cas)

items.title: Svitolina oo kaga adkaatay Sabalenka, kuna gudubtay semi-finalka WTA Finals
items.summary: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 6-3, 3-6, 6-1 kaga adkaatay Aryna Sabalenka tartanka WTA Finals ee Indian Wells, taasoo soo afjartay xilli-ciyaareedka Sabalenka.
items.imageAlt: Elina Svitolina oo ku ciyaaraysa tartanka Indian Wells (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: Aqalka Cad: Trump, Xi iyo Putin ayaa Khamiista Shenzhen ku yeelan doona kulan saddex-geesood ah oo nukliyeer ah
items.summary: Aqalka Cad ee Mareykanka ayaa Jimcihii shaaciyay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu toddobaadka soo socda magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha kula kulmi doono hoggaamiyaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping iyo Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, kulankii ugu horreeyay ee saddex-geesood ah ee hoggaamiyeyaasha saddexda dal.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo laga qaaday degmada Futian ee magaalada Shenzhen, Shiinaha (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Goolhayaha Andorra Jesús Owono oo 12 kulan laga ganaaxay isku dhacii ku dambeeyay geerida Jesús de Miguel
items.summary: Guddiga anshaxa ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) ayaa Jimcihii 12 kulan ka ganaaxay goolhayaha FC Andorra Jesús Owono, kadib isku dhac uu la galay weeraryahankii Tenerife Jesús de Miguel, kaas oo maalin kadib geeriyooday.
items.imageAlt: Ciudad del Fútbol ee Las Rozas, xarunta Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Isbaanya (RFEF) (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal oo diblomaasiyiin u diraya wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada Ukraine
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Yurub António Costa ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in Yurub ay wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine u diri doonto koox diblomaasiyiin ah oo ka socda Midowga Yurub iyo shan dal: Ingiriiska, Faransiiska, Jarmalka, Talyaaniga iyo Booland.
items.imageAlt: António Costa, oo hadda ah Guddoomiyaha Golaha Yurub, sawir laga qaaday sannadkii 2017 (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Mareykanka oo dalka oo dhan ka joojiyay duulimaadyada, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xakamaynta hawada
items.summary: Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) ayaa Jimcihii, 13 November, amar ku bixisay in diyaarad kasta oo ka duulaysa garoomada dalka oo dhan la hakiyo, kadib cillad isgaarsiineed oo saameysay xarumaha gobollada ee xakameeya duulimaadyada.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Wilbur Wright ee magaalada Washington, oo ah xarunta Hay'adda Duulista Federaalka Mareykanka (FAA) (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo shirka Golaha Fulinta Midowga Afrika ee Accra ku taageertay in ururku dhaqaale ahaan isku filnaado
items.summary: Wasiiru Dowlaha Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad), ayaa 13 November magaalada Accra ee Ghana ka sheegay in Soomaaliya ay taageersan tahay in Midowga Afrika uu yeesho hannaan dhaqaale oo isku filan.
items.imageAlt: Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad) oo kulan kula jira Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Giriigga, Brussels (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: Microsoft oo raalli-gelin ka bixisay cilladdii adeegyadeeda oo ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay dunida
items.summary: Shirkadda Microsoft ayaa sheegtay inay aad uga xun tahay cilladda ku timid adeegyadeeda, oo ay ku jiraan Outlook iyo Teams, kadib markii ay ku dhowaad 24 saacadood carqaladeysay isticmaaleyaasha in ka badan 70 dal.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta shirkadda Microsoft ee Redmond, Mareykanka, oo sare laga sawiray (sawir kayd ah, 2021)

items.title: Qaraxyo laga maqlay dekedda Jask ee Iran kadib sheegashada IRGC ee weerarka radar Mareykan oo Bahrain ku yaal
items.summary: Qaraxyo ayaa Jimcihii 13 November laga maqlay magaalada dekedda ah ee Jask ee koonfurta Iran, sida ay sheegtay wakaaladda wararka dowladda Iran ee IRNA, saacado kadib markii Ilaalada Kacaanka (IRGC) ay sheegatay inay burburiyeen nidaam radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku yaal Bahrain.
items.imageAlt: Xeebta Jask ee koonfurta Iran, oo ku taal Gacanka Cumaan (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay oo eedeyn cusub u jeedisay madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña oo la xiriirta burburka bangiga Ueno
items.summary: Xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Paraguay ayaa Jimcihii 13 November madaxweynihii hore Santiago Peña ku eedeeyay ka qaybgal koox dambiyeed, oo la xiriirta doorkiisa la sheegay ee burburka bangiga dijitaalka ah ee Ueno, toddobaad kadib markii baarlamaanku xilka ka qaaday.
items.imageAlt: Santiago Peña oo ah madaxweynihii hore ee Paraguay (sawir kayd ah, 2025)

items.title: Kagame oo booqasho taariikhi ah ku tagay Cambodia, 3 heshiis oo iskaashi ahna la saxiixay
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Rwanda Paul Kagame ayaa 13 November magaalada Phnom Penh kula kulmay Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Cambodia Hun Manet, waxaana labada dal kala saxiixdeen 3 heshiis oo ku saabsan maalgashiga, dalxiiska iyo duulimaadyada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Rwanda Paul Kagame oo ka hadlaya shirka amniga ee Munich (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: Ronaldinho oo 46 jir ah oo la filayo inuu Axadda u saftay Ravenna, kulankiisii ugu horreeyay tan iyo 2015
items.summary: Xiddiga reer Brazil Ronaldinho ayaa la filayaa inuu Axadda ka bilaabo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee rasmi ah muddo ka badan 10 sano, marka kooxdiisa Ravenna ay la ciyaarto deriskeeda Forlì horyaalka Serie C ee Talyaaniga.
items.imageAlt: Ronaldinho, xiddigii hore ee Brazil (sawir kayd ah, 2019)

items.title: Ruushka oo wafdi ganacsi oo 70 qof ah u diray Kabul si uu ula xaajooto dowladda Taliban
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka Ruushka Alexei Overchuk ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdi ka kooban 70 ganacsade oo gaaray Kabul, halkaas oo ay dowladda Taliban kala hadleen gaadiidka, beeraha iyo daawooyinka.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul wasaare ku-xigeenka Ruushka Alexei Overchuk (sawir rasmi ah oo kayd ah)

items.title: Ruto oo ballan qaaday in waddada Nairobi-Mombasa laga dhigo laba jid muddo sannad gudihiis ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Jimcihii magaalada Mombasa ka sheegay in dowladdiisu muddo sannad gudihiis ah laba jid ka dhigi doonto waddada weyn ee isku xirta Nairobi iyo Mombasa.
items.imageAlt: Waddada weyn ee Nairobi iyo Mombasa isku xirta (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Maxkamadda ICC oo baaritaankeeda Afgaanistaan ku koobtay dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban
items.summary: Garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ayaa xiray qaybta baaritaanka Afgaanistaan ee lagu eegi karay ciidamada Mareykanka, waxayna baaritaanka ku koobeen dambiyada lagu eedeeyay Taliban, sida ay muujinayaan dukumentiyo maxkamadda oo Jimcihii la shaaciyay.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ee magaalada The Hague (sawir kayd ah, 2019)

items.title: Goolhayaha caanka ah ee Mareykanka Alyssa Naeher oo ka fariisatay kubadda cagta xirfadda
items.summary: Alyssa Naeher, oo ka mid ah goolhayeyaasha ugu guulaha badan taariikhda xulka haweenka Mareykanka, ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay ka fariisanayso kubadda cagta xirfadda kadib 11 xilli ciyaareed oo ay u ciyaartay kooxda Chicago Stars.
items.imageAlt: Alyssa Naeher oo u diyaar garoobaysa kulan saaxiibtinimo oo xulka Mareykanka la ciyaaray Shiinaha (sawir kayd ah, 2018)

items.title: Israa'iil oo la sheegay inay Somaliland u xaqiijisay in aqoonsigu sii jiri doono xitaa haddii xukuumaddeedu isbeddesho
items.summary: Mas'uuliyiin Israa'iili ah ayaa hoggaanka Somaliland u xaqiijiyay in Israa'iil aysan ka noqon doonin aqoonsiga ay siisay Somaliland, xataa haddii xukuumadda Tel Aviv ay isbeddesho, iyadoo la soo xiganayo telefishanka dowladda Israa'iil ee KAN.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Hargeysa ah (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: OCHA oo ka digtay daacuun iyo shuban-biyood ku faafaya Mudug kadib fatahaadaha
items.summary: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-dubaridka arrimaha bini'aadantinimada (OCHA) ayaa ka digay korodhka cudurrada faafa ee ka dhashay fatahaadihii dhowaan ka dhacay gobolka Mudug, gaar ahaan deegaannada bariga Gaalkacyo.
items.imageAlt: Hoyga ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dad fatahaad ka barakacay oo ku yaal duleedka Beledweyne, gobolka Hiiraan (sawir kayd ah, 2014)

items.title: Turkiga iyo Qatar oo saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah oo Istanbul lagu gaaray
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan iyo Amiirka Qatar Sheekh Tamiim bin Xamad Aal Thaani ayaa Jimcihii Istanbul ku saxiixay heshiis difaac wadaag ah, xilli ay qabteen shirka 12aad ee Guddiga Istiraatiijiyadeed ee Sare ee labada dal.
items.imageAlt: Amiirka Qatar Sheekh Tamiim bin Xamad Aal Thaani iyo Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan oo ka qayb galay kulan ka dhacay xarunta Qaramada Midoobay (sawir kayd ah, September 2025)

items.title: McIlroy iyo Hatton oo wadaaga hoggaanka DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai
items.summary: Rory McIlroy iyo Tyrrell Hatton ayaa wadaaga hoggaanka tartanka golf-ka ee DP World Tour Championship ee Dubai kadib labadii maalmood ee hore, iyagoo labaduba ku jira shan dhibcood ka hooseeya par-ka.
items.imageAlt: Rory McIlroy oo kubadda ku tuuraya godka koowaad xilli tababar ka hor tartanka Masters ee 2024 ee Augusta (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Lix qof oo ku dhimatay dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo ku burburay Syokimau, duleedka Nairobi
items.summary: Ugu yaraan lix qof ayaa ku dhimatay kadib markii dhismo siddeed dabaq ah oo aan la dhammaystirin uu subaxnimadii Jimcaha ku burburay Syokimau oo ku taal duleedka Nairobi.
items.imageAlt: Saldhigga tareenka ee Syokimau, oo ku yaal duleedka Nairobi, meel u dhow goobta uu dhismuhu ku burburay (sawir kayd ah, 2014)

items.title: Madaxweyne Ramaphosa oo warqadaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika, Cyril Ramaphosa, ayaa maanta Madaxtooyada Pretoria si rasmi ah uga guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo Safiirka cusub ee Soomaaliya u fadhiya Koonfur Afrika, Amb. Aadam Isxaaq.
items.imageAlt: Safiirka Soomaaliya, Aadam Isxaaq (bidix), iyo Madaxweyne Cyril Ramaphosa (midig) oo ku sugan Madaxtooyada Pretoria

items.title: Puntland oo ciidamo geysay deegaanka Roox ee Mudug kadib xiisad dhimasho sababtay
items.summary: Dowladda Puntland ayaa ciidamo nabadgelyo geysay deegaanka Roox ee gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo maalmo ka hor ay ka dhacday xiisad sababtay dhimashada hal qof.
items.imageAlt: Mas'uuliyiin Puntland iyo Galmudug, saraakiil booliis iyo hawlwadeenno UNSOM ah oo ku sugan magaalada Gaalkacyo, xilli tababar booliis la furayay (sawir kayd ah, 2017)

items.title: IAEA oo Iran ugu baaqday inay kormeerayaasha u ogolaato goobaha nukliyeerka ee muhiimka ah
items.summary: Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga ee Caalamka (IAEA) ayaa warbixin cusub ku sheegtay in si degdeg ah loo baahan yahay in dib loo bilaabo kormeerka Iran, maadaama aysan haysan macluumaad ku saabsan uraaniyamka aadka loo kobciyay, iyadoo la soo xiganayo AFP iyo Reuters.
items.imageAlt: Calammada dalalka xubnaha ka ah oo taagan xarunta IAEA ee magaalada Vienna (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah ee Ukraine oo Volgograd ku dilay 4 qof
items.summary: Afar qof ayaa la dilay, labana waa la dhaawacay, kadib weerar diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo Ukraine ku qaaday aag warshadeed oo ku yaal magaalada Volgograd ee koonfurta Ruushka, sida uu sheegay guddoomiyaha gobolka Andrei Bocharov.
items.imageAlt: Warshadda shidaalka sifeysa ee Volgograd oo laga arkayo degmada Krasnoarmeisky (sawir kayd ah, 2023)

items.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway oo go'aamisay in oggolaanshaha saddex goob oo saliid ah uu sharci-darro ahaa
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ayaa 13-kii November go'aamisay in oggolaanshihii dowladdu siisay saddex goob oo saliid iyo gaas ah oo ku yaal Badda Waqooyi uu ahaa mid aan ansax ahayn, maadaama aan la qiimeyn saameynta cimilada.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Norway ee magaalada Oslo (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Ciidamada IRGC oo sheegay in markab gaas dareere ah uu ku qarxay miino bariga Marinka Hormuz
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa Jimcaha sheegay in markab sida gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha (LNG) uu si xoog leh u qarxay kaddib markii uu ku dhacay miino badeed bariga Marinka Hormuz, sheegashadaas oo aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Sawir dayax-gacmeed oo muujinaya Marinka Hormuz

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine iyo Ruushka waxay ku heshiiyeen isweydaarsigii maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weynaa
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelensky, ayaa 12-kii November magaalada Dublin ka sheegay in Ukraine iyo Ruushka ay isku raaceen isweydaarsiga maxaabiista dagaal ee ugu weyn ilaa hadda, kaddib kulan uu la yeeshay ergayada Mareykanka Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo booqasho ku jooga Golaha Yurub (sawir kayd ah, 2025)

items.title: Kosovo oo Soomaaliya ka codsatay inay ka caawiso helitaanka sagaal xubnood oo wafdi Soomaaliyeed ka maqan
items.summary: Dowladda Kosovo ayaa warqad diblomaasiyadeed ku weydiisatay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya inay ka caawiso ogaanshaha halka ay ku sugan yihiin sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsanaa wafdi Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo 27-kii October ka baxay hoygoodii magaalada Prishtina iyaga oo aan cidna ogeysiin.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha cusub ee garoonka diyaaradaha caalamiga ah ee Prishtina, Kosovo

items.title: Sacuudiga oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 11,500 kursi oo Xajka 2027 ah
items.summary: Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeysay 11,500 boos oo Xaj ah oo loogu talagalay xujeyda Soomaaliyeed ee Xajka 2027, kadib heshiis ay labada dowladood ku kala saxiixdeen magaalada Jeddah.
items.imageAlt: Kacbada iyo xujeyda ku sugan Masjidka Xaramka ee Maka xilliga Xajka (sawir kayd ah, 2018)

items.title: Jubaland oo diiday magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Golaha Wasiirrada
items.summary: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha ee Jubaland ayaa sheegtay inaysan aqoonsanayn magacaabista hoggaanka Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka, iyadoo ku doodday in hannaanka dhismaha hay'adda aan lala tashan dowlad-goboleedyada.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirro iyo mas'uuliyiin Jubaland ah oo ka qayb galay xaflad magaalada Kismaayo (sawir kayd ah, 2015)

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo looga hortagayo saameynta El Niño
items.summary: Midowga Yurub ayaa Soomaaliya u qoondeeyay 6 milyan oo Yuuro oo lagu xoojinayo u diyaargarowga musiibooyinka iyo taageerada bulshada nugul, xilli laga cabsi qabo in El Niño uu saameyn xooggan ku yeesho qaybo ka mid ah Afrika 2026 iyo 2027.
items.imageAlt: Hadja Lahbib, wakiilka Midowga Yurub ee diyaargarowga iyo maareynta xasaradaha (sawir kayd ah, 2024)

items.title: Kalonzo Musyoka oo u ambabaxaya Mareykanka si uu ula kulmo xildhibaannada Congress-ka ka hor doorashada 2027
items.summary: Hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya, Kalonzo Musyoka, ayaa 18 ilaa 24 November u safraya Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu kula kulmi doono xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka isla markaana la kulmi doono Kenyanka qurbaha.
items.imageAlt: Kalonzo Musyoka, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Wiper ee Kenya

items.title: Muqdisho oo markii ugu horreysay martigelisay shirka Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo CEWARN
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay shir laba maalmood ah oo ay yeesheen Guddiga Xoghayeyaasha Joogtada ah ee IGAD iyo xarunta digniinaha hore ee colaadaha CEWARN.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaalka magaalada Muqdisho, caasimadda Soomaaliya

items.title: Senator Chris Van Hollen oo ku dhawaaqay inuu Chuck Schumer kula tartamayo hoggaanka Dimuqraadiga ee Aqalka Sare
items.summary: Senator-ka Dimuqraadiga ah ee gobolka Maryland, Chris Van Hollen, ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuu u tartamayo jagada Hoggaamiyaha Aqlabiyadda ee Aqalka Sare ee Mareykanka, isagoo noqday senator-kii ugu horreeyay ee si toos ah u loolama Chuck Schumer.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Senator Chris Van Hollen

items.title: Cade Cunningham oo taariikh NBA sameeyay: 52 dhibcood, 11 caawin iyo 0 kubbad lumis
items.summary: Xiddiga Detroit Pistons Cade Cunningham ayaa Khamiistii dhaliyay 52 dhibcood, kana caawiyay 11, isagoo aan lumin hal kubbad, xilli Pistons ay 144-140 kaga adkaadeen Washington Wizards kadib 2 waqti oo dheeri ah.
items.imageAlt: Cade Cunningham oo u ciyaaraya Detroit Pistons

items.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran oo sheegtay inay weerar ku qaadeen goob radar oo Mareykan ah oo ku taal Bahrain
items.summary: Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay inay beegsadeen goob radar digniin hore oo Mareykanku ku leeyahay Bahrain, iyagoo ku tilmaamay aargoosi weerar cirka laga soo qaaday oo ku dhacay munaarad isgaarsiineed oo ku taal koonfurta Iran.
items.imageAlt: Qalcadda Bahrain iyo muuqaalka magaalada Manama, caasimadda Bahrain

items.title: Maxkamad Isbaanya ah oo hakisay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional
items.summary: Garsoore ku sugan magaalada Gijón ee waqooyiga Isbaanya ayaa Khamiistii hakiyay hawlaha kooxda midigta fog ee Núcleo Nacional, iyadoo la baarayo dambiyo nacayb iyo urur sharci darro ah.
items.imageAlt: Fagaaraha Plaza Mayor ee magaalada Gijón, waqooyiga Isbaanya

items.title: FBI: Haakarro Kuuriyada Waqooyi ah oo wicitaanno muuqaal been ah ku xaday in ka badan $400 milyan oo crypto ah
items.summary: Hay'adda FBI ee Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in haakarro ay dowladda Kuuriyada Waqooyi taageerto ay in ka badan $400 milyan oo lacag crypto ah ku xadeen iyagoo adeegsanaya wicitaanno muuqaal ah oo been abuur ah si ay u xadaan aqoonsiga dadka.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta FBI ee J. Edgar Hoover Building ee Washington

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inuu ka fiirsan doono xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu hubaal ka fiirsan doono adeegsiga xoog militari oo ka dhan ah Cuba, isagoo intaas ku daray inuu doonayo in arrinta Cuba la dhammeeyo ka hor inta uusan xilka ka degin 2029.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Malecón ee magaalada Havana, caasimadda Cuba

items.title: Zelensky oo soo dhoweeyay in Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda Ukraine iyo Ruushka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa soo dhoweeyay ballanqaad ay bixiyeen ergooyinka Mareykanka Jared Kushner iyo Steve Witkoff oo ah in wakiillo ka socda Midowga Yurub lagu daro wareegga xiga ee wada-hadallada nabadda ee Ruushka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky oo kulan ku jira, June 2026

items.title: Booliska Haiti oo dib ula wareegay garoonka kubadda cagta ee qaranka oo 2 sano ay haysteen kooxaha burcadda
items.summary: Ciidamada amniga Haiti ayaa Khamiistii dib gacanta ugu soo celiyay garoonka ugu weyn ee kubadda cagta ee dalka, kaas oo 2 sano ay gacanta ku hayeen kooxaha burcadda.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Sylvio Cator ee Port-au-Prince, garoonka qaranka ee Haiti (sawir 2010)

items.title: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania oo sheegay in shirka NATO ee 2027 aan lagu qaban doonin Tirana
items.summary: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania Edi Rama ayaa sheegay in NATO aysan sannadka soo socda shirkeeda ku qaban doonin Albania sidii loo qorsheeyay, xilli dowladdiisu ay wajahayso dhaleeceyn ku saabsan kharashka difaaca iyo mudaaharaadyo gudaha ah.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul wasaaraha Albania Edi Rama oo ka hadlaya shir jaraa'id, Berlin 2025

items.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo Yordan Alvarez oo codad buuxa loogu doortay ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan MLB 2026
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka Chicago Cubs Pete Crow-Armstrong iyo ciyaaryahanka Houston Astros Yordan Alvarez ayaa Khamiistii lagu dhawaaqay inay yihiin ciyaartoyda ugu qiimaha badan (MVP) ee National League iyo American League, iyagoo labaduba helay codadka oo dhan.
items.imageAlt: Pete Crow-Armstrong oo u ciyaaraya Chicago Cubs, 2024

items.title: Maxkamad ku taal Kaliningrad oo 12 sano xabsi ku xukuntay qareen u dooda xuquuqda aadanaha
items.summary: Maxkamad ku taal gobolka Kaliningrad ee Ruushka ayaa Khamiistii 12 sano oo xabsi ah ku xukuntay Maria Bontsler, qareen 66 jir ah oo difaaci jirtay dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyo siyaasadeed, kadib markii lagu helay khiyaano qaran.
items.imageAlt: Kaniisadda weyn ee hore ee magaalada Kaliningrad, Ruushka

items.title: Mauricio Pochettino oo heshiis 2 sano iyo badh ah ku gaaray inuu tababare u noqdo Manchester United
items.summary: Manchester United iyo Mauricio Pochettino, tababaraha xulka Mareykanka, ayaa heshiis ku gaaray inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda, isagoo bedelaya Michael Carrick oo Khamiistii xilka laga qaaday.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo garoonka ku jira xilli ciyaar xulka Mareykanka iyo Belgium, March 2026

items.title: Burburka dhismaha Brooklyn: tirada dadka dhintay oo gaartay 8, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah
items.summary: Mas'uuliyiinta magaalada New York ayaa Khamiistii sheegay in 8 qof, oo ay ku jiraan 2 carruur ah, ay ku dhinteen burburkii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo Arbacadii ku dumay goob dhismo oo ku taal degmada Brooklyn.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Flatbush Avenue ee degmada Brooklyn, New York, oo baraf ku daboolan, January 2026

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu xoog ka adeegsado Iran haddii xulafada iyo maraakiibta la khatar geliyo
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa Khamiistii sheegay inuusan ka waaban doonin inuu ciidan ka adeegsado Iran haddii uu arko in xaaladdu ka soo horjeedo Washington, isagoo intaas ku daray in laga yaabo inuu hadda sidaas sameeyo.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Donald Trump oo waraysi bixinaya, 30 October 2026

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Guddiga doorashada oo xisbiyada siin waayay jadwal cad oo doorashada 22 December
items.summary: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ee Koonfur Suudaan (NEC) ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Juba shir kula yeeshay xisbiyada siyaasadda si looga wada hadlo diyaargarowga doorashada guud ee 22 December, balse xisbiyada ayaa sheegay in aan la siin jadwal cad oo lagu dhammaystirayo hawlaha harsan.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal guud oo magaalada Juba, caasimadda Koonfur Suudaan

items.title: Cillad ku timid adeegyada Microsoft oo saameysay Outlook, Teams iyo Copilot
items.summary: Kumanaan isticmaalayaal ah oo adeegyada Microsoft ah ayaa Khamiistii la kulmay dhibaatooyin ku saabsan emailka Outlook, Teams, Copilot iyo adeegyo kale oo Microsoft 365 ah, kadib markii server-yo si lama filaan ah u shaqeyn waayeen.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha 92 ee xarunta Microsoft ee Redmond, Washington

items.title: Rwanda oo COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin $3 bilyan oo koronto ah iyo ilaalinta daadadka Kigali
items.summary: Dowladda Rwanda ayaa shirka cimilada ee COP31 ka codsatay maalgelin caalami ah oo lagu taageerayo korontada, adkaysiga magaalooyinka iyo beeraha, iyadoo sheegtay inay u baahan tahay ku dhowaad 3.05 bilyan oo doollar qorshaheeda korontada.
items.imageAlt: Dad ka qayb qaadanaya shaqo bulsho oo lagu dayactirayo dhul-qoyanka Nyandungu ee Kigali, 2017

items.title: Khubaro oo cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed
items.summary: Koox khubaro ah ayaa maanta cambaareeyay xil ka qaadista sharci-darrada ah ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku sameysay Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Bashe Yuusuf Axmed, iyo dhaarinta qof loogu magacdaray beddelkiisa, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay faragelin cad oo lagu hayo madax-bannaanida garsoorka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud (bidix) iyo garsoore xiran dharka rasmiga ah ee Maxkamadda Sare (midig)

items.title: Harry Kane oo jebiyay rikoorka kulamada ugu badan ee xulka Ingiriiska, isagoo gaaray 126
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Bayern Munich Harry Kane ayaa Khamiistii noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu kulamada badan taariikhda xulka ragga Ingiriiska, kadib markii lagu bilaabay ciyaartii Nations League ee Croatia ee garoonka Wembley, taas oo ahayd kulankiisii 126-aad, sida ay werisay bogga rasmiga ah ee Bundesliga.
items.imageAlt: Harry Kane oo xulka Ingiriiska u ciyaaraya, June 2026

items.title: Helikobtar milateri oo nooca S-70 ah oo ku burburay Malatya ee bariga Turkiga, 4 askari ayaa ku dhintay
items.summary: Helikobtar ay leeyihiin ciidamada Turkiga oo nooca S-70 ah ayaa Khamiista fiidkii ku burburay degmada Yeşilyurt ee gobolka Malatya, waxaana shilka ku dhintay 4 askari.
items.imageAlt: Helikobtar Sikorsky S-70 Black Hawk ah oo ay leeyihiin ciidamada dhulka ee Turkiga, bandhigga Teknofest 2021, Istanbul (sawir hore)

items.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn saaray dhammaan 10-ka shirkadood ee ugu waaweyn saliidda Ruushka
items.summary: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Khamiista ku dhawaaqday cunaqabateyn cusub oo beegsanaysa dhammaan 10-ka shirkadood ee ugu waaweyn ee soo saara saliidda Ruushka, iyadoo ujeedku yahay in la jaro dakhliga lagu maalgeliyo dagaalka Ukraine.
items.imageAlt: Andy Burnham, 13 August 2024 (sawir hore)

items.title: Aisha Jumwa oo dib ugu laabatay xisbiga UDA, 3 bilood kadib markii ay ku biirtay Wiper
