items.summary: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa Khamiista, 12 November 2026, Aqalka Madaxtooyada ee Mombasa ku soo dhaweeyay wasiirkii hore Aisha Jumwa oo dib ugu soo laabatay xisbiga talada haya ee UDA.
items.imageAlt: William Ruto (sawir hore)

items.title: Lix safaaradood oo ka digay khatar sare oo Ebola uga dillaacdo Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Safaaradaha Jarmalka, Japan, Netherlands, Norway, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Mareykanka ee Juba ayaa Khamiista bayaan wadajir ah ku sheegay in Koonfur Suudaan ay wajaheyso khatar sare oo Ebola ah, waxayna hoggaamiyeyaasha dalka ugu baaqeen inay maalgeliyaan qaybta caafimaadka.
items.imageAlt: Haweeney ku fadhida xarun caafimaad oo ku taalla Koonfur Suudaan, 2023

items.title: Jensen Huang oo iska casilay hoggaanka Nvidia, Colette Kress oo noqotay maamulaha ku-meel-gaarka
items.summary: Shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Khamiista xaqiijisay in aasaasaheeda iyo maamulaheeda guud Jensen Huang uu xilka ka degayo, kadib warar sheegayay inuu xiriir la lahaa haweeney ay saraakiisha Mareykanku u haystaan basaasad Shiine ah.
items.imageAlt: Jensen Huang oo ka hadlaya Jaamacadda Stanford, 30 April 2026

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Antalya kula kulmay Erdogan iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Liibiya
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Khamiista magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga kula kulmay Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Liibiya Cabdulxamiid Dbeibah, iyadoo kulammadu ay ka dhaceen hareeraha shirka cimilada ee COP31.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Erdogan iyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo furaya terminaalka cusub ee garoonka Aadan Cadde, Muqdisho, January 2015

items.title: MSF: Boqollaal milyan oo doollar oo Ebola loogu talagalay oo aan gaarin shaqaalaha safka hore ee Kongo
items.summary: Hay'adda Dhakhaatiirta Aan Xuduudaha Lahayn (MSF) ayaa Khamiista ka digtay in maalgelinta caalamiga ah ee lagula dagaallamayo cudurka Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo aysan gaarin shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo bulshooyinka sida weyn ugu baahan.
items.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Guud ee QM António Guterres iyo madaxa WHO Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus oo booqanaya xarunta daaweynta Ebola ee Mangina, Kongo, September 2019

items.title: Crystal Palace oo xilka ka qaaday tababare Pierre Sage kadib 16 kulan
items.summary: Kooxda Crystal Palace ayaa Khamiista xilka ka qaaday tababaraha Faransiiska Pierre Sage, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku jirto kaalinta ugu hooseysa Premier League-ka kadib shan bilood oo uu hoggaaminayay.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Selhurst Park ee kooxda Crystal Palace, qaybta Holmesdale Stand

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyay 3 siyaasadood qaran, heshiis Turkiga iyo xafiis OHCHR
items.summary: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Khamiista Muqdisho ku ansixiyay 3 siyaasadood qaran, magacaabista madaxda hay'ado dowladeed iyo heshiisyo caalami ah oo uu ku jiro mid Turkiga, kulan uu guddoomiyay Ra'iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre oo khudbad ka jeedinaya Muqdisho, January 2023

items.title: Kenya: Qareen Abshir Abdi oo nool laga helay Marsabit kadib 11 maalmood oo uu maqnaa
items.summary: Ururka Qareennada Kenya (LSK) ayaa xaqiijiyay in qareen Abshir Abdi, oo la sheegay in niman hubeysan ay ka qaadeen Nairobi horraantii November, laga helay isagoo nool deegaanka Sololo ee gobolka Marsabit.
items.imageAlt: Waddada isku xirta Marsabit iyo Moyale ee waqooyiga Kenya

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Antalya ka daahfurtay qorshe maalgashi cimilo oo lagu qiyaasay 12.8 bilyan oo doollar
items.summary: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Khamiista magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga ka daahfuray Qorshaha Maalgashiga Qaranka ee wax-ka-qabashada isbeddelka cimilada, kaas oo lagu qiyaasay 12.8 bilyan oo doollar muddo 10 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Nin xoolo-dhaqato ah oo riyo daaq u raadinaya xilli abaar, 2012

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo Faysal Maxamed Xaashi u magacaabay Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka
items.summary: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kulan koodii khamiislaha ahaa ku magacaabay Mudane Faysal Maxamed Xaashi in uu noqdo Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka, kadib soo jeedin ka timid Wasiirka Maaliyadda Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Biixi Iimaan Cige.
items.imageAlt: Mudane Faysal Maxamed Xaashi, Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay’adda Dakhliga Qaranka, oo ay gadaashiisa ka muuqdaan astaanta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo dekedda Muqdisho

items.title: Manchester United oo xilka ka qaaday Michael Carrick, Pochettino ayaa la filayaa inuu bedelo
items.summary: Manchester United ayaa Khamiista shaacisay inay xilka ka qaadday tababaraheedii Michael Carrick, iyadoo kooxdu ay ku jirto kaalinta 18-aad ee Premier League kadib bilowgii ugu xumaa ee xilli ciyaareed muddo 40 sano ah.
items.imageAlt: Michael Carrick oo la sawiray kadib ciyaar dhex martay Millwall iyo Middlesbrough, April 2025

items.title: Zelensky: Xaddidaad cusub oo lagu sameeyay Starshield ayaa wiiqaysa difaaca Ukraine
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky ayaa Khamiista sheegay in ciidamada Ukraine ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay la kulmeen carqalado waaweyn oo ku yimid adeegga isgaarsiinta dayax-gacmeedka Starshield, kuwaasoo saameeyay safka hore oo dhan iyo dhulka Ruushku qabsaday.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky, 2022

items.title: Turkiga oo beeniyay warar sheegaya inuu 15,000 askari u dirayo Soomaaliya
items.summary: Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka ee Turkiga ayaa Khamiista beenisay warar sheegayay in Ankara ay 15,000 askari u diri doonto Soomaaliya codsi Muqdisho ka yimid, iyadoo sheegtay in ciidamadeeda halkaas jooga ay sii wadaan tababarka iyo talobixinta.
items.imageAlt: Furitaanka saldhigga ciidamada Turkiga ee Muqdisho, September 2017

items.title: James Anderson oo 44 jir ah oo u wareegay Surrey kaddib markii Lancashire aysan siin heshiis cusub
items.summary: Ciyaartoyga kubbadda cricket-ka ee England James Anderson, oo 44 jir ah, ayaa heshiis la saxiixday kooxda Surrey, taas oo u oggolaanaysa inuu ciyaarta sii wado xitaa kaddib dhalashadiisa 45-aad.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaartoyga cricket-ka ee England James Anderson sannadkii 2023

items.title: Burundi oo la sheegay inay dadajinayso ka bixitaanka ciidamadeeda Soomaaliya ka hor dhammaadka AUSSOM
items.summary: Dowladda Burundi ayaa la sheegay inay dadaal degdeg ah ugu jirto sidii ay ciidamadeeda uga saari lahayd Soomaaliya ka hor inta uusan dhammaan howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM, sida ay Khamiista werisay Hiiraan Online iyo Goobjoog News oo soo xigtay warbaahinta Africa Intelligence.
items.imageAlt: Askar ka tirsan ciidamada Burundi ee Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya oo safaf ku jira

items.title: Sarkaal ciidamada Ruushka ah oo lagu dilay qarax gaari oo ka dhacay St Petersburg
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan ciidamada Ruushka ayaa Khamiista lagu dilay qarax ku dhacay gaarigiisa degmada Pushkinsky ee magaalada St Petersburg, sida ay sheegtay Guddiga Baarista ee Ruushka oo dacwad dil ah furay.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah degmada Pushkinsky ee St Petersburg, Ruushka

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo COP31 ka codsaday 6.3 bilyan oo dollar oo Soomaaliya ugu diyaargarowdo isbeddelka cimilada
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shirweynaha COP31 ee Antalya ka dalbaday in Soomaaliya la siiyo 6.3 bilyan oo dollar si ay ula qabsato saameynta isbeddelka cimilada inta u dhexeysa hadda iyo 2035.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo kulan rasmi ah ku jira sannadkii 2025

items.title: Duqeyn Israa'iil ah oo ku dhacday Isbitaalka Nasser ee Khan Younis: 6 qof ayaa la sheegay inay dhinteen
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 6 qof ayaa la dilay, in ka badan 20 kalena waa ku dhaawacmeen duqeyn cirka ah oo Israa'iil ay Khamiista subaxnimo ku qaadday dhismo ka tirsan Isbitaalka Nasser ee magaalada Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza, sida ay sheegtay hay'adda difaaca madaniga ee Gaza.
items.imageAlt: Dhismayaal burburay oo ku yaal magaalada Khan Younis, koonfurta Gaza

items.title: Philip Rivers oo noqonaya tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee NC State
items.summary: Philip Rivers, oo ahaa ciyaaryahan caan ah oo ka ciyaaray NFL, ayaa oggolaaday inuu noqdo tababaraha cusub ee kooxda kubadda cagta Mareykanka ee jaamacadda NC State, halkaas oo uu horey quarterback uga ahaa.
items.imageAlt: Philip Rivers xilligii uu NFL ka ciyaarayay, 2017

items.title: Stephen Curry oo dhaawac caloosha ah ku baxay, Rockets-na 115-108 kaga adkaadeen Warriors
items.summary: Xiddigga Golden State Warriors Stephen Curry ayaa Arbacadii ka baxay ciyaartii Houston Rockets rubucii 1-aad kaddib xanuun dhinaca midig ee caloosha ah, Rockets-na waxay ciyaarta ku guuleysteen 115-108.
items.imageAlt: Stephen Curry oo tababar tuur ah sameynaya ciyaar ka hor

items.title: Amnesty: QM iyo dowladda Koonfur Suudaan ayaa ka gaabiyay ka hortagga xasuuqii Abiemnom
items.summary: Hay'adda Amnesty International ayaa warbixin ay Khamiista soo saartay ku sheegtay in hawlgalka nabad-ilaalinta QM ee Koonfur Suudaan (UNMISS) iyo mas'uuliyiinta dalka ay haysteen digniino ku filan, balse ay ku guuldareysteen inay ka hortagaan weerar 1 March 2026 lagu dilay in ka badan 200 qof oo ku sugnaa Abiemnom.
items.imageAlt: Gawaarida hawlgalka QM ee Koonfur Suudaan (UNMISS) oo biyo ka qaadaya webiga Niil

items.title: Dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku burburay Brooklyn, New York: ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 2 qof ayaa dhimatay, in ka badan 17 kalena waa la dhaawacay kaddib markii dhismo 3 dabaq ah oo ku yaal xaafadda Flatbush ee degmada Brooklyn, magaalada New York, uu Arbacadii galabnimo ku dumay goob dhismo oo ag taal, sida ay sheegeen mas'uuliyiinta magaalada.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Flatbush Avenue ee degmada Brooklyn, magaalada New York

items.title: Bangiga EBRD oo ballan-qaaday 6 bilyan oo doollar mashaariicda tamarta la cusboonaysiin karo ee Turkiga
items.summary: Bangiga Yurub ee Dib-u-dhiska iyo Horumarinta (EBRD) ayaa sheegay inuu shanta sano ee soo socota 6 bilyan oo doollar gelin doono mashaariicda tamarta nadiifka ah ee Turkiga, kadib markii uu ku biiray barnaamij cusub oo lagu daah-furay shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya.
items.imageAlt: Marawaxadaha dabaysha ee beerta korontada dabaysha ee Silivri, gobolka Istanbul, Turkiga

items.title: Jacob Misiorowski oo si wadajir ah ugu guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League
items.summary: Ciyaartoyga tuuraha ah ee kooxda Milwaukee Brewers Jacob Misiorowski ayaa Arbacadii lagu dhawaaqay inuu ku guuleystay abaalmarinta Cy Young ee National League ee xilli-ciyaareedka 2026, isagoo helay dhammaan 30-ka cod ee kaalinta koowaad.
items.imageAlt: Jacob Misiorowski oo kubad tuuraya isagoo u ciyaaraya Milwaukee Brewers

items.title: Saamiyada Nvidia oo hoos u dhacay iyadoo guddiga shirkadda uu ka doodayo mustaqbalka Jensen Huang
items.summary: Saamiyada shirkadda Nvidia ayaa Arbacadii ku dhacay in ka badan 8 boqolkiiba ganacsiga saacadaha dambe, kadib warar sheegaya in guddiga agaasimayaasha shirkadda uu ka doodi doono jagada madaxa shirkadda Jensen Huang.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta dhexe ee shirkadda Nvidia ee magaalada Santa Clara, California

items.title: Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Guatemala oo khatar ugu jira inay waayaan magaca dal ka xorobay jadeecada
items.summary: Guddi khubaro caafimaad oo madax-bannaan ayaa toddobaadkan Washington ku eegaya in Mareykanka, Mexico iyo Guatemala ay weli buuxiyaan shuruudaha dalal laga tirtiray faafidda jadeecada.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Ururka Caafimaadka Pan-Ameerika (PAHO) ee magaalada Washington

items.title: Baabe Leo XIV oo gaaray Peru, dalkii uu muddo dheer ka shaqeeyay
items.summary: Baabe Leo XIV ayaa Arbacadii gaaray Peru, oo ah marxaladdii ugu dambeysay ee socdaalkiisa Koonfurta Ameerika, waxaana soo dhaweeyay kumanaan qof oo u yaqaan "Padre Robert".
items.imageAlt: Taallada Baabe Leo XIV ee Pimentel, Chiclayo, Peru

items.title: Dimuqraadi Scott Colom oo ku guuleystay kursiga Golaha Guurtida ee Mississippi
items.summary: Musharraxa xisbiga Dimuqraadiga Scott Colom ayaa ku guuleystay doorashada Golaha Guurtida Mareykanka ee gobolka Mississippi, isagoo tiro yar oo codad ah kaga adkaaday Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith oo ka tirsan xisbiga Jamhuuriga.
items.imageAlt: Scott Colom, musharraxa Dimuqraadiga ee Golaha Guurtida Mississippi

items.title: Svitolina oo dib uga soo kacday kaga adkaatay Muchova, rajada WTA Finals-na ilaashatay
items.summary: Elina Svitolina oo u dhalatay Ukraine ayaa 3-6, 6-2, 6-2 kaga adkaatay Karolina Muchova tartanka WTA Finals, taasoo u sii daysay fursadda inay u gudubto semi-finalka.
items.imageAlt: Elina Svitolina oo ciyaar teennis ah ku jirta

items.title: Garsoore Mareykan ah oo oggolaaday in dacwadda $10 bilyan ee Trump ka gudbiyay BBC ay socoto
items.summary: Garsoore federaal ah oo ku sugan Florida ayaa go'aamiyay in dacwadda sumcad-dilka ee Madaxweyne Donald Trump ka gudbiyay BBC, oo uu ku dalbanayo $10 bilyan, ay sii socon karto.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta BBC ee Broadcasting House, London

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya: Tanaasul farsamo waa diyaar, doorashada qof iyo cod se lagama noqonayo
items.summary: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya, Cabdifataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku diyaar u tahay tanaasul ku saabsan arrimaha farsamo ee doorashada, balse aysan ka tanaasuli doonin hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya ee Villa Somalia, Muqdisho

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo Jimcaha fasax dadweyne ka dhigtay aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu
items.summary: Koonfur Suudaan ayaa Jimcaha, 13 November 2026, ku dhawaaqday fasax dadweyne si muwaadiniintu uga qayb galaan aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya, sida uu sheegay guddiga sare ee qabanqaabada aaska.
items.imageAlt: Fagaaraha xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee magaalada Juba, Koonfur Suudaan

items.title: Mareykanka oo kooxdiisa ka saaray Koobka Adduunka ee U-17 ee Qatar walaac amni dartiis
items.summary: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Mareykanka (U.S. Soccer) ayaa go'aansaday inaanu kooxda qaranka ee da'da ka yar 17 u dirin Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA ee U-17 ee Qatar, isagoo sheegay walaac amni oo la xiriira colaadda Bariga Dhexe.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal hawada laga qaaday xarunta isboortiga Aspire Zone ee Doha, Qatar

items.title: War-saxaafadeed: Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol oo sheegay inuusan ka qaybgalin kulan wadajir ah oo mucaarad
items.summary: Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa war-saxaafadeed ku sheegay in aysan jirin wararka sheegaya inuu ka qaybgalay kulan wadajir ah oo uu la yeeshay ururro kale oo mucaarad ah, wuxuuna ka warramay booqasho ay Taliyeyaasha Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ku tageen hoyga Madaxweynihii 9aad Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo.
items.imageAlt: War-saxaafadeedka Xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ee 11 November 2026, oo uu saxiixay afhayeenka xisbiga Cabdirashiid Maxamed Xaashi

items.title: Iran oo ciidamada badda iyo cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran ayaa Arbacadii ku dhawaaqday inay ciidamada badda iyo ciidamada cirka ee Argentina u aqoonsatay ururro argagixiso, taasoo jawaab u ah go'aan Buenos Aires horay uga gaartay Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ee Iran.
items.imageAlt: Markabyada dagaalka ee ciidamada badda Argentina ARA Robinson iyo ARA Rosales

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo COP31 ka codsaday in dalalka cimilada wasakheeya ay hoggaamiyaan wax ka qabashada saameynteeda
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Arbacadii khudbad ka jeediyay shirweynaha 31-aad ee Qaramada Midoobay ee isbeddelka cimilada (COP31) oo ka furmay magaalada Antalya ee Turkiga, wuxuuna beesha caalamka ugu baaqay inay fuliyaan ballanqaadyadii cimilada.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shirka amniga cuntada adduunka ee London, November 2023

items.title: Kulanka Xasan Sheekh iyo Abiy: marin-badeedka iyo madaxbannaanida Soomaaliya
items.summary: Kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ee maanta ka dhacay Turkiga wuxuu ku soo beegmay xilli labada dal ay weli wajahayaan caqabado diblomaasiyadeed oo ka dhashay murankii marin-badeedka. Mabda'a Soomaaliya waa in madaxbannaanideeda iyo midnimadeeda dhuleed si buuxda loo ixtiraamo.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan oo ka hadlaya shir xisbiga AK Parti (sawir hore, kama aha kulanka maanta)

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka: 66 sano oo xiriir diblomaasiyadeed, iskaashi iyo saaxiibtinnimo ah
items.summary: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka waxay leeyihiin xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo soo taxnaa tan iyo xilligii ay Soomaaliya xorriyadda qaadatay 1-dii Luulyo 1960, kana dhisan saaxiibtinimo, is-ixtiraam, iskaashi iyo danaha labada shacab. Qoraa: Eng Mahad AA.
items.imageAlt: Calanka Jarmalka (bidix) iyo calanka Soomaaliya (midig), oo uu ku qoran yahay astaanta Wartabiye TV

items.title: Tababarihii hore ee NFL Rex Ryan oo loo soo oogay dacwado kaddib shil lugeyaal ka dhacay Nashville
items.summary: Rex Ryan, falanqeeyaha ESPN iyo tababarihii hore ee kooxaha New York Jets iyo Buffalo Bills, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 isu dhiibay booliska Nashville, kaddib markii lagu eedeeyay inuu baabuurkiisa ku dhuftay laba qof oo lugeynayay oo uu goobta ka tagay.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Broadway ee bartamaha magaalada Nashville, Tennessee

items.title: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan oo kulan la yeeshay Ra'iisul Wasaarihii hore Xasan Cali Khayre
items.summary: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Ra'iisul Wasaarihii 19-aad ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre. Waxay ka wada hadleen geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed ee dalka, dadaallada afarta dhinac ee Türkiye, Maraykanka, Boqortooyada Ingiriiska iyo Midowga Yurub, iyo xiriirka…
items.imageAlt: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan (bidix) iyo Ra'iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya Xasan Cali Khayre (midig) oo is garab taagan, calammada Soomaaliya oo gadaashooda ka muuqda

items.title: Safiirka Ruushka u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, oo geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ku dhawaaqday in safiirka dalkaas u fadhiyay Mareykanka, Alexander Darchiev, uu si lama filaan ah u geeriyooday isagoo 66 jir ah.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha safaaradda Ruushka ee magaalada Washington, D.C.

items.title: Iran oo ku hanjabtay inay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub haddii looga duulo
items.summary: Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 sheegay in Tehran ay weerari doonto saldhigyada Mareykanka ee Yurub iyo jasiiradaha fogfog haddii laga adeegsado weerar lagu qaado Iran.
items.imageAlt: Mohsen Rezaei, xoghayaha Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran (sawir 2013)

items.title: Baarlamaanka Kenya oo meel mariyay sharci ka mamnuucaya isbitaallada inay bukaanka iyo meydadka hayaan
items.summary: Golaha Qaranka ee Kenya ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 meel mariyay sharci mamnuucaya in isbitaalladu ay lacag hore ka dalbadaan bukaanka xaaladaha degdegga ah, ama ay hayaan bukaan iyo meydad biilal aan la bixin awgood.
items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka ee Golaha Qaranka Kenya, magaalada Nairobi

items.title: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Sweden
items.summary: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Mohamud Karshe, ayaa xarunta Urur Goboleedka IGAD ee magaalada Muqdisho ku qaabilay Danjiraha Dowladda Sweden u fadhiya Soomaaliya, H.E. Amb. Hans Henric Lundquist, iyagoo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida.
items.imageAlt: Wakiilka IGAD ee Soomaaliya Mohamud Karshe iyo Danjiraha Sweden Hans Henric Lundquist oo ku sugan xarunta IGAD ee Muqdisho

items.title: England oo baajisay Test-ka haweenka ee West Indies si ay ugu diyaar garowdo Ashes-ka
items.summary: Kooxda cricket-ka haweenka England ayaa baajisay ciyaar Test ah oo bisha April looga ciyaari lahaa West Indies, waxayna taa beddelkeeda Ingiriiska ku ciyaari doontaa ciyaaro kubadda cas ah oo ay ugu diyaar garoobayso Ashes-ka.
items.imageAlt: Dhismo ka tirsan garoonka cricket-ka Headingley ee magaalada Leeds, England

items.title: Wasiirka Caddaaladda Soomaaliya oo ka digay khatar ku wajahan dowladnimada, kuna baaqay dib-u-eegis federaalka
items.summary: Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud, ayaa Arbacada 11 November 2026 ka digay khataraha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka, wuxuuna ku baaqay in dib loo eego nidaamka federaalka.
items.imageAlt: Siyaasiyiin iyo odayaal Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan Villa Somalia xilli la saxiixayay heshiiskii dowlad goboleedka Baydhabo (sawir 2014)

items.title: Ergooyinka Trump oo Moskow ugu ambabaxaya Putin kaddib wada-hadallada Abu Dhabi oo aan horumar cad laga gaarin
items.summary: Jared Kushner, oo qaba gabadha Madaxweyne Donald Trump, ayaa Arbacada sheegay in isaga iyo ergayga Bariga Dhexe Steve Witkoff ay berri u safri doonaan Moskow si ay ula kulmaan Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin, kaddib markii wada-hadallada saddex-geesoodka ah ee Abu Dhabi ay ku dhammaadeen horumar cad la'aan.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin oo gacan qaad la sameynaya ergayga Mareykanka Steve Witkoff, 5 September 2026

items.title: Isbaanya oo markii ugu horreysay muddo 14 sano ah gashay shaqo-joojin guud oo ka dhan ah xiisadda guryaha
items.summary: Malaayiin shaqaale ah oo Isbaanya ah ayaa Arbacada, 11 November 2026, galay shaqo-joojin guud oo 24 saacadood ah, iyagoo dowladda ka dalbanaya inay wax ka qabato xiisadda guryaha, wax ka yar saddex toddobaad kahor doorashada qaranka ee 29 November.
items.imageAlt: Boodhadh ugu baaqaya shaqo-joojintii guud ee 14 November 2012 oo lagu dhejiyay waddo ku taal Barcelona (sawir kayd ah)

items.title: Kenya oo sii daysay bukaankii Ebola ee ugu dambeeyay, tirinta 42 maalmood ee ka xorowga cudurka oo bilaabatay
items.summary: Kenya ayaa Arbacada, 11 November 2026, isbitaalka ka sii daysay bukaankii ugu dambeeyay ee Ebola, taasoo bilowday muddo 42 maalmood ah oo kormeer ah; haddii aan kiis cusub la helin, dalka waxaa lagu dhawaaqi doonaa inuu ka xorobay Ebola 23 December, sida uu sheegay Wasiirka Caafimaadka Aden Duale.
items.imageAlt: Aden Duale, oo xilligaas ahaa Wasiirka Difaaca Kenya, oo ka hadlaya Manda Bay, September 2023

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy oo Turkiga kaga wada hadlay amniga Soomaaliya iyo gobolka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed ayaa kulan ku yeeshay Turkiga, kahor shirka madaxda ee COP31 ee magaalada Antalya, waxayna ka wada hadleen xaaladda amni ee Soomaaliya iyo isbeddellada Geeska Afrika, sida ay werisay warbaahinta dowladda Itoobiya ee Fana.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Itoobiya Abiy Axmed oo ka qeyb galay xaflada caleemo-saarka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee Muqdisho, June 2022

items.title: Somaliland oo xukun dil ah ku fulisay sagaal maxbuus oo maxkamaduhu ku xukumeen dambiyo dil
items.summary: Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa subaxnimadii Arbacada, 11 November 2026, deegaanka Mandheera ku fulisay xukun dil ah oo lagu fuliyay sagaal qof oo maxkamadaha Somaliland hore ugu xukumeen dil, kaddib markii lagu helay dambiyo dil.
items.imageAlt: Taallada dagaalka ee bartamaha Hargeysa, caasimadda Somaliland (sawir 2007)

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya oo saxiixay heshiiska Xajka 2027: Soomaaliya waxaa loo qoondeeyay 11,500 xujaaj
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa magaalada Jiddah ku saxiixay heshiiska qoondada Xajka sannadka 1448 Hijriga (2027), kaas oo Soomaaliya loogu qoondeeyay 11,500 oo xujaaj ah.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta Soomaaliya, Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, oo ka qeyb galaya shir Muqdisho ka dhacay, January 2023

items.title: Lithuania oo xirtay garoomada Vilnius iyo Kaunas, diyaarado NATO-na la kiciyay kaddib drone laga soo diray Belarus
items.summary: Diyaaradaha dagaalka NATO ayaa laba jeer xalay la kiciyay kaddib markii diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga tuhunsan yahay inay ka yimaadeen Belarus ay digniin cireed ka dhaliyeen qaybo badan oo Lithuania ah, garoomada Vilnius iyo Kaunas-na si ku meel gaar ah loo xiray, iyadoo la soo xiganayo idaacadda dowladda…
items.imageAlt: Albaabka weyn ee Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Vilnius, Lithuania

items.title: Mareykanka oo si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay in ciidamadiisu ka baxeen saldhigga Baledogle
items.summary: Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa markii ugu horreysay si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay in ciidamada Mareykanku ay ka baxeen saldhigga milatari ee Baledogle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kaddib markii dhabaha diyaaraduhu xumaaday.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Mareykanka iyo guutada Danab oo tababar ku sameynaya saldhigga Baledogle, April 2021

items.title: Madaxda hay'adaha amniga oo Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka
items.summary: Taliyeyaasha hay'adaha amniga iyo milatariga Soomaaliya ayaa Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay hoggaamiyeyaal ka tirsan mucaaradka, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amni iyo xiisadda siyaasadeed ee dalka.
items.imageAlt: Ra'iisul wasaarihii hore Maxamed Xuseen Rooble oo ka hadlaya shir Muqdisho ka dhacay, December 2020

items.title: Senator Ted Cruz oo taageerada safiirka cusub ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan Soomaaliya ku xiray arrinta Somaliland
items.summary: Senator Ted Cruz oo ka tirsan Aqalka Senate-ka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in taageeradiisa ansixinta Devin Kennington, oo Madaxweyne Donald Trump u magacaabay safiirka Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya, ay ku xiran tahay sida maamulku ugu dhaqmo mawqifka madaxweynaha ee Somaliland.
items.imageAlt: Senator Ted Cruz, sawirkiisa rasmiga ah ee Senate-ka Mareykanka (2019)

items.title: Ururrada qareennada Uganda iyo Bariga Afrika oo Xasan Sheekh ugu baaqay inuu ixtiraamo Maxkamadda Sare
items.summary: Ururka Qareennada Uganda iyo Ururka Qareennada Bariga Afrika (EALS) ayaa bayaanno ay soo saareen 10 November 2026 ugu baaqay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu ixtiraamo go'aannada Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khudbad ka jeedinaya Muqdisho (sawir 2012)

items.title: Tanzania: dakhliga beerta qaranka ee TANAPA oo saddex laab kor ugu kacay shan sano gudahood
items.summary: Hay'adda Beeraha Qaranka ee Tanzania (TANAPA) ayaa sheegtay in dakhligeedu uu ka kacay 174 bilyan oo shilin sannadkii 2021/2022 una gaaray 534 bilyan oo shilin sannadkii 2025/2026, iyadoo tirada dalxiisayaashu ay dhaaftay 1.5 milyan.
items.imageAlt: Libaax duurjoog ah oo ku sugan Beerta Qaranka ee Serengeti, Tanzania

items.title: Burcad-badeedda xeebaha Soomaaliya oo dib u kordheysa, kalluumeysatada Bander Beyla oo cabanaya
items.summary: Weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale kordhaya tan iyo April 2026, sida ay sheegtay warbixin uu 10-ka November daabacay Africa Defense Forum, taas oo walaac ku abuurtay amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya.
items.imageAlt: Doon ay isticmaali jireen burcad-badeed Soomaali ah, oo ay qabsadeen ciidamada badda Finland intii lagu jiray howlgalka Atalanta

items.title: Kenya: Golaha Guurtida oo ka walaacsan diyaargarowga garoonka Kasarani ee AFCON 2027
items.summary: Guddiga Shaqada iyo Daryeelka Bulshada ee Golaha Guurtida Kenya ayaa walaac ka muujiyay diyaargarowga garoonka Moi International Sports Centre ee Kasarani, oo loo qorsheeyay inuu martigeliyo ciyaaraha Koobka Qaramada Afrika (AFCON) 2027.
items.imageAlt: Gudaha garoonka Kasarani (Moi International Sports Centre), Nairobi, Kenya

items.title: Ebola: kiisaska Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo oo dhaafay 11,000, dhimashaduna waa 5,387
items.summary: Tirada kiisaska la xaqiijiyay ee cudurka Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo ayaa gaartay 11,042, iyadoo ugu yaraan 5,387 qof ay u dhinteen, sida ay muujinayaan xogta dowladda ee Talaadadii la shaaciyay.
items.imageAlt: Mutadawiciin ka tirsan Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kongo oo ku sugan Bunia, gobolka Ituri, intii lagu jiray faafidda Ebola, August 2026

items.title: Ruushka oo sheegay inuu gobolka Leningrad ku riday 146 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha gobolka Leningrad ee Ruushka, Aleksandr Drozdenko, ayaa sheegay in 146 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn la soo riday intii lagu jiray weerar Talaadadii ka socday gobolkaas, sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka ee dowladda Ruushka TASS.
items.imageAlt: Xafiiska shirkadda sifeynta shidaalka KINEF ee magaalada Kirishi, gobolka Leningrad

items.title: El Salvador oo sheegtay inay burburisay xarunta kooxda burcadda 400 Mawozo ee Haiti
items.summary: Madaxweynaha El Salvador Nayib Bukele ayaa sheegay in ciidamada militariga dalkiisa ay burburiyeen xarunta kooxda 400 Mawozo, oo ka mid ah kooxaha burcadda ugu waaweyn Haiti, weerar dhul iyo cir ah oo lagu qaaday dhisme ku yaalla duleedka caasimadda Port-au-Prince.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Port-au-Prince, caasimadda Haiti, oo laga sawiray hawada sare

items.title: Wariyadda Masar Lina Attalah oo maanta maxkamad loo celinayo, iyadoo xabsi u eg
items.summary: Wariyadda caanka ah ee Masar Lina Attalah, oo madax u ah warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan ee Mada Masr, ayaa Arbacada maanta ah la horkeenayaa maxkamad dembiyeed oo dib loogu qaadayo dacwad lagu eedeeyay ka shaqeyn shati la'aan iyo faafinta war been ah.
items.imageAlt: Lina Attalah, madaxa Mada Masr, oo ka hadlaysa Bandhigga Saxaafadda Caalamiga ah ee Perugia, Talyaaniga, 2024

items.title: UNCTAD: isbeddelka cimiladu wuxuu dunida ka lumin karaa 10% wax-soosaarkeeda
items.summary: Hay'adda Ganacsiga iyo Horumarinta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNCTAD) ayaa ka digtay in khasaaraha dhaqaale ee isbeddelka cimiladu uu gaari karo qiyaastii 10% wax-soosaarka guud ee adduunka haddii heerkulka dunidu kordho 3 darajo oo Celsius ah.
items.imageAlt: Rebeca Grynspan, xoghayaha guud ee UNCTAD, oo ku sugan Palais des Nations ee Geneva, 2021

items.title: Eric Zemmour oo ku dhawaaqay inuu mar labaad u tartamayo madaxweynaha Faransiiska
items.summary: Qoraaga iyo siyaasiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, Eric Zemmour, ayaa Talaadadii telefishinka TF1 ka xaqiijiyay inuu musharax ka noqonayo doorashada madaxweynaha ee sannadka soo socda, iyadoo la soo xiganayo wakaaladda AFP.
items.imageAlt: Eric Zemmour, siyaasiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, April 2022

items.title: Ruushka oo dalka ka saaray diblomaasi Moldova ah, jawaab ka ah tallaabo Chisinau qaaday
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ayaa Talaadadii sheegtay inay dalka ka saartay shaqaale ka tirsan safaaradda Moldova, iyadoo ku tilmaantay jawaab ka ah go'aankii Moldova ee ahaa inay erido shaqaale safaaradda Ruushka ka tirsan.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Ruushka ee magaalada Moscow

items.title: Erdoğan oo COP31 ku qabtay lix kulan, Turkiga iyo Sacuudigana saxiixeen heshiis koronto
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Antalya, oo ay ka socoto shirka cimilada ee COP31, ku qaabilay lix hoggaamiye iyo masuul, waxaana uu goobjoog ka ahaa saxiixa heshiis is-afgarad koronto oo u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Sacuudi Carabiya.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Tamarta Turkiga Alparslan Bayraktar

items.title: Aqalka Wakiillada Mareykanka oo bilaabay codbixin go'aamineysa qaraarka xil ka qaadista Hegseth
items.summary: Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa Talaadadii bilaabay codbixin habraac ah oo go'aamineysa in qaraarka xil ka qaadista Wasiirka Difaaca Pete Hegseth dib loogu celiyo guddi ama loo gudbiyo codbixin kama dambays ah.
items.imageAlt: Hoolka Golaha Wakiillada Mareykanka ee dhismaha Capitol-ka, Washington

items.title: Gianni Infantino oo laga yaabo in Congress-ka Mareykanka uu u yeero bisha January
items.summary: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino ayaa laga yaabaa in toddobaadyada soo socda, ugu dambeyn bisha January, uu waajib ku noqdo inuu ka jawaabo amarro yeedhid ah oo uu soo saaro Congress-ka Mareykanka, sida uu werinayo wargeyska Ingiriiska ee The Telegraph.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha FIFA Gianni Infantino

items.title: Ciidamada UNIFIL oo rasaas lagu furay intii ay ku sugnaayeen roondo koonfurta Lubnaan
items.summary: Ciidamada nabad-ilaalinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Lubnaan (UNIFIL) ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in qiyaastii 12 xabbadood lagu riday mid ka mid ah kooxahooda roondada ku jiray meel u dhow Wadi Jilu oo ka tirsan degmada Tyre, iyagoo aan magacaabin cidda ka dambeysay.
items.imageAlt: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada UNIFIL oo roondo ku jira xadka Blue Line ee koonfurta Lubnaan

items.title: Tanzania oo sheegtay inay 5-tii sano ee la soo dhaafay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin ku dhistay 676 dugsi
items.summary: Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Maamulka Gobollada iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee Tanzania, Dr Festo Dugange, ayaa sheegay in dowladdu ku bixisay 604.6 bilyan oo shilin dhismaha 676 dugsi oo cusub iyo 34,464 musqulood, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Ardayda dugsiga hoose ee Nyakahoja ee magaalada Mwanza, Tanzania

items.title: Askari ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka oo Ingiriiska lagu xiray, looguna tuhmay basaasnimo Ruushka
items.summary: Booliska la-dagaallanka argagixisada ee London ayaa sheegay in askari 41 jir ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada Mareykanka lagu xiray meel u dhow magaalada Gloucester, iyadoo looga shakisan yahay inuu ku xadgudbay sharciga amniga qaranka ee la xiriira Ruushka.
items.imageAlt: Calaamadda xarunta New Scotland Yard ee Booliska Metropolitan Police ee London

items.title: Lewis Hamilton oo booqday xuduudda Masar iyo Gaza si uu u arko gargaarka bini'aadannimada
items.summary: Darawalka Formula 1 ee 7 jeer horyaalka adduunka ku guuleystay, Lewis Hamilton, ayaa Talaadadii booqday magaalada El Arish ee Masar iyo marinka Rafah, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay shaqaalaha gargaarka ee loo diyaarinayo Marinka Gaza.
items.imageAlt: Darawalka Formula 1 Lewis Hamilton

items.title: Aurélien Tchouaméni oo dhaawac awgiis uga baxay xulka Faransiiska
items.summary: Khadka dhexe ee Real Madrid, Aurélien Tchouaméni, ayaa ka tagaya xerada xulka Faransiiska kadib dhaawac uu ka gaaray agagaarka gumaarka, mana ciyaari doono kulamada Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga ee UEFA Nations League.
items.imageAlt: Aurélien Tchouaméni oo u ciyaaraya xulka Faransiiska

items.title: Maamulka Trump oo soo jeediyay xeer ka saari kara 6.3 milyan oo qof barnaamijka gargaarka cuntada
items.summary: Wasaaradda Beeraha Mareykanka (USDA) ayaa Talaadadii daabacday xeer la soo jeediyay oo meesha ka saaraya u-qalmitaanka tooska ah ee barnaamijka SNAP, taasoo sida ay werisay Al Jazeera ka saari karta qiyaastii 6.3 milyan oo qof.
items.imageAlt: Suuq beereed ku yaal Baltimore oo lagu isticmaalo kaararka EBT ee gargaarka cuntada

items.title: Kirk Cousins oo dib ugu laabtay Minnesota Vikings, Raiders-na jagada waxay siiyeen Fernando Mendoza
items.summary: Kooxda Minnesota Vikings ayaa Kirk Cousins, oo ah quarterback 38 jir ah, ka heshay kooxda Las Vegas Raiders iyagoo bixinaya doorashada wareegga 3-aad ee 2027.
items.imageAlt: Kirk Cousins oo xiran dirayska Minnesota Vikings intii lagu jiray ciyaar NFL

items.title: Jim Jordan oo loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka, kadib lumintii aqlabiyadda
items.summary: Xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Aqalka Wakiilada Mareykanka ayaa cod qarsoodi ah ku doortay Jim Jordan, oo ka socda gobolka Ohio kuna dhow Madaxweyne Donald Trump, si uu u beddelo Mike Johnson, toddobaad kadib markii xisbigu lumiyay aqlabiyadda doorashooyinkii xilliga dhexe.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Xildhibaan Jim Jordan

items.title: Xeer-ilaalinta Mareykanka: hoggaamiye Kataib Hezbollah ah oo xabsi New York ka hagay qorshe weerar saldhig Ingiriis
items.summary: Dacwad cusub oo ay xeer-ilaalinta federaalka Mareykanka soo saartay ayaa lagu eedeeyay Mohammad Dawood Al-Saadi, oo haysta dhalashada Iran iyo Ciraaq, inuu isagoo xabsi ku jira New York hagay qorshe fashilmay oo lagu doonayay in lagu weeraro saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee RAF Fairford ee Ingiriiska.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad dagaal oo Mareykan ah oo ka duulaysa saldhigga RAF Fairford ee Ingiriiska

items.title: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda oo amar ku bixiyay xarigga saraakiil ka tirsan degmada Ibanda
items.summary: Wasiirka Dowladaha Hoose ee Uganda, Balaam Barugahara, ayaa amar ku bixiyay in la xiro lagana joojiyo shaqada qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha dowladda hoose ee degmada Ibanda, kuwaas oo lagu eedeeyay musuqmaasuq, maamul xumo lacagaha dadweynaha iyo xadgudub xilka.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Uganda Balaam Barugahara

items.title: Ingiriiska oo sheegay in habka dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Suudaan
items.summary: Ku-xigeenka Ergayga Joogtada ah ee Ingiriiska ee Qaramada Midoobay, Kate Foster, ayaa shir Golaha Ammaanka ee New York ka sheegay in habka cusub ee dowladda ku-meel-gaarka ah uu sii wiiqay is-afgaradka siyaasadeed, iyadoo qodobo muhiim ah oo heshiiska nabadda ee 2018 aan weli la fulin.
items.imageAlt: Qolka shirarka Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York

items.title: Rabshado ka dhacay Bangladesh kadib markii taageerayaasha Sheikh Hasina ay dibadbax sameeyeen
items.summary: Booliska Bangladesh ayaa gaas ilmeysiiye iyo rasaas caag ah ku kala eryay taageerayaasha ra'iisul wasaarihii xilka laga tuuray Sheikh Hasina, kuwaas oo dalbanaya inay dalka dib ugu soo laabato.
items.imageAlt: Suuqa cusub ee degmada Gopalganj ee Bangladesh

items.title: Von der Leyen oo 50 milyan oo yuuro u ballan qaaday Bulgaria iyo Romania kadib weerarrada Badda Madow
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Guddiga Midowga Yurub, Ursula von der Leyen, ayaa ballan qaaday 50 milyan oo yuuro si loo dedejiyo xarun wadaag ah oo amniga badda oo ay Bulgaria iyo Romania ka hirgelinayaan Badda Madow, kadib weerarro diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn lagu qaaday maraakiib xamuul.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Varna ee Bulgaria, oo ku taal xeebta Badda Madow

items.title: Uganda oo higsaneysa inay sannadkii soo saarto 210 milyan oo lammaane galoofyada caafimaadka
items.summary: Wasiirka Dowlaha ee Warshadaha Uganda, David Bahati, ayaa xariga ka jaray khadka 2-aad ee wax-soo-saarka warshadda East African Medical Vitals ee Namanve, taasoo lagu wado inay awoodda sannadlaha ah ka qaaddo qiyaastii 80 milyan ilaa 210 milyan oo lammaane.
items.imageAlt: Galoofyada caafimaadka oo la baarayo

items.title: Iran oo sheegtay inaysan hakin ballanqaadyadeeda NPT, iyadoo kooxaha adag ay ka hadlayaan bam nukliyeer
items.summary: Iran ayaa sheegtay inaysan hakin waajibaadkeeda heshiiska ka-hortagga faafidda hubka nukliyeerka (NPT), hase yeeshee kormeerro caalami ah oo ballaaran oo lagu sameeyo goobaheeda ayaa weli fog.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, Iran

items.title: Maxkamad rafcaan oo ku taal London oo baabi'isay sharcigii Trinidad iyo Tobago ee mamnuucayay galmada khaniisiinta
items.summary: Maxkamadda rafcaanka ugu dambaysa ee Trinidad iyo Tobago, oo fadhigeedu yahay England, ayaa Talaadadii baabi'isay sharci qarniyo jiray oo dambi ka dhigayay galmada dadka isku jinsiga ah.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Middlesex Guildhall ee London, halkaas oo ay ku shaqeyso maxkamadda

items.title: Scott McTominay oo shaaciyay inuu daaweyn wadnaha ah helay intii lagu jiray Koobka Adduunka
items.summary: Ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe ee Napoli iyo xulka Scotland, Scott McTominay, ayaa sheegay inuu daaweyn lagu saxayo garaaca wadnaha oo aan caadi ahayn helay laba maalmood ka hor guushii Scotland ee Haiti bishii June ee Koobka Adduunka.
items.imageAlt: Scott McTominay oo u ciyaaraya Scotland ciyaartii Bolivia, June 2026

items.title: Xisbiga National Rally oo heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray bangiyo si loo maalgeliyo ololaha Le Pen
items.summary: Xisbiga midigta fog ee Faransiiska, National Rally, ayaa heshiis hordhac ah la gaaray laba bangi oo Yurub ah oo ku saabsan amaah dhan 10.6 milyan euro oo lagu maalgelinayo ololaha doorashada madaxtinimo ee Marine Le Pen, sida uu sheegay khasnajiga xisbiga.
items.imageAlt: Marine Le Pen, hoggaamiyaha xisbiga National Rally, May 2024

items.title: Masar oo sheegtay in ciidamadeedu ay bilooyin joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya ujeeddo difaac
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in askar Masaari ah ay bilooyin badan joogeen Sacuudi Carabiya si ay u ilaaliyaan goobo muhiim ah kadib weerarro lagu qaaday boqortooyada, isagoo xusay in ciidamadaasi aysan u gudbi doonin Yemen.
items.imageAlt: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty

items.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo xaqiijisay kiis dhimasho ah oo qandhada jaallaha ah ee degmada Morobo
items.summary: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Koonfur Suudaan ayaa xaqiijisay in nin beeralay ah oo 48 jir ah oo ku noolaa degmada Morobo ee gobolka Central Equatoria uu u dhintay qandhada jaallaha (yellow fever), kadib safar uu ku tagay Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Kongo.
items.imageAlt: Buurta Lujule ee degmada Morobo, Koonfur Suudaan

items.title: Pochettino oo la sheegay inuu xiiseynayo inuu ka tago xulka Mareykanka oo uu u dhaqaaqo Manchester United
items.summary: Tababaraha xulka ragga Mareykanka, Mauricio Pochettino, ayaa xiiseynaya inuu qaato shaqada tababarenimo ee Manchester United, xiisahaasna waa mid labada dhinac ah, sida ay wargeyska The Guardian u sheegeen ilo badan.
items.imageAlt: Mauricio Pochettino oo hoggaaminaya xulka Mareykanka ciyaartii Belgium, March 2026

items.title: Baarlamaanka Uganda oo amray baaritaan laba toddobaad ah oo ku saabsan maalgashiga Dei BioPharma
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Uganda, Jacob Oboth, ayaa faray guddiga sayniska iyo tiknoolajiyadda inuu laba toddobaad gudahood baaro maalgashiga 723.4 bilyan oo shilin ee dowladdu ku samaysay shirkadda Dei BioPharma.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Baarlamaanka Uganda ee magaalada Kampala

items.title: Kenya oo safaaradeedii Haiti u wareejisay magaalada Mexico City
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya ayaa sheegtay in xafiiska diblomaasiyadeed ee Port-au-Prince loo raray Mexico City, taas oo qayb ka ah dib-u-habeyn lagu sameynayo safaaradaha dalka.
items.imageAlt: Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya, Korir Sing'oei, oo kulan ku leh Vienna

items.title: Eli Junior Kroupi oo markii ugu horreysay loogu yeeray xulka Faransiiska, isagoo beddelaya Marcus Thuram
items.summary: Weeraryahanka Bournemouth ee 20 jirka ah, Eli Junior Kroupi, ayaa tababaraha xulka Faransiiska Zinédine Zidane markii ugu horreysay u yeeray, si uu u beddelo Marcus Thuram oo dhaawac uga baxay xerada.
items.imageAlt: Eli Junior Kroupi oo u ciyaaraya Bournemouth ciyaar ay la yeesheen Fulham, May 2026

items.title: Jeneraal Muhoozi oo xiray bartiisa X kadib hanjabaad uu u diray Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Uganda
items.summary: Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa xiray bartiisa X kadib qoraallo uu ugu hanjabay Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Jessica Alupo inay xilka ka dhaqaaqdo.
items.imageAlt: Ku-xigeenka Madaxweynaha Uganda, Jessica Alupo

items.title: Formula 1 oo xilli ciyaareedka ku soo gabagabeyn doonta Qatar iyo Abu Dhabi sidii loo qorsheeyay
items.summary: Formula 1 ayaa ku wargelisay garoonka Imola ee Talyaaniga in aan loo baahan doonin kayd ahaan, iyadoo tartannada Qatar (27 ilaa 29 November) iyo Abu Dhabi (4 ilaa 6 December) ay dhici doonaan sidii loo qorsheeyay inkasta oo ay socoto colaadda Mareykanka iyo Israa'iil ay la leeyihiin Iran.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarado ka duulaya jasiiradda Yas intii lagu jiray tartanka Abu Dhabi Grand Prix

items.title: Booliiska Faransiiska oo dad u xiray baaritaanka Mohamed Al Fayed
items.summary: Booliiska Faransiiska ayaa dad xiray kadib markii ay baareen saddex hanti oo uu ku jiro hotelka Ritz ee Paris, iyagoo ka shaqeynaya baaritaanka xadgudubyadii loo aaneeyay Mohamed Al Fayed, sida ay sheegtay warqad Booliiska Magaalada London (Met) u direen dhibbanayaasha.
items.imageAlt: Hotelka Ritz ee fagaaraha Place Vendôme ee Paris

items.title: TAZARA oo joojisay tareenada u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December
items.summary: Hay'adda Tareenada Tanzania iyo Zambia (TAZARA) ayaa joojisay adeegyada tareenada rakaabka iyo xamuulka ee u dhexeeya Mbeya iyo Makambako ilaa 1 December 2026, kadib shil tareen xamuul oo burburiyay dhowr kiilomitir oo jidka tareenka ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Tareen TAZARA ah oo u socda Mbeya

items.title: Uganda oo sheegtay inay hakadka ka qaadi doonto qaar ka mid ah hay'adaha NGO-yada
items.summary: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Uganda, Ephraim Kamuntu, ayaa sheegay in hay'adaha aan dowliga ahayn ee la hubiyo inay xalliyeen walaacyadii laga qabay loo oggolaan doono inay dib u bilaabaan hawlahooda, kadib dib-u-eegis lagu sameeyay 10 hay'adood oo la hakiyay.
items.imageAlt: Waddada Kampala Road ee caasimadda Uganda, Kampala

items.title: Qiimaha alaabta Mareykanka oo October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba, in ka badan intii la filayay
items.summary: Qiimaha alaabta macaamiisha ee Mareykanka ayaa bishii October kordhay 0.4 boqolkiiba marka loo eego bishii ka horreysay, halka dhaqaaleyahannadu filayeen 0.3 boqolkiiba, sida ay muujisay xog uu Talaadadii soo saaray Xafiiska Tirakoobka Shaqada (BLS).
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Postal Square ee Washington, D.C., oo ay ku taal xarunta Xafiiska Tirakoobka Shaqada ee Mareykanka

items.title: Hegseth oo isku dayga xil ka qaadistiisa ku tilmaamay jees-jees iyo carqaladeyn
items.summary: Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth, ayaa Talaadadii shir jaraa'id ku sheegay in qaraarka xil ka qaadistiisa ee Golaha Wakiillada uu yahay jees-jees iyo ciyaar siyaasadeed, isagoo dhaliisha loo jeediyay iyo dagaalka Iran ku tilmaamay khilaaf siyaasadeed.
items.imageAlt: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee Wasiirka Difaaca Mareykanka Pete Hegseth

items.title: OCHA: Qorshaha gargaarka Soomaaliya ee 2026 waxaa loo helay 300 milyan oo dollar, oo ah 35.2% kaliya
items.summary: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-duwidda arrimaha bani'aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa sheegay in qorshaha gurmadka bani'aadannimo ee Soomaaliya ee sannadka 2026 loo helay ilaa 300 milyan oo dollar, taas oo ah 35.2 boqolkiiba lacagta loo baahan yahay.
items.imageAlt: Haween Soomaaliyeed oo safka u taagan si ay u helaan baaritaan caafimaad oo bilaash ah, xero barakacayaal oo ku taal Muqdisho

items.title: Usman Khawaja oo sheegay in xubin MCC ah ay cunsuriyad ula dhaqantay Lord's sannadkii 2023
items.summary: Ciyaaryahankii hore ee kubadda cricket-ka Australia, Usman Khawaja, ayaa buuggiisa cusub ee taariikh nololeedka ku sheegay in xubin ka tirsan naadiga Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC) ay si cunsuriyad ah u caayday intii lagu jiray ciyaartii Ashes ee Lord's sannadkii 2023.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Pavilion ee garoonka cricket-ka Lord's ee London

items.title: Anthropic oo qorsheyneysa inay ilaa $64 bilyan ka ururiso suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq
items.summary: Shirkadda sirdoonka macmalka ah ee Anthropic, oo samaysay barnaamijka Claude, ayaa sheegtay inay saamiyadeeda ku iibin doonto inta u dhexeysa $70 iyo $78 halkii saami marka ay ku biirto suuqa saamiyada Nasdaq ee New York, iyadoo ku ururin karta ilaa $64 bilyan.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Nasdaq MarketSite ee magaalada New York

items.title: Baarlamaanka cusub ee Israa'iil oo la dhaariyay, Eisenkot oo isku dayaya dhisidda dowlad
items.summary: Xildhibaannada cusub ee Knesset-ka Israa'iil ayaa Talaadadii la dhaariyay, iyadoo hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Gadi Eisenkot uu isku dayayo inuu dhiso dowlad xukunka kaga tuurta ra'iisul wasaare ku-simaha Benjamin Netanyahu.
items.imageAlt: Dhismaha Knesset-ka, baarlamaanka Israa'iil, ee Qudus

items.title: Wasiir Daahir Shire oo Beledweyne ka sheegay in dowladdu dareensan tahay tabashada reer Hiiraan
items.summary: Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed, oo hoggaaminaya wafdi maanta gaaray Beledweyne, ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalku dareensan tahay tabashada dadka gobolka Hiiraan oo ay ka qayb qaadan doonto xalkeeda.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Beledweyne ee gobolka Hiiraan

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo laga soo celiyay Liibiya
items.summary: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta soo dhoweysay 171 muwaadin oo dalka dib loogu soo celiyay kadib markii ay horey ugu tahriibeen Liibiya.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Diyaaradaha Caalamiga ah ee Aadan Cadde ee Muqdisho

items.title: Safiirka Turkiga iyo La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga milatari iyo amniga
items.summary: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay La-taliyaha Amniga Qaranka, Aweys Xaaji Yuusuf Axmed, waxayna ka wada hadleen iskaashiga milatari iyo amni ee labada dal iyo la dagaallanka argagixisada, sida ay sheegtay safaaradda Turkiga.
items.imageAlt: Saldhigga milatari ee Turkiga ee magaalada Muqdisho

items.title: Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran: Laba markab oo saliid qaada ayaa dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz
items.summary: Ciidamada badda ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran (IRGC) ayaa sheegay in Talaadadii laba markab oo saliid qaada ay dab ku qabsaday Marinka Hormuz, kaddib qarax ka dhacay waddo aysan Iran oggolaan.
items.imageAlt: Marinka Hormuz oo laga arkayo diyaarad

items.title: Qiimaha saliidda Brent oo markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August ka hooseeyay 90 doolar
items.summary: Saliidda Brent ayaa Talaadadii hoos ugu dhacday in ka yar 90 doolar fuustii, markii ugu horreysay tan iyo August, kaddib markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu tilmaamay in dagaalka Iran uu dhammaan karo.
items.imageAlt: Goob saliid laga soo saaro oo ku taal Badda Waqooyi

items.title: Maxkamad Malaysia oo u oggolaatay in Najib Razak loo wareejiyo xabsi guri
items.summary: Maxkamadda Sare ee Kuala Lumpur ayaa go'aamisay in ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Malaysia Najib Razak, oo 73 jir ah, uu inta ka hartay xukunkiisa la dhimay ee 6 sano ah ku qaato xabsi guri.
items.imageAlt: Najib Razak, ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Malaysia, sannadkii 2017

items.title: RC Lens oo xilka ka qaadday tababare Yannick Cahuzac 2 bilood kaddib magacaabistiisa
items.summary: Kooxda Lens ee horyaalka Faransiiska ayaa Talaadadii xilka ka qaadday tababaraheeda Yannick Cahuzac, kaddib toddobaad ay 3 jeer isku xigta ku guuldarreysatay.
items.imageAlt: Yannick Cahuzac sannadkii 2019

items.title: Japan oo Filibiin siinaysa radar xeebeed iyo diyaarado drone ah oo qiimahoodu yahay 4.3 bilyan yen
items.summary: Japan iyo Filibiin ayaa Manila ku saxiixay heshiis deeq ah oo 4.3 bilyan yen (24 milyan euro) ah, kaas oo Japan ay ku siinayso ciidamada Filibiin nidaam radar xeebeed ah iyo diyaarado drone ah oo lagu kormeero maraakiibta.
items.imageAlt: Markabka dagaal ee BRP Miguel Malvar ee ciidamada badda Filibiin

items.title: Bulgaria: Ugu yaraan 11 qof oo ku dhintay shil baabuur badan oo meel u dhow Yambol
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 11 qof ayaa ku dhintay, 48 kalena way ku dhaawacmeen shil ay ku lug lahaayeen baabuur badan oo ka dhacay waddada weyn ee Trakia meel u dhow magaalada Yambol ee Bulgaria, sida uu sheegay Ra'iisul Wasaare Rumen Radev.
items.imageAlt: Waddada weyn ee Trakia ee Bulgaria

items.title: Uganda oo bilaabaysa barnaamij qaran oo tababar degdeg ah oo lagu daryeelayo dadka dhaawacma
items.summary: Barnaamij qaran oo shaqaalaha caafimaadka, shaqaalaha ambalaasta iyo shacabka caadiga ah lagu barayo sida loo gurmado dadka dhaawacma ayaa laga bilaabayaa Uganda, si loo yareeyo dhimashada laga hortagi karo.
items.imageAlt: Ambalaas ka shaqeynaysa magaalada Kampala

items.title: Iran oo beenisay wadahadal la qorsheeyay, kaddib markii Trump sheegay in dagaalka ciidan uu 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday'
items.summary: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in dagaalka Iran uu dhinaca militariga ka 'ku dhowaad dhammaaday', halka saraakiisha Iran ay beeniyeen warar sheegaya wadahadal la qorsheeyay oo Qatar lagu qabanayo.
items.imageAlt: Abbas Araghchi oo ku sugan kulan lagu qabtay Vienna (2021)

items.title: Lix dal iyo shirkado ay ka mid yihiin Anthropic, OpenAI iyo Microsoft oo saxiixay 'Baaqa Paris' ee amniga AI
items.summary: Madaxda Bahrain, Canada, Finland, Faransiiska, Norway iyo Netherlands iyo madaxda 10 shirkadood oo AI ah ayaa 9-ka November saxiixay baaq wadajir ah oo loogu magac daray 'Paris Call for AI Safety and Security'.
items.imageAlt: Qasriga Élysée ee Paris, xarunta Madaxtooyada Faransiiska

items.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo u ambabaxday Antalya si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka cimilada COP31
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa u safartay Antalya ee Türkiye si ay uga qeyb gasho shirka COP31 iyo kulan heer sare ah oo ku saabsan cunto-karinta nadiifka ah ee Afrika, sida ay werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.
items.imageAlt: Samia Suluhu Hassan (2017)

items.title: Mandera: 8 qof oo lagu dilay weerar lagu qaaday gaari ilaalinayay shaqaalaha waddada Arabia
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 8 qof ayaa lagu dilay weerar gaadmo ah oo hubeysteyaal ku qaadeen gaari amni oo ilaalinayay shaqaalaha mashruuca waddada Mandera–Arabia–Lafey.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Mandera ee waqooyi-bari Kenya

items.title: Askar ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle oo ka baxay ciidamada dowladda kaddib baaqii Ugaaska beesha
items.summary: Ugu yaraan 300 oo askari oo ka tirsan beesha Xawaadle ayaa labadii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay ka baxay safka ciidamada dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib baaq uu soo saaray Ugaaska guud ee beesha.
items.imageAlt: Gaari ay saaran yihiin askar ka tirsan ciidamada xoogga dalka Soomaaliya oo dhex maraya magaalada Beledweyne (sawir hore, 2012)

items.title: Hindiya: 3 shaqaale oo ku dhintay warshadda qaybaha iPhone ee Tata ee Hosur
items.summary: Saddex shaqaale qandaraas ah ayaa ku dhintay warshadda Tata Electronics ee Hosur, gobolka Tamil Nadu, kaddib markii ay neefsadeen gaas intii ay baarayeen haan biyo-sifeyn.
items.imageAlt: Qorrax-soo-baxa magaalada Hosur ee gobolka Tamil Nadu, Hindiya

items.title: Isbaanish: Sarkaal booliis ah oo ku dhintay qarax boorso ka dhacay magaalada Oviedo
items.summary: Sarkaal ka tirsan Booliska Qaranka Isbaanish ayaa ku dhintay, mid kalena si xun ayuu u dhaawacmay, kaddib markii boorso dhabarka la saarto ay ku qaraxday dhisme ku yaal magaalada Oviedo, sida ay werisay BBC iyo warbaahinta Isbaanish.
items.imageAlt: Muuqaal ka mid ah magaalada Oviedo ee Isbaanish

items.title: Uganda: Golaha Wasiirada oo ansixiyay 19 bilyan oo shilin oo loogu talagalay 1,841 ganacsade oo fatahaaddu saameysay

items.summary: Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan (Digfeer) ee Muqdisho ayaa qaybtiisa baaritaanka unugyada ku daray saddex mashiin oo markii ugu horreysay la keenay Soomaaliya, sida uu Dawan Africa u sheegay madaxa qaybta, Dr. Ismaaciil Maxamuud Cabdullaahi.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Isbitaalka Recep Tayyip Erdogan ee Muqdisho (2015)

items.title: Premier League: Arsenal oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Liverpool, hoggaankana qabsatay
items.summary: Gool uu Kai Havertz dhaliyay daqiiqadii 16-aad ayaa Arsenal u horseeday guushii ugu horreysay ee ay Anfield ka gaarto 14 sano gudahood, waxayna u gudubtay kaalinta koowaad ee Premier League.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Anfield ee kooxda Liverpool oo laga muuqaal qaaday safka weyn

items.title: Bundesliga: Eintracht Frankfurt oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Hamburger SV
items.summary: Eintracht Frankfurt ayaa 3-1 ku garaacday Hamburger SV, waxayna u dalacday kaalinta 8-aad ee Bundesliga, sida ay Bulinews iyo IANS ku warrameen.
items.imageAlt: Ciyaar Eintracht Frankfurt ku dhex martay garoonkeeda Waldstadion (Deutsche Bank Park), 2024

items.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Racing Santander
items.summary: Real Madrid ayaa qeybtii hore saddex gool ku dhalisay garoonka Racing Santander, waxayna gaartay guushii lixaad oo isku xigta, sida ay muujiyeen warbixinnada kooxda iyo ESPN.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka El Sardinero ee magaalada Santander, Isbaanish

items.title: SomBank iyo IBS Bank oo maalgelin Islaami ah u fidiyay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed
items.summary: SomBank ayaa sheegtay inay kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed siisay maalgelin Islaami ah oo gaareysa ilaa $2 milyan, halka IBS Bank ay soo bandhigtay adeeg cusub oo lagu magacaabo “Kalluun Kaabe”.
items.imageAlt: Laba kalluumeysato Soomaaliyeed oo ku sugan magaalada Baraawe

items.title: Barnaamijka Saudi Noor oo Muqdisho ka bilaabay daaweyn iyo qalliin bilaash ah oo indhaha
items.summary: Barnaamijka bani’aadminnimo ee Saudi Noor 2026 ayaa Isbitaalka Madiina ee Muqdisho ka bilaabay adeegyo bilaash ah oo daryeelka indhaha, kuwaas oo lagu wado inay gaaraan ku dhawaad 500 bukaan.
items.imageAlt: Dhakhtar ku jira qaybta gurmadka ee Isbitaalka Madiina, Muqdisho (2014)

items.title: Ligue 1: Marseille oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Toulouse garoonka Vélodrome
items.summary: Olympique de Marseille ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Toulouse ciyaar ka tirsan wareegga 9-aad ee Ligue 1.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Vélodrome ee kooxda Olympique de Marseille

items.title: Shirka COP17 oo Yerevan ku ansixiyay qorshe lagu dardargelinayo ilaalinta dabeecadda
items.summary: Dalalka ka qeybgalay Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee caasimadda Armenia ayaa ku heshiiyay “Yerevan Pathway”, oo ah qorshe lagu dardargelinayo 23-ka hadaf ee la doonayo in la gaaro 2030.
items.imageAlt: Albaabka xarunta Shirka QM ee Kala-duwanaanshaha Noolaha (COP17) ee Yerevan, Armenia

items.title: Mo Ibrahim: Dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha Afrika waa hoos u dhacayaan
items.summary: Mo Ibrahim, aasaasaha hay’adda Mo Ibrahim Foundation, ayaa wakaaladda AFP u sheegay in dimuqraadiyadda iyo xuquuqda aadanaha ay Afrika hoos ugu dhacayaan. Tusmada hay’addu waxay muujisay horumar dhaqaale, balse hoos u dhac xagga amniga iyo ka qeybgalka dadweynaha.
items.imageAlt: Mo Ibrahim oo khudbad ka jeedinaya shir ka dhacay Uppsala, Iswiidhan (2014)

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga safiirka Israa’iil
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa Axaddii qasriga madaxtooyada ee Hargeysa ku guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga Michael Lotem, oo ah safiirka Israa’iil u fadhiya Somaliland.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Cirro oo Hargeysa kula hadlaya taliyaha AFRICOM, Gen. Dagvin Anderson (Nofeembar 2025)

items.title: Hawlgalkii QM ee Saxaraha Galbeed (MINURSO) oo dhammaaday kadib 35 sano
items.summary: Muddada hawlgalka MINURSO ayaa dhammaatay saqdii dhexe ee Sabtida kadib markii Golaha Ammaanka uu ku heshiin waayay mustaqbalkiisa. Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres ayaa sheegay in QM ay diyaar u tahay inay sii taageerto dadaallada nabadda.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta hawlgalka MINURSO ee magaalada Laayoune (2012)

items.title: Boosaaso oo lagu qabtay tartankii ugu horreeyay ee kubadda cagta xeebta Soomaaliya
items.summary: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Puntland iyo Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ayaa 30 Oktoobar Boosaaso ka furay tartan kubadda cagta xeebta ah oo ay ka qayb galayaan 6 kooxood, kaas oo markii ugu horreysay ay haweenku ka muuqdaan.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Boosaaso iyo xeebteeda oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qayb gashay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026
items.summary: Calanka Soomaaliya ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwa lagu soo bandhigay furitaanka Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada ee Dakar 2026, oo socon doona 31 Oktoobar ilaa 13 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxaa matalaya feeryahanka 17 jirka ah Xasan Anwar oo ku tartamaya miisaanka 50 kiilo.
items.imageAlt: Damaashaadka toosha Ciyaaraha Olombikada Dhallinyarada Dakar 2026 ee Diamniadio

items.title: Golden State Valkyries oo ku guuleystay horyaalkii ugu horreeyay ee WNBA
items.summary: Golden State Valkyries ayaa ciyaartii 7aad ee finalka WNBA ku garaacday Atlanta Dream 68-63, waxayna qaadeen horyaalkoodii ugu horreeyay, iyagoo ku jira xilli-ciyaareedkoodii 2aad oo keliya.
items.imageAlt: Golden State Valkyries oo la ciyaaraya Indiana Fever (May 2026)

items.title: Lewis Hamilton oo ka bilaabaya safka hore Mexico City Grand Prix
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton ayaa markii ugu horreysay isagoo u tartamaya Ferrari ku guuleystay booska koowaad ee bilowga (pole) ee Mexico City Grand Prix, isagoo ka horreeyay George Russell iyo Charles Leclerc.
items.imageAlt: Lewis Hamilton oo baabuurka Ferrari wata (2025)

items.title: Canelo Álvarez oo dib u qaatay suunka WBC ee miisaanka super-middleweight
items.summary: Feeryahanka reer Mexico Canelo Álvarez ayaa magaalada Riyadh go’aan ay garsoorayaasha oo dhammi isku raaceen kaga adkaaday Christian Mbilli, oo ahaa horyaal aan weli laga badin, wuxuuna dib ula noqday suunka WBC.
items.imageAlt: Canelo Álvarez oo feeraha ku jira (sawir hore, 2017)

items.title: Nigeria oo baaraysa laba kiis oo looga shakiyay Ebola
items.summary: Xarunta Nigeria ee La-dagaallanka iyo Ka-hortagga Cudurrada (NCDC) ayaa sheegtay in waqooyi-bari dalka laga helay laba qof oo looga shakiyay Ebola; waa la go’doomiyay, baaritaan shaybaarna waa lagu wadaa.
items.imageAlt: Fayraska Ebola oo mikroskoob lagu sawiray

items.title: Midowga Yurub oo baaraya warar sheegaya in markab kalluumeysi oo Iiraan leedahay lagu afduubay xeebaha Bari
items.summary: Hawlgalka badda ee Midowga Yurub, ATALANTA, ayaa baaraya warar sheegaya in burcad-badeed ay 29 Oktoobar afduubeen markabka kalluumeysiga Azini ee Iiraan leedahay, meel u dhow degmada Bandarbeyla. Xarunta Amniga Badda ee MSCIO ayaa maraakiibta ganacsiga ugu baaqday inay feejignaan muujiyaan.
items.imageAlt: Astaanta Midowga Yurub oo ku taal markab dagaal oo ka qayb qaata hawlgalka Atalanta (sawir hore, 2009)

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo Baydhabo ku guddoomiyay shir amni oo aan caadi ahayn
items.summary: Wakaaladda wararka dowladda, SONNA, ayaa sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Madoobe), uu Baydhabo ku guddoomiyay shir lagu qiimeeyay xaaladda amni ee deegaannada maamulka. Shirka waxaa looga hadlay xoojinta tallaabooyinka amniga iyo iskaashiga hay'adaha ammaanka.
items.imageAlt: Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur, sawir hore

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan oo ka wada hadlay ballaarinta ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga
items.summary: Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, ayaa Muqdisho kula kulmay safiirka Cumaan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Saalim bin Xabiib Al Camiri. Waxaa la sheegay in kulanku diiradda saaray xoojinta ganacsiga labada dal iyo abuurista fursado cusub oo ganacsi.
items.imageAlt: Qasriga Al Alam ee magaalada Muscat, Cumaan

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Ruushka oo ka wada hadlay iskaashiga amniga iyo tababarka booliska
items.summary: Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), ayaa la kulmay Igor Zubov, ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Ruushka. Zubov ayaa sheegay in dowladdiisu diyaar u tahay inay la wadaagto aqoonta iyo tababarka la dagaallanka dambiyada.
items.imageAlt: Saraakiil booliska Soomaaliyeed oo tababar ku jira, Akadeemiyada Booliska Generaal Kaahiye, Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2014)

items.title: Dowladda federaalka oo bilowday qorshaynta waddo 110 km ah oo isku xirta Buuhoodle iyo Tuulo-Samakaab
items.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in Wasiir Ayuub Ismaaciil oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka uu saxiixay qorshaha waddada, iyadoo uu goobta joogay Xildhibaan Cabdi Qawdhan. Xildhibaanku wuxuu sheegay in mashruucu yahay guul weyn oo nolosha dadka deegaanka beddeli doona.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Buuhoodle (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Barcelona oo 6-1 ku jabisay Alavés, Lamine Yamal-na 2 gool dhaliyay
items.summary: Barcelona ayaa 6-1 kaga adkaatay Alavés garoonka Spotify Camp Nou, waxayna dib ugu laabatay hoggaanka La Liga.
items.imageAlt: Lamine Yamal oo garoonka ku jira (2025)

items.title: Bayern iyo Dortmund oo 2-2 ku kala baxay, Harry Kane-na rigoore ayuu khasaariyay
items.summary: Bayern Munich iyo Borussia Dortmund ayaa garoonka Allianz Arena 2-2 ku kala baxay ciyaarta Der Klassiker ee Bundesliga.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Allianz Arena ee Bayern Munich (sawir hore)

items.title: AC Milan oo 3-1 kaga adkaatay Inter ciyaarta derby-ga Milan
items.summary: AC Milan ayaa garoonka San Siro 3-1 kaga guuleysatay Inter, waxayna joojisay taxanaha Inter ee 9 ciyaarood oo horyaal ah oo aan laga badin.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka San Siro ee magaalada Milan (sawir hore)

items.title: Washington DC iyo Virginia oo dacwad ka gudbiyay qorshaha qaansada guusha ee Trump
items.summary: Washington DC iyo gobolka Virginia ayaa maxkamad federaal ah ka codsaday inay joojiso qorshaha Madaxweyne Trump ee ah in qaanso guul (triumphal arch) laga dhiso Memorial Circle, iyagoo ku tilmaamay mid sharci-darro ah.
items.imageAlt: Buundada Arlington Memorial iyo wabiga Potomac ee Washington, D.C.

items.title: Erdoğan oo ugu baaqay Ruushka iyo Ukraine inay joojiyaan weerarrada Badda Madow
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa magaalada Istanbul, isagoo la taagan Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy, ku sheegay in weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta rayidka ee Badda Madow aan la aqbali karin, cid kasta oo fulisaba.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan (2025)

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo furay diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ka hor doorashooyinka 2027
items.summary: Diiwaangelinta ururrada siyaasadda ayaa socon doonta 1 ilaa 22 Nofembar. Soomaaliya waxay isu diyaarinaysaa doorashada baarlamaanka ee Abriil 2027 iyo doorashada madaxtooyada ee Maajo 2027.
items.imageAlt: Astaanta Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka

items.title: Madaxweyne Deni oo diiday jadwalka doorashada 2027, kuna baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa wareysi uu siiyay telefishinka Puntland ku sheegay inuusan arkin doorasho uu Xasan Sheekh qaban karo, wuxuuna ku baaqay gole ku-meel-gaar ah oo dalka u horseeda doorasho. Waxaa la xusay in eedeymaha uu soo jeediyay aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo ka hadlaya Golaha Wadatashiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho (2021)

items.title: Brighton oo 1-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester City garoonkeeda
items.summary: Yasin Ayari ayaa daqiiqaddii 11aad dhaliyay goolka keliya ee ciyaarta, Brighton-na markii ugu horreysay ayay garoonka City kaga guuleysatay, iyagoo isku dayay 18 jeer.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Amex ee kooxda Brighton, Ingiriiska (2013)

items.title: Koonfur Afrika oo 176 orod kaga adkaatay Australia, taxanaha Test-kana ku guuleysatay
items.summary: Koonfur Afrika ayaa garoonka Newlands ku guuleysatay Test-kii 3aad, taxanahana 2-1 ku qaadatay, kadib markii Australia, oo looga baahnaa 288 orod, lagu wada saaray 111 orod.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka kirikitka ee Newlands, Cape Town

items.title: Chelsea oo 2-0 ku garaacday Manchester United, United-na 9 ciyaarood kuma guuleysan
items.summary: Chelsea ayaa garoonka Stamford Bridge 2-0 kaga adkaatay Manchester United, kadib markii Lisandro Martínez laga saaray kaarka cas daqiiqaddii 63aad.
items.imageAlt: Garoonka Stamford Bridge ee Chelsea, London, oo hawada laga sawiray (2023)

items.title: Somaliland oo ka digtay xadgudubyada loo geysto dadka Itoobiyaanka ah ee ku nool Boorama
items.summary: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Somaliland, Barkhad Jaamac Batuun, ayaa sheegay in aan loo dulqaadan doonin xadgudub ama cabsi gelin lagula kaco ajaanibta. Wuxuu sheegay in qofna aanu xaq u lahayn inuu si xoog ah u saaro ama u weeraro ajnabi, arrimahaasna ay mari doonaan habka sharciga.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Boorama oo hawada laga sawiray (2024)

items.title: Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ku dartay liiska dekedaha aan buuxin heerarka amniga
items.summary: Ilaalada Xeebaha Mareykanka ayaa ogeysiis ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in dekedaha Soomaaliya aysan haysan tallaabooyin wax ku ool ah oo looga hortago argagixisada. Go'aanka oo dhaqan galay 27 Oktoobar wuxuu keenayaa hubin amni oo dheeraad ah oo lagu sameeyo maraakiibta Mareykanka u socda kadib markay soo maraan…
items.imageAlt: Konteenarro ku jira dekedda Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Achraf Hakimi oo saddex gool dhaliyay, PSG-na 5-1 ku garaacday Le Havre
items.summary: PSG ayaa Jimcihii 5-1 kaga adkaatay Le Havre, daafaca reer Morocco Achraf Hakimi ayaa dhaliyay 3 gool, 2 kalena caawiyay.
items.imageAlt: Achraf Hakimi oo xiran funaanadda Morocco (2024)

items.title: Somaliland oo shacabka ka mamnuucday qaadashada hubka
items.summary: Taliyaha booliska Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in ciidamada ammaanka la faray inay hubka ka qaadaan dadka aan haysan oggolaansho.
items.imageAlt: Magaalada Hargeysa oo hawada laga sawiray (2022)

items.title: Muqdisho oo lagu xusay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga
items.summary: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho ayaa xaflad u qabatay sannad-guuradii 103-aad ee aasaaska Jamhuuriyadda Turkiga. Guddoomiyaha Aqalka Sare, Cabdi Xaashi Cabdullaahi, ayaa sheegay in xiriirka labada dal uu ku dhisan yahay saaxiibtinimo iyo is-ixtiraam, isagoo xusay booqashadii Erdoğan ee 2011.
items.imageAlt: Safaaradda Turkiga ee Muqdisho

items.title: Uganda oo bilowday ka bixitaanka ciidamadeeda Soomaaliya kadib ku dhowaad 20 sano
items.summary: Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, Jen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa sheegay in la bilaabay ka bixitaanka ciidamada UPDF ee Soomaaliya, amniganna loo wareejinayo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa la sheegay in tallaabadu ay timid xilli miisaaniyadda taageerada hawlgalka AUSSOM la dhimay.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Uganda ee hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya oo salaan sharaf bixinaya (sawir hore, 2021)

items.title: Machadka Heritage oo daabacay daraasad ku saabsan doorka bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya
items.summary: Machadka Heritage ee Daraasaadka Siyaasadda ayaa soo saaray daraasad lagu qiimeynayo doorka, waxtarka iyo caqabadaha ururrada bulshada rayidka ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kaalintooda daah-furnaanta iyo la xisaabtanka dowladda. Agaasimaha machadka, Mursal Maxamuud Saney, ayaa sheegay in ururradaasi kaalin muhiim ah ka…
items.imageAlt: Xubno ka tirsan ururrada bulshada rayidka ah oo ka qaybgalaya shir dadweyne oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2014)

items.title: Jen. Maxamed Cali Barise oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga
items.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in Jen. Barise, oo la magacaabay 25-kii Oktoobar, uu xilka kala wareegay Jen. Madey Nuuray Sheekh Ufurow. Barise ayaa horay xilkan u hayay 2019 ilaa 2020.
items.imageAlt: Askarta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka qeyb galaya dhoolatus ciidan (2013)

items.title: Hay'adda Batroolka: Ceelka saliidda ee badda Curad-1 wuxuu gaaray lakab muhiim ah
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Hay'adda Batroolka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo ay wado shirkadda Turkiga ee TPAO, ay gaartay lakab ay ka muuqan karaan calaamadaha saliidda. Wuxuu sheegay in bartilmaameedka ugu dambeeya la filayo in la gaaro bisha Diseembar.
items.imageAlt: Markabka qodista saliidda ee Turkiga Kanuni (2020), ma aha Çağrı Bey

items.title: Somaliland oo dadkeeda ka mamnuucday ka qaybgalka siyaasadda Soomaaliya
items.summary: Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Somaliland ayaa soo saartay amar ay ku sheegtay in qof kasta oo ka qaybgala hawlaha siyaasadda Soomaaliya uu wajihi karo tallaabo sharci. Amarka lama caddeyn hawlaha uu khuseeyo iyo sida loo fulin doono.
items.imageAlt: Xarunta Golaha Wakiilada ee Hargeysa (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Hawlgalka QM oo dhammaanaya iyadoo aan la helin hab lagu xalliyo khilaafka doorashada
items.summary: Hawlgalka siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa Sabtida soo afjarmaya iyadoo aan la isku raacin hab beddela oo dhexdhexaadiya muranka muddo-xileedka madaxweynaha. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa mucaaradka ku casuumay wadahadal 14-18 Noofembar, balse kooxaha mucaaradka ee waaweyn weli ma xaqiijin ka-qaybgalkooda.
items.imageAlt: Shir Golaha Ammaanka QM uga socda xaaladda Soomaaliya (sawir hore, 2019)

items.title: Hirshabeelle oo ansixisay miisaaniyad $47.45 milyan ah oo sannadka 2027
items.summary: Waxaa la sheegay in golaha wasiirada Hirshabeelle, oo uu shir-guddoominayay Madaxweyne Guudlaawe, ay ansixiyeen miisaaniyadda 2027, taas oo 7% ka badan tii 2026. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay amniga, doorashooyinka iyo u diyaargarowga fatahaadaha.
items.imageAlt: Khariidadda Soomaaliya oo muujinaysa dowlad goboleedka Hirshabeelle

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo laba toddobaad hakiyay fadhiyada si loo rakibo nidaamka E-Parliament
items.summary: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa sheegay in fadhiyada la hakinayo laga bilaabo 31-ka Oktoobar. Wuxuu sheegay in nidaamka cusub uu dhaqan-galin doono codbixin elektaroonig ah iyo diiwaangelin dijitaal ah.
items.imageAlt: Xildhibaanno federaal ah oo fadhiya xaflad baarlamaan (2016)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo isu diyaarinaysa fatahaado El Niño oo laga cabsi qabo inay cunto-yaraanta kordhiyaan
items.summary: Barnaamijka Cuntada Adduunka (WFP) iyo hay'adaha la shaqeeya ayaa xoojinaya qorshayaasha xaaladaha degdegga ah, oo ay ku jiraan digniin hore, waddooyin gaadiid iyo lacag caddaan ah, ka hor roobabka El Niño. Bulshooyinka webiyada u dhow ayaa lagu tilmaamay kuwa ugu khatarta badan.
items.imageAlt: Sawir dayax-gacmeed oo muujinaya fatahaad ku teedsan webiga Shabeelle

items.title: Midowga Yurub: Badeecadaha Soomaaliya waxay suuqyadiisa ku geli karaan canshuur la'aan
items.summary: Ergada Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay ka mid tahay 33 dal oo Afrikaan ah oo nidaamka 'Everything But Arms' u oggolaanayo inay badeecadahooda, hubka mooyee, canshuur la'aan u dhoofiyaan Yurub. Waxaa la xusay in faa'iidadu ay ku xiran tahay in ganacsatadu buuxiyaan heerarka tayada ee Yurub.
items.imageAlt: Dekedda Berbera, oo badeecooyin badan laga dhoofiyo (2023)

items.title: Turkiga oo sheegay inuu markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi u soo dirayo xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.summary: Safiirka Turkiga u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa xilli lagu xusayay Toddobaadka Kalluumeysiga Qaranka ee Muqdisho ku dhawaaqay in markab cilmi-baaris iyo kalluumeysi loo soo dirayo si loo xoojiyo xirfadda kalluumeysatada Soomaaliyeed. Magaca markabka iyo goorta uu imanayo lama shaacin.
items.imageAlt: Doonyaha kalluumeysatada iyo shabaagyo ku yaal xeebta Garacad

items.title: Itoobiya oo sheegtay inay Ruushka ka heshay 12 diyaaradood oo dagaal
items.summary: Ra'iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Itoobiya ay heshay 12 diyaaradood oo nooca Su-35 ah, ayna sugayso nidaamyo difaaca hawada ah oo S-400 ah, xilli xiisad ka taagan tahay xadka Itoobiya iyo Eritrea.
items.imageAlt: Diyaarad dagaal oo nooca Su-35 ah

items.title: Wasiirka Tamarta oo kor u kaca qiimaha korontada Muqdisho ku sababeeyay qiimaha shidaalka
items.summary: Wasiir Cabdullaahi Bidhaan ayaa sheegay in kororka qiimaha korontada Muqdisho uu ka dhashay sicir-bararka shidaalka ee la xiriira xiisadda Bariga Dhexe, isagoo xusay in dowladdu ay hor istaagtay soo jeedin lagu labanlaabayay qiimaha.
items.imageAlt: Tiir koronto oo ku yaal Muqdisho (sawir hore, 2015)

items.title: Farmaajo oo baaritaan madax-bannaan ka dalbaday dagaalkii Jamea
items.summary: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo ayaa dowladda ku eedeeyay inay ciidamada u isticmaalayso khilaafaadka siyaasadeed. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in dagaalka lagu dilay 75 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweynihii hore Farmaajo oo khudbad jeedinaya (2017)

items.title: Soomaaliya oo daah-furtay qorshe shan sano ah oo ku saabsan dhallinyarada, nabadda iyo amniga
items.summary: Qorshaha 2026–2030 ayaa loogu talagalay in kaalinta dhallinyarada ee dhismaha nabadda la kordhiyo.
items.imageAlt: Dhallinyaro ka qaybgalaya shir dhallinyarada oo Muqdisho ka dhacay (sawir hore, 2016)

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo dib u dhigay safar uu ku tagi lahaa Ruushka
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa dib u dhigay safarkii loo qorsheeyay Ruushka. Warbixinta ayaa go'aankan la xiriirisay weerarrada Al-Shabaab iyo xiisadda doorashooyinka.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo shir ku jira (2015)

items.title: Shacabka ayaa gacanta u galay hubkii saarnaa gaariga la duqeeyay duleedka Buurhakabo
items.imageAlt: Askar ku sugan agagaarka Buurhakabo oo qorrax-dhac lagu sawiray (sawir hore, 2013)

items.title: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo isu diyaarinaya inay ka baxaan saldhigyo muhiim ah
items.summary: Ka bixitaanka ciidamada ayaa walaac ka dhex abuuray xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya.
items.imageAlt: Ciidamada Midowga Afrika oo garoonka Muqdisho ku sugaya diyaarad (2011)

items.title: Museveni oo Soomaalida ugu baaqay midnimo si looga adkaado Al-Shabaab
items.summary: Madaxweynaha Uganda ayaa sheegay in midnimadu tahay furaha looga adkaan karo caqabadda ugu weyn ee Soomaaliya haysata.
items.imageAlt: Madaxweyne Museveni oo soo dhaweynaya Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, shirkii Kampala (2023)

items.title: Hawlgalkii siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay oo Soomaaliya ku dhammaaday
items.summary: Xiritaanka hawlgalka ayaa soo afjaraya in ka badan soddon sano oo taageero QM ah oo ku aaddan dhismaha nabadda iyo maamulka.
items.imageAlt: Nicholas Kay, madaxii ugu horreeyay ee UNSOM, oo Muqdisho yimid markii hawlgalka la aasaasay (2013)

items.title: Villa Soomaaliya oo si rasmi ah gogol wadatashi ugu fidisay Madasha Mucaaradka
items.summary: Madasha Mucaaradka, oo ay ku jiraan Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe, iyo xisbiga Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa loo fidiyay wadatashiga, oo dhici doona 14–18 November.
items.imageAlt: Shan nin oo xubno ka ah Madasha oo sawir wadajir ah ka qaaday
